title_zh: 开场：糖酵解与三羧酸循环——全书最重要的两张图
title_en: Opening: glycolysis and the TCA cycle, the two most important schemes

points.zh: 今天的目标是尽可能把糖酵解全部讲完，主线是糖酵解，末尾再展望三羧酸循环。
points.en: The goal today is to get through all of glycolysis, with a look ahead to the TCA cycle at the end.

points.zh: 老师说糖酵解和三羧酸循环是整个生物化学里涉及化学结构最多的两张图，没有之一。
points.en: He calls glycolysis and the TCA cycle the two schemes that carry more chemical structure than anything else in biochemistry.

points.zh: 他进一步强调：整个生化没有任何章节比这两章更重要。
points.en: He goes further: no chapter in the whole of biochemistry matters more than these two.

points.zh: 这两章难度也比较大，所以本节课刻意放慢速度，把每一个化学反应一一过一遍。
points.en: They are also among the hardest, so the pace is deliberately slowed to walk through every single reaction.

points.zh: 学法是打开 ChemDraw，跟着老师一边讲一边画，把每一步反应亲手画出来。
points.en: The method: open ChemDraw and draw each step by hand while the reaction is being explained.

points.zh: 画的重点是看清每一步到底是哪一个化学键发生了改变。
points.en: What the drawing is for is seeing exactly which bond changes at each step.

points.zh: 老师认为一边画一边学，印象会比只看现成的图深刻很多。
points.en: Drawing along, he argues, fixes the pathway in memory far better than staring at a finished figure.

points.zh: 顺带会教 ChemDraw 的基本使用，作为画有机结构的工具。
points.en: Basic ChemDraw usage is taught alongside, as the tool for drawing organic structures.

extra.zh: 为什么偏偏是这两张图：糖酵解是几乎所有细胞共有的中心碳代谢入口，三羧酸循环则是碳骨架彻底氧化和生物合成前体（α-酮戊二酸、草酰乙酸、琥珀酰-CoA）的枢纽。后面的脂代谢、氨基酸代谢、糖异生、酮体全都挂在这两条主干上，所以先把它们学透，回报最高。
extra.en: Why these two: glycolysis is the central carbon entry shared by nearly every cell, and the TCA cycle is the hub both for complete oxidation and for biosynthetic precursors (alpha-ketoglutarate, oxaloacetate, succinyl-CoA). Lipid metabolism, amino acid metabolism, gluconeogenesis and ketogenesis all hang off these two trunks, which is why learning them first pays the most.

extra.zh: 先把两组数字钉住：糖酵解共 10 步酶促反应，每分子葡萄糖净得 2 ATP、2 NADH、2 丙酮酸（产 4 ATP、耗 2 ATP）；三羧酸循环每转一圈产 3 NADH、1 FADH2、1 GTP/ATP 和 2 分子 CO2。
extra.en: Two number sets worth nailing down now: glycolysis is 10 enzymatic steps and yields, per glucose, a net 2 ATP, 2 NADH and 2 pyruvate (4 made, 2 spent); one turn of the TCA cycle gives 3 NADH, 1 FADH2, 1 GTP/ATP and 2 CO2.

extra.zh: 画结构其实是在压缩记忆量：糖酵解 10 步只有四类化学变化——磷酰基转移（HK、PFK-1、PGK、PK）、异构化（PGI、TPI、变位酶）、羟醛裂解（醛缩酶）、氧化加底物水平磷酸化（GAPDH）。按化学变化归类，10 步就变成 4 个概念。
extra.en: Drawing is really a compression trick: the ten steps of glycolysis contain only four kinds of chemistry — phosphoryl transfer (HK, PFK-1, PGK, PK), isomerisation (PGI, TPI, mutase), aldol cleavage (aldolase), and oxidation coupled to substrate-level phosphorylation (GAPDH). Grouped that way, ten steps collapse into four ideas.

extra.zh: 糖酵解 glycolysis 与糖异生 gluconeogenesis 不是简单的正逆反应：两条路共用 7 步接近平衡的可逆酶，但糖酵解的三个不可逆步（己糖激酶、PFK-1、丙酮酸激酶）在糖异生里必须由另外的酶绕过（丙酮酸羧化酶+PEP 羧激酶、FBPase-1、葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶）。
extra.en: Glycolysis and gluconeogenesis are not one pathway run backwards: they share seven near-equilibrium reversible enzymes, but the three irreversible glycolytic steps (hexokinase, PFK-1, pyruvate kinase) must be bypassed by different enzymes (pyruvate carboxylase plus PEP carboxykinase, FBPase-1, glucose-6-phosphatase).

quiz.q_zh: 老师为什么把糖酵解和三羧酸循环并列，并要求逐个反应画结构？
quiz.q_en: Why does the teacher pair glycolysis with the TCA cycle and insist on drawing every reaction?

options.zh: 涉及化学结构最多，也是最重要的两章
options.en: Both carry the most structure and the most weight

options.zh: 都在线粒体基质中进行，同属一个区室
options.en: Both run entirely inside the mitochondrial matrix

options.zh: 都不受别构调节，因此规律最为简单
options.en: Both proceed without any allosteric control

options.zh: 都只在无氧条件下运转，机制完全相同
options.en: Both operate only under anaerobic conditions

quiz.explain_zh: 老师原话是这两章涉及的化学结构最多、也最重要。糖酵解在细胞质、三羧酸循环在线粒体基质，并不是同一区室；两者都有很强的别构调控（PFK-1、柠檬酸合酶、异柠檬酸脱氢酶）；糖酵解有氧无氧都在跑，三羧酸循环反而依赖有氧再生 NAD+，所以“只在无氧”也不成立。
quiz.explain_en: His own words: these two carry the most chemical structure and matter most. Glycolysis is cytosolic while the TCA cycle is in the mitochondrial matrix, so they are not one compartment; both are heavily allosterically regulated (PFK-1, citrate synthase, isocitrate dehydrogenase); and glycolysis runs aerobically as well, while the TCA cycle actually depends on oxygen to regenerate NAD+.

quiz.q_zh: 一分子葡萄糖走完糖酵解，净收益是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the net yield when one glucose runs through glycolysis?

options.zh: 净得 6 ATP、2 FADH2 和 2 分子乳酸
options.en: A net 6 ATP, 2 FADH2 and 2 lactate

options.zh: 净得 2 ATP、2 NADH 和 2 分子丙酮酸
options.en: A net 2 ATP, 2 NADH and 2 pyruvate

options.zh: 净得 4 ATP、2 NADH 和 2 分子丙酮酸
options.en: A net 4 ATP, 2 NADH and 2 pyruvate

options.zh: 净得 2 ATP、4 NADH 和 4 分子丙酮酸
options.en: A net 2 ATP, 4 NADH and 4 pyruvate

quiz.explain_zh: 底物水平磷酸化在 PGK 和 PK 两步共产 4 ATP，但准备阶段被己糖激酶和 PFK-1 消耗了 2 ATP，净得 2；NADH 只在 GAPDH 一步产生，每个三碳单位 1 个，共 2 个。糖酵解本身不产 FADH2，乳酸是无氧时由乳酸脱氢酶另外生成的分支产物，不计入糖酵解的产物。
quiz.explain_en: Substrate-level phosphorylation at PGK and PK makes 4 ATP, but hexokinase and PFK-1 spend 2 in the preparatory phase, so the net is 2; NADH comes only from GAPDH, one per triose, hence 2. Glycolysis makes no FADH2, and lactate is a separate anaerobic branch product made by lactate dehydrogenase.

title_zh: 【可跳过·非课程内容】ChemDraw 界面设置与软件闲聊
title_en: [Skippable · not course material] Setting up ChemDraw and software chat

points.zh: 在文档设置里把纸张改成横竖各十张，默认的一张纸不够画整条糖酵解。
points.en: In document settings the paper is enlarged to ten by ten pages; the default single sheet is too small for the whole pathway.

points.zh: 把文档类型改成 poster（海报）后，分页虚线消失，画面看起来更整洁。
points.en: Switching the document type to poster removes the page-break dashed lines and makes the canvas look cleaner.

points.zh: 元素周期表面板不在 object 菜单里，而是在视图 view 菜单中勾选“显示周期表”。
points.en: The periodic table panel is not under the object menu but is ticked on under the view menu.

points.zh: 老师说日常最常用的就是左侧工具栏和这个周期表两块面板。
points.en: The two panels he uses most are the left-hand toolbar and that periodic table.

points.zh: 工具栏可以点住边缘拖动，学生的默认在上方；老师习惯放在左边，纯属个人习惯。
points.en: The toolbar can be dragged by its edge; the student's sits at the top, while he prefers it on the left, purely a habit.

points.zh: 老师称 ChemDraw 是画有机结构的权威软件，全世界都在用。
points.en: He calls ChemDraw the authoritative tool for organic structures, used worldwide.

points.zh: 授权按人头计费，他说学术用户大约每人每年两万元，几百人的实验室根本买不起。
points.en: Licensing is per seat; he quotes roughly twenty thousand yuan per academic user per year, unaffordable for a lab of hundreds.

points.zh: 因此正版率很低，他提到厂商这两年在大量起诉未购买版权的使用者。
points.en: Hence few buy it, and he notes the vendor has been suing unlicensed users heavily in recent years.

extra.zh: 这一段是软件操作和闲聊，不含任何考点，复习时可以直接跳过；真正需要的技能是能徒手在纸上画出中间体。
extra.en: This stretch is software setup and small talk with no examinable content and can be skipped on review; the skill that matters is drawing the intermediates by hand on paper.

extra.zh: “学术用户每人每年两万元”是老师的印象值，不是可核实的官方报价，不要当数据记忆；实际授权价格因地区、订阅方式、机构协议差别很大。
extra.en: The figure of twenty thousand yuan per academic seat per year is the teacher's impression, not a verifiable published price; actual licensing varies widely by region, subscription type and institutional agreement.

extra.zh: 免费替代方案存在：ChemSketch、MarvinSketch、Ketcher、RDKit 都能画结构并导出矢量图。期刊要求的是矢量格式（EPS/SVG/PDF）与清晰度，从不指定必须用哪一款软件。
extra.en: Free alternatives exist: ChemSketch, MarvinSketch, Ketcher and RDKit all draw structures and export vector graphics. Journals require a vector format (EPS/SVG/PDF) and legibility, never a particular program.

extra.zh: 别把工具当内容：ChemDraw 的模板库里有现成的环系，可以一键放出六元环，但考试要求的是你知道这个环是吡喃环、哪个碳带 CH2OH、第一步磷酸化在哪里。
extra.en: Do not confuse the tool with the content: ChemDraw's template library will drop in a ready-made ring, but the exam asks whether you know it is a pyranose, which carbon bears the CH2OH, and where the first phosphorylation lands.

quiz.q_zh: 在 ChemDraw 里调出元素周期表面板，老师用的是哪个入口？
quiz.q_en: In which menu did the teacher find the periodic table panel?

options.zh: 在文档设置里把页面类型改成 poster
options.en: The poster page type in document settings

options.zh: 在文件菜单的模板 template 列表里面
options.en: The template list inside the file menu bar

options.zh: 在视图 view 菜单里勾选显示周期表
options.en: A show-periodic-table tick in the view menu

options.zh: 在对象 object 菜单里勾选周期表面板
options.en: A periodic-table tick in the object menu list

quiz.explain_zh: 他先在 object 里找，没找到，随即改口说是在视图 view 里勾选“显示周期表”。file 菜单里的 template 是结构模板，不是元素表；object 菜单里并没有这个开关；poster 是文档尺寸设置，与周期表无关。
quiz.explain_en: He first looked under object, failed to find it, and corrected himself to the view menu's show-periodic-table option. The template list under file holds structure templates, not the element table; the object menu has no such switch; and poster is a page-size setting unrelated to the panel.

quiz.q_zh: 把文档尺寸改成十乘十页、页面类型改成 poster，目的是什么？
quiz.q_en: Why enlarge the document to ten by ten pages and set the type to poster?

options.zh: 得到足够大的连续画布，去掉分页虚线
options.en: A big continuous canvas with no page dashes

options.zh: 只有 poster 模式才能把图片拖进文档
options.en: Only poster mode accepts a dragged-in image

options.zh: 只有 poster 模式才能调出元素周期表
options.en: Only poster mode exposes the periodic table

options.zh: 只有 poster 模式才能导出矢量图文件
options.en: Only poster mode can export a vector file

quiz.explain_zh: 老师的理由就是一张纸画不下整条糖酵解，改成海报页面后虚线也没了、看着更整洁。周期表是在视图菜单里开的，与页面类型无关；矢量导出和拖入图片在普通文档里同样可以做。
quiz.explain_en: His stated reason is that one sheet cannot hold the whole pathway, and the poster page also drops the dashed page breaks. The periodic table is toggled from the view menu regardless of page type, and both vector export and dragging in an image work in an ordinary document.

title_zh: 学代谢要抓的四个参数：底物产物、能量、酶名、调控
title_en: Four things to record for every metabolic reaction: substrate/product, energy, enzyme name, regulation

points.zh: 前面核酸那一章不算难，所以这节课省下时间直接进入糖酵解正题。
points.en: The nucleic acid chapter was not hard, so time is saved there and the lecture goes straight into glycolysis.

points.zh: 老师先立框架：糖酵解、三羧酸循环、脂质代谢、核酸代谢这些动态生化章节里，每个化学反应都有几个必须记的参数。
points.en: He sets a framework first: in the dynamic chapters — glycolysis, TCA, lipid and nucleotide metabolism — every reaction has a few parameters you must record.

points.zh: 第一位是底物和产物是什么；在糖酵解和三羧酸循环里连结构都要记住。
points.en: First, what the substrate and product are; in glycolysis and the TCA cycle even their structures must be memorised.

points.zh: 在脂质那一章底物结构相对没那么重要，核酸那一章基本可以不看结构，但仍要知道底物是什么。
points.en: In the lipid chapter the structures matter less, and in the nucleotide chapter hardly at all, though you still need to know what the substrate is.

points.zh: 第二位是这个反应产能还是吸能、能量如何变化。
points.en: Second, whether the reaction releases or consumes energy and how that energy changes.

points.zh: 他强调整个代谢章说白了就是在讨论化学能怎么变成生物可用的能量，所以能量最值得关注。
points.en: He stresses that the whole of metabolism is really a discussion of how chemical energy becomes biologically usable energy, so energy is what to watch.

points.zh: 第三位是酶的名字，讲课时会顺带给出英文名。
points.en: Third, the name of the enzyme, with the English name given in passing as each step comes up.

points.zh: 他发现酶的英文命名很有规律：只要知道底物的结构，酶名基本能猜个七七八八。
points.en: He points out that the English names follow a pattern: once you know the substrate, you can guess most enzyme names.

points.zh: 第四位是调控——正向还是逆向、被抑制还是被激活；这一点只在糖代谢里非常重要，在脂质和核酸代谢里非常不重要，所以本节课和下节课会着重讲。
points.en: Fourth, regulation — forward or reverse, inhibited or activated. This matters enormously in sugar metabolism and hardly at all in lipid or nucleotide metabolism, so it is emphasised in this lecture and the next.

extra.zh: 酶名规律的实例：底物 + 反应类型 + -ase。hexokinase = hexose（己糖）+ kinase（ATP 依赖的磷酰基转移）；phosphofructokinase-1 = 对已带磷酸的果糖再磷酸化；phosphoglucose isomerase = 异构化；aldolase 来自 aldol（羟醛）裂解；enolase = 生成烯醇。反过来记：底物结构一确定，酶名基本就定了。
extra.en: How the naming actually works: substrate + reaction type + -ase. Hexokinase = hexose plus a kinase (ATP-dependent phosphoryl transfer); phosphofructokinase-1 phosphorylates an already-phosphorylated fructose; phosphoglucose isomerase isomerises; aldolase is named for the aldol cleavage; enolase makes an enol. Fix the substrate and the name almost follows.

extra.zh: “产能还是耗能”必须分清标准态 ΔG°′ 和细胞内实际 ΔG。糖酵解中 ΔG°′ 为正的步骤有醛缩酶 +23.8、磷酸丙糖异构酶 +7.5、磷酸甘油酸变位酶 +4.4、烯醇化酶 +1.8 kJ/mol；但细胞内产物被下游不断抽走，这几步的实际 ΔG 仍然 ≤ 0，通路照样往前走。
extra.en: Distinguish standard-state ΔG°′ from the real ΔG inside a cell. Steps with positive ΔG°′ in glycolysis are aldolase +23.8, triose phosphate isomerase +7.5, phosphoglycerate mutase +4.4 and enolase +1.8 kJ/mol; yet because downstream steps keep removing product, their actual cellular ΔG stays at or below zero and flux continues.

extra.zh: “每个反应都要问调控”并不等于每一步都受调控。糖酵解真正的调控点是三个不可逆步：己糖激酶／葡萄糖激酶、PFK-1（限速步）、丙酮酸激酶；其余七步接近平衡，只是被通量拉着走。
extra.en: Asking about regulation at every step does not mean every step is regulated. The real control points in glycolysis are the three irreversible steps — hexokinase/glucokinase, PFK-1 (the rate-limiting step) and pyruvate kinase; the other seven sit near equilibrium and are simply dragged along by flux.

extra.zh: 第四个参数最漂亮的例子是果糖-2,6-二磷酸（F-2,6-BP）：它根本不是糖酵解的中间体，而是双功能酶 PFK-2/FBPase-2 生成的调节分子，是 PFK-1 最强的别构激活剂，同时抑制糖异生的 FBPase-1。胰高血糖素经 PKA 磷酸化该双功能酶使 F-2,6-BP 下降，于是糖酵解关、糖异生开。
extra.en: The most elegant example of this fourth parameter is fructose-2,6-bisphosphate: not a pathway intermediate at all, but a regulator made by the bifunctional enzyme PFK-2/FBPase-2. It is the strongest allosteric activator of PFK-1 and simultaneously inhibits gluconeogenic FBPase-1. Glucagon, via PKA phosphorylation of that bifunctional enzyme, lowers it, switching glycolysis off and gluconeogenesis on.

quiz.q_zh: 按老师的排序，哪一项在糖代谢里非常重要、而在脂质和核酸代谢里并不重要？
quiz.q_en: Which parameter did he say matters greatly in sugar metabolism but hardly at all in lipid and nucleotide metabolism?

options.zh: 每一步反应是被激活还是被抑制
options.en: Whether each step is activated or inhibited

options.zh: 每一步的底物和产物分别是什么
options.en: What the substrate and product of each step are

options.zh: 催化每一步反应的酶叫什么名字
options.en: What the enzyme catalysing each step is called

options.zh: 每一步反应是产能还是消耗能量
options.en: Whether each step releases or consumes energy

quiz.explain_zh: 老师明说调控这一项只在糖代谢里着重讲，在脂质和核酸代谢那两章“非常不重要”。底物与产物、能量变化、酶名这三项他要求各章都要记，只是重要性依次递减，并没有说在别的章节可以不管。
quiz.explain_en: He states plainly that regulation is emphasised only for sugar metabolism and is unimportant in the lipid and nucleotide chapters. Substrate and product, energy change and enzyme name are all required throughout, merely in descending order of importance.

quiz.q_zh: 关于糖酵解各步“到底是产能还是耗能”，下列说法正确的是？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about energy in the individual steps of glycolysis is correct?

options.zh: 醛缩酶那一步 ΔG°′ 为正，靠产物被抽走进行
options.en: The aldolase step has a positive ΔG°′, pulled by product

options.zh: 醛缩酶那一步 ΔG°′ 为负，靠底物堆积推动
options.en: The aldolase step has a negative ΔG°′, pushed by substrate

options.zh: 细胞内实际 ΔG 只由标准态决定，与浓度无关
options.en: The real ΔG in a cell is set by standard state alone

options.zh: 糖酵解每一步的 ΔG°′ 都是负值，全程都自发
options.en: Every glycolytic step has a negative ΔG°′ and is spontaneous

quiz.explain_zh: 醛缩酶步 ΔG°′ ≈ +23.8 kJ/mol，磷酸丙糖异构酶、变位酶、烯醇化酶也为正，但下游不断消耗 GAP，使这些步骤在细胞内的实际 ΔG ≤ 0。实际 ΔG = ΔG°′ + RTlnQ，必然依赖浓度；说每一步 ΔG°′ 都为负与上述正值直接矛盾；靠底物堆积推动醛缩酶步也不符合细胞内的真实情况。
quiz.explain_en: Aldolase has ΔG°′ around +23.8 kJ/mol, as do triose phosphate isomerase, the mutase and enolase, yet continuous downstream consumption of GAP keeps their actual cellular ΔG at or below zero. Real ΔG = ΔG°′ + RTlnQ and so must depend on concentrations; claiming every step has a negative ΔG°′ contradicts those positive values; and it is product removal, not substrate accumulation, that drives the aldolase step.

quiz.q_zh: hexokinase 这个名字本身直接告诉你什么？
quiz.q_en: What does the name hexokinase itself tell you directly?

options.zh: 底物是己糖，反应是氧化脱氢
options.en: A hexose substrate and a dehydrogenation

options.zh: 底物是戊糖，反应是磷酰基转移
options.en: A pentose substrate and a phosphoryl transfer

options.zh: 底物是己糖，反应是磷酰基转移
options.en: A hexose substrate and a phosphoryl transfer

options.zh: 底物是己糖，反应是醛酮异构
options.en: A hexose substrate and an aldose-ketose shift

quiz.explain_zh: hexo- 指己糖底物，-kinase 指 ATP 依赖的磷酰基转移，合起来就是把己糖磷酸化成 6-磷酸葡萄糖。脱氢由 dehydrogenase 承担（如 GAPDH），醛酮异构由 isomerase 承担（如磷酸葡糖异构酶），以戊糖为底物的激酶会叫 ribokinase 一类。
quiz.explain_en: Hexo- names a hexose substrate and -kinase an ATP-dependent phosphoryl transfer, together giving phosphorylation of a hexose to glucose-6-phosphate. Dehydrogenation belongs to a dehydrogenase such as GAPDH, aldose-ketose interconversion to an isomerase such as phosphoglucose isomerase, and a pentose-using kinase would be named ribokinase or similar.

title_zh: EMP 这个别名，以及糖酵解与三羧酸循环的分布
title_en: The name EMP, and how widely glycolysis and the TCA cycle are distributed

points.zh: 糖酵解有时被称作 EMP 途径，这是它的一个别称。
points.en: Glycolysis is sometimes called the EMP pathway, an alternative name for the same route.

points.zh: 老师说 EMP 这个叫法大概来自微生物学，具体英文缩写他当场想不起来，让学生现场查。
points.en: He says the name comes out of microbiology but cannot recall what the letters stand for and asks the student to look it up.

points.zh: 他推测 EMP 是与微生物里另一条比较相似的糖类代谢途径相对应而得名的。
points.en: He guesses it is named in contrast with another, rather similar sugar pathway found in microbes.

points.zh: 看到查出来的结果后他猜 EMP 可能是人名，说中文名不重要，知道 EMP 就是糖酵解即可。
points.en: Seeing the search result he guesses these are personal names, and says the Chinese rendering does not matter as long as you know EMP means glycolysis.

points.zh: 糖酵解在现代植物、动物、微生物里基本都广泛存在。
points.en: Glycolysis is essentially universal in modern plants, animals and microbes.

points.zh: 他特意强调“现代”，提到很多古菌、一些古老类群，但话说到一半就转去讲 EMP 的命名，结论没给完。
points.en: He stresses the word modern and starts on archaea and other ancient groups, but breaks off into the naming question and never finishes the thought.

points.zh: 不同生物体内的糖酵解途径大体相似，都以相同的方式消化葡萄糖。
points.en: The pathway is broadly the same across organisms, all digesting glucose in the same manner.

points.zh: 他随后说三羧酸循环则不是一种普遍的产能方式，“只在人类以及少数高等动物里边才会有”，把糖酵解定位为普适通用、TCA 不是。
points.en: He then says the TCA cycle is not a widespread way of making energy and exists "only in humans and a few higher animals", casting glycolysis as universal and the TCA cycle as not.

extra.zh: EMP = Embden–Meyerhof–Parnas，来自三位科学家的姓：Gustav Embden、Otto Meyerhof、Jakub Karol Parnas——老师当场猜“可能是人名”，猜对了。与之对应的那条微生物途径就是 ED 途径（Entner–Doudoroff），此外还有磷酸戊糖途径，三条路常放在一起比较。
extra.en: EMP stands for Embden–Meyerhof–Parnas, the surnames of Gustav Embden, Otto Meyerhof and Jakub Karol Parnas — his guess that they were personal names was right. The contrasting microbial route he was reaching for is the Entner–Doudoroff pathway, usually compared alongside the pentose phosphate pathway.

extra.zh: 他说“三羧酸循环只在人类以及少数高等动物里才有”（约 09:01），这是明确的错误，本讲中他没有自我更正。实际上 TCA 和糖酵解一样近乎普遍存在：绝大多数好氧细菌、古菌、真菌、植物和动物都有完整循环（真核在线粒体基质，细菌在细胞质）；部分严格厌氧菌和少数寄生菌只保留分支型（不闭合）的 TCA，用来供应 α-酮戊二酸、琥珀酰-CoA 等生物合成前体，而不是完全没有这些酶。
extra.en: His claim that the TCA cycle exists "only in humans and a few higher animals" (around 09:01) is simply wrong, and he does not correct it later in this lecture. The cycle is nearly as universal as glycolysis: most aerobic bacteria, archaea, fungi, plants and animals run a complete cycle (in the mitochondrial matrix in eukaryotes, in the cytoplasm in bacteria). Some strict anaerobes and a few parasites keep only a branched, open TCA that supplies biosynthetic precursors such as alpha-ketoglutarate and succinyl-CoA — they are not simply missing the enzymes.

extra.zh: 他关于“现代生物”那句话没说完。EMP 型糖酵解是已知最古老、最保守的代谢途径之一；古菌确实使用改良版——半磷酸化或非磷酸化的 Entner–Doudoroff 途径、ADP 依赖的己糖激酶、ATP 净收益为零的酵解变体——但那是同一条途径的变体，不能理解成“古菌没有糖酵解”。
extra.en: The unfinished sentence about "modern" organisms: EMP-type glycolysis is among the oldest and most conserved pathways known. Archaea do use modified versions — semi-phosphorylative or non-phosphorylative Entner–Doudoroff routes, ADP-dependent hexokinases, glycolytic variants with no net ATP gain — but these are variants of the same pathway, not an absence of glycolysis.

extra.zh: 需要氧的是电子传递链和氧化磷酸化，不是 TCA 的酶本身。厌氧菌缺的是末端电子受体，所以把循环开成分支型、用于合成而非产能；这也是为什么“无氧就没有 TCA”这种说法在细菌里并不成立。
extra.en: It is the electron transport chain and oxidative phosphorylation that need oxygen, not the TCA enzymes themselves. Anaerobes lack a terminal electron acceptor, so they run the cycle open and branched, for biosynthesis rather than energy — which is why "no oxygen, no TCA" does not hold in bacteria.

quiz.q_zh: 糖酵解的别名 EMP 途径中，EMP 指的是什么？
quiz.q_en: In the alternative name EMP pathway, what does EMP stand for?

options.zh: extramitochondrial phosphate 的缩写
options.en: Short for extramitochondrial phosphate use

options.zh: Entner、Doudoroff、Parnas 三人的姓氏
options.en: The surnames Entner, Doudoroff and Parnas

options.zh: Embden、Meyerhof、Parnas 三人的姓氏
options.en: The surnames Embden, Meyerhof and Parnas

options.zh: embryonic metabolic pathway 的缩写
options.en: Short for the embryonic metabolic pathway

quiz.explain_zh: EMP 由 Gustav Embden、Otto Meyerhof、Jakub Karol Parnas 三人得名，老师当场猜“可能是人名”正好猜对。Entner 和 Doudoroff 命名的是另一条独立的细菌糖代谢途径 ED，常与 EMP 并列比较，两组人名不能混；胚胎代谢途径和线粒体外磷酸化两种解释都不存在。
quiz.explain_en: EMP honours Gustav Embden, Otto Meyerhof and Jakub Karol Parnas, so his hunch that they were people's names was correct. Entner and Doudoroff name a different bacterial route, abbreviated ED and often compared with EMP, so the two sets of names must not be mixed; neither an embryonic pathway nor extramitochondrial phosphate is a real expansion.

quiz.q_zh: 三羧酸循环在生物界的分布，正确的说法是？
quiz.q_en: How is the TCA cycle actually distributed across living organisms?

options.zh: 只有真核生物才有，所有原核生物都没有
options.en: Only eukaryotes have it and no prokaryote does

options.zh: 多数好氧细菌、真菌、植物和动物都有
options.en: Most aerobic bacteria, fungi, plants and animals

options.zh: 只有严格厌氧菌保留完整循环用于产能
options.en: Only strict anaerobes keep it, and for energy

options.zh: 只有人类和少数高等动物才具备完整循环
options.en: Only humans and a few higher animals run it fully

quiz.explain_zh: 老师课上说 TCA“只在人类以及少数高等动物里才有”，这一点是错的：TCA 与糖酵解一样近乎普遍，真核生物在线粒体基质、细菌在细胞质里运行完整循环。恰恰相反的是，严格厌氧菌通常只保留分支型（不闭合）循环，用于供应 α-酮戊二酸、琥珀酰-CoA 等前体而非产能；把它限定在真核生物同样不成立。
quiz.explain_en: His in-class statement that the cycle exists only in humans and a few higher animals is wrong: it is nearly as universal as glycolysis, running in the mitochondrial matrix in eukaryotes and in the cytoplasm in bacteria. Strict anaerobes are in fact the group that keeps only a branched, open cycle, and they use it for precursors such as alpha-ketoglutarate and succinyl-CoA rather than for energy; restricting it to eukaryotes fails for the same reason.

quiz.q_zh: 老师提到古菌却没把话说完，古菌在糖酵解上的实际情况是？
quiz.q_en: He raised archaea but never finished the point: what is actually true of glycolysis in archaea?

options.zh: 古菌走的是与人类完全相同的经典 EMP 途径
options.en: Archaea run exactly the classical EMP route we do

options.zh: 古菌用磷酸戊糖途径完全替代了糖的分解
options.en: Archaea replace sugar breakdown with the pentose route

options.zh: 古菌走的是改良版，如非磷酸化的 ED 途径
options.en: Archaea use variants such as non-phosphorylative ED

options.zh: 古菌完全没有糖分解途径，只能利用氨基酸
options.en: Archaea lack sugar catabolism and live on amino acids

quiz.explain_zh: EMP 型糖酵解是最古老最保守的途径之一，古菌使用的是它的改良版：半磷酸化或非磷酸化的 Entner–Doudoroff 途径、ADP 依赖的己糖激酶、ATP 净收益为零的酵解变体。所以既不是“完全没有”，也不是“与人类完全相同”；磷酸戊糖途径的主职是产 NADPH 和核糖-5-磷酸，不承担糖的完全分解。
quiz.explain_en: EMP-type glycolysis is among the oldest and most conserved pathways, and archaea run modified versions of it: semi-phosphorylative or non-phosphorylative Entner-Doudoroff routes, ADP-dependent hexokinases, and variants with no net ATP. So neither absence nor identity with the human pathway is right, and the pentose phosphate pathway exists to make NADPH and ribose-5-phosphate rather than to degrade sugar completely.

title_zh: 【可跳过·非课程内容】自制网站分享与 localhost 打不开
title_en: [Skippable · not course material] Sharing a home-made website and the localhost problem

points.zh: 老师顺口提到自己做了一个学习用的网站，想给学生看一下。
points.en: He mentions in passing that he has built a study website and wants to show it.

points.zh: 他翻了一下发现网站里还没有做到糖酵解这一部分。
points.en: Checking it, he finds the glycolysis part has not been built yet.

points.zh: 因为他这台电脑上没有微信，链接被直接发到会议的聊天框里。
points.en: With no WeChat on that computer, the link goes into the meeting chat instead.

points.zh: 链接是一个 localhost 地址，学生打不开。
points.en: The link is a localhost address and the student cannot open it.

points.zh: 老师解释 localhost 指的是他自己那台机器，只有在同一个局域网里才可能互相访问。
points.en: He explains that localhost means his own machine, reachable only from inside the same local network.

points.zh: 要让外部访问需要一个真正的域名或公网地址，他说回头再研究、之后再发。
points.en: Outside access would need a real domain or public address; he says he will work it out and send it later.

points.zh: 两人短暂讨论了网站界面的语言是捷克语。
points.en: They briefly discuss the site's interface being in Czech.

points.zh: 随后老师说“我们接着讲糖酵解途径”，回到正题。
points.en: He then says they will get back to the glycolytic pathway and resumes the lecture.

extra.zh: localhost 与 127.0.0.1 是回环地址，永远指向“发出请求的那台机器”，所以别人点开只会连到自己电脑。要共享：同一局域网可用主机的内网 IP 加端口（如 192.168.x.x:8000），跨网需要端口转发或 ngrok、Cloudflare Tunnel 这类隧道，或者直接部署到服务器。
extra.en: localhost and 127.0.0.1 are loopback addresses that always point at whichever machine makes the request, so anyone else opening the link just reaches their own computer. To share it: on the same LAN use the host's private IP and port (e.g. 192.168.x.x:8000); across networks you need port forwarding, a tunnel such as ngrok or Cloudflare Tunnel, or a real deployment.

extra.zh: 这一段没有任何考点，网站本身也还没做到糖酵解，复习时直接跳到 11:09 前后继续即可。
extra.en: Nothing here is examinable and the site did not yet cover glycolysis; on review, skip ahead to around 11:09.

extra.zh: 学习工具（网站、ChemDraw、各种图谱 app）不是考点本身。考试考的是能默画中间体结构、写出酶名与调控关系；工具只决定你复习的效率，不决定你的得分。
extra.en: Study tools — websites, ChemDraw, pathway apps — are not themselves the material. What is examined is drawing the intermediates from memory and naming the enzymes and their regulation; tools change how fast you revise, not what you are scored on.

quiz.q_zh: 学生打不开老师发来的 localhost 链接，根本原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: Why could the student not open the localhost link the teacher sent?

options.zh: localhost 始终指向打开链接的那台电脑
options.en: localhost always points at the machine opening it

options.zh: localhost 链接必须用管理员权限才能打开
options.en: A localhost link needs administrator rights to open

options.zh: localhost 只能在浏览器的隐私模式下解析
options.en: localhost resolves only in a private browsing window

options.zh: localhost 链接过期以后会自动失效不可用
options.en: A localhost link expires and stops working later

quiz.explain_zh: localhost/127.0.0.1 是回环地址，谁点开就指向谁自己的机器，所以学生连的其实是他自己的电脑。这与权限无关，浏览器的隐私模式也不改变地址解析，回环地址更不存在有效期。要共享得用内网 IP、隧道服务或部署到公网。
quiz.explain_en: localhost and 127.0.0.1 are loopback addresses pointing at whoever opens them, so the student's browser was reaching his own machine. Permissions are irrelevant, private browsing does not change address resolution, and a loopback address has no expiry; sharing requires a LAN IP, a tunnel or a real deployment.

quiz.q_zh: 闲聊结束后老师回到正题，他给糖酵解定的最终产物是什么？
quiz.q_en: Returning to the lecture after the digression, what did he give as the end product of glycolysis?

options.zh: 草酰乙酸，与乙酰 CoA 缩合成柠檬酸
options.en: Oxaloacetate, condensing to give citrate

options.zh: 乙酰 CoA，随后直接进入三羧酸循环
options.en: Acetyl-CoA, which then enters the TCA cycle

options.zh: 丙酮酸，一般被视为糖酵解的终点
options.en: Pyruvate, the accepted end of the pathway

options.zh: 乳酸，由乳酸脱氢酶在胞质中生成
options.en: Lactate, made by lactate dehydrogenase

quiz.explain_zh: 他明确说底物是葡萄糖、最终产物是丙酮酸，一般把丙酮酸当作糖酵解的终点。乙酰 CoA 由丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体在线粒体基质中生成，已经在糖酵解之后；乳酸是无氧条件下的分支产物；草酰乙酸是三羧酸循环的中间物。
quiz.explain_en: He states that the substrate is glucose and the final product pyruvate, generally treated as the end of the pathway. Acetyl-CoA is made afterwards by the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex in the mitochondrial matrix, lactate is an anaerobic branch product, and oxaloacetate is a TCA intermediate.

title_zh: 糖酵解的定位：葡萄糖到丙酮酸，与磷酸戊糖途径的关系
title_en: What glycolysis is for: glucose to pyruvate, and its link to the pentose phosphate pathway

points.zh: 整章里 glucose 一律代指葡萄糖，有时缩写成 GLC。
points.en: Throughout the chapter glucose is written out or abbreviated GLC.

points.zh: 糖酵解的整个过程是把葡萄糖氧化——老师说也可以理解为分解——为丙酮酸，并产生 ATP。
points.en: The pathway oxidises glucose — he says you can read it as breaking it down — to pyruvate, producing ATP.

points.zh: 首要的一点：底物是葡萄糖，最终产物是丙酮酸，一般把丙酮酸当作糖酵解的终点。
points.en: Key point one: the substrate is glucose, the final product pyruvate, and pyruvate is conventionally the end of glycolysis.

points.zh: 有一些糖可以借助糖酵解的一部分步骤走进别的代谢途径。
points.en: Some sugars use part of the glycolytic route to feed into other pathways.

points.zh: 老师说磷酸戊糖途径会“借用糖酵解的前几步”，拿这几步的产物去走它自己的代谢途径。
points.en: He says the pentose phosphate pathway "borrows the first few steps" of glycolysis and uses their products for its own route.

points.zh: 因此他说糖酵解在一定程度上参与了一小部分磷酸戊糖途径，后面会稍微带过。
points.en: So glycolysis, he says, participates to some degree in the pentose phosphate pathway, to be touched on later.

points.zh: 磷酸戊糖途径的主要作用被概括为把糖类转化为五碳糖：吃进去的六碳糖有一小部分被转成五碳糖，五碳糖用来构筑核酸。
points.en: He summarises that pathway as converting sugars into pentoses: a small fraction of ingested hexose becomes pentose, which is used to build nucleic acids.

points.zh: 进入正式步骤之前先讲磷酸：整章会一直穿插这个很重要的生化小分子。
points.en: Before the steps themselves he introduces phosphate, the small molecule that threads through the whole chapter.

points.zh: 磷酸最早在蛋白那一章以磷酸化的形式出现，在核酸那一章广泛遇到；它带一到两个负电荷，在核酸里靠负电荷与氯化钠这类盐形成盐桥，帮助核酸溶解。
points.en: Phosphate first appeared as protein phosphorylation and then throughout the nucleic acid chapter; it carries one to two negative charges and, in nucleic acids, forms salt bridges with ions such as those of sodium chloride, aiding solubility.

extra.zh: PPP 与糖酵解的接口要说准：氧化分支从糖酵解第一步的产物 G6P 分出（因此只共用己糖激酶那一步），经 G6PDH 和 6-磷酸葡糖酸脱氢酶产 NADPH 与核酮糖-5-磷酸；非氧化分支再由转酮酶、转醛酶把碳骨架以 F6P 和 3-磷酸甘油醛的形式还回糖酵解。说“借用前几步”方向大体对，但容易让人误以为两条路共享好几步酶促反应。
extra.en: State the interface precisely: the oxidative branch leaves from G6P, the product of the first glycolytic step, so only the hexokinase step is shared; G6PDH and 6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase then make NADPH and ribulose-5-phosphate. The non-oxidative branch, via transketolase and transaldolase, returns carbon to glycolysis as F6P and glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate. "Borrowing the first few steps" points the right way but wrongly suggests several shared enzymatic steps.

extra.zh: PPP 有两个同等重要的产物，老师只提了五碳糖那一半。另一半是 NADPH：用于脂肪酸和胆固醇的还原性合成，以及还原型谷胱甘肽的再生（红细胞抗氧化的唯一来源，G6PD 缺乏症导致溶血正源于此）。
extra.en: The pentose phosphate pathway has two equally important outputs and he named only one. The other is NADPH, used for reductive synthesis of fatty acids and cholesterol and for regenerating reduced glutathione — the sole source in red cells, which is why G6PD deficiency causes haemolysis.

extra.zh: 把终点数清楚：1 葡萄糖 → 2 丙酮酸 + 2 ATP（净）+ 2 NADH。丙酮酸随后是一个三岔口——有氧时经丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体变乙酰 CoA 进 TCA；无氧时在动物里由 LDH 变乳酸、在酵母里经脱羧和乙醇脱氢酶变乙醇加 CO2；此外还可经丙酮酸羧化酶变草酰乙酸进入糖异生。
extra.en: Count the end point exactly: one glucose gives 2 pyruvate, a net 2 ATP and 2 NADH. Pyruvate then sits at a three-way junction — aerobically to acetyl-CoA via the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex and into the TCA cycle; anaerobically to lactate via LDH in animals or to ethanol plus CO2 in yeast; and to oxaloacetate via pyruvate carboxylase for gluconeogenesis.

extra.zh: 老师说磷酸“带一到两个负电荷”的化学依据是电离常数：H2PO4⁻ ⇌ HPO4²⁻ 的 pKa2 ≈ 6.86，正好落在生理 pH 附近，所以细胞里两种形态共存，磷酸也因此成为细胞内主要的缓冲对之一。完全三价的 PO4³⁻ 要 pH 高于 12（pKa3 ≈ 12.3）才显著存在。
extra.en: The chemistry behind "one to two negative charges": the H2PO4- to HPO4 2- equilibrium has a pKa2 of about 6.86, right at physiological pH, so both species coexist in the cell — which also makes phosphate a major intracellular buffer. Fully trivalent PO4 3- requires pH above 12 (pKa3 about 12.3).

quiz.q_zh: 磷酸戊糖途径与糖酵解的连接方式，准确的描述是？
quiz.q_en: How is the pentose phosphate pathway actually connected to glycolysis?

options.zh: 从糖酵解第一步的产物 G6P 分出氧化分支
options.en: Its oxidative branch leaves glycolysis at G6P

options.zh: 与糖酵解完全独立，两条路不共用中间物
options.en: It is fully separate, sharing no intermediate

options.zh: 从糖酵解的丙酮酸分出，向上重建六碳糖
options.en: It branches from pyruvate, rebuilding hexoses

options.zh: 从果糖-1,6-二磷酸分出，共用醛缩酶一步
options.en: It branches at fructose-1,6-bisphosphate

quiz.explain_zh: PPP 的氧化分支从 G6P 起步，所以与糖酵解只共用己糖激酶那一步；非氧化分支再把碳骨架以 F6P 和 3-磷酸甘油醛的形式还回糖酵解。老师说“借用前几步”方向对但偏松：它既不从丙酮酸分出，也不在果糖-1,6-二磷酸处分叉，更不是与糖酵解毫无交集。
quiz.explain_en: The oxidative branch starts at G6P, so only the hexokinase step is shared, and the non-oxidative branch returns carbon to glycolysis as F6P and glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate. His "borrows the first few steps" points the right way but is loose: the branch is not at pyruvate, not at fructose-1,6-bisphosphate, and certainly not absent.

quiz.q_zh: 磷酸戊糖途径除了五碳糖，另一个同等重要的产物是什么？
quiz.q_en: Besides pentose sugars, what is the other equally important product of that pathway?

options.zh: GTP，由底物水平磷酸化直接产生能量
options.en: GTP, made by substrate-level phosphorylation

options.zh: NADPH，用于还原性生物合成与抗氧化
options.en: NADPH, for reductive synthesis and defence

options.zh: NADH，直接进入电子传递链合成 ATP
options.en: NADH, feeding the chain to make ATP directly

options.zh: FADH2，用于琥珀酸脱氢酶那一步反应
options.en: FADH2, used at the succinate dehydrogenase step

quiz.explain_zh: 氧化分支的两步脱氢（G6PDH 与 6-磷酸葡糖酸脱氢酶）各产一分子 NADPH，用于脂肪酸和胆固醇合成以及谷胱甘肽还原。NADH 来自糖酵解的 GAPDH 和三羧酸循环，FADH2 来自琥珀酸脱氢酶，GTP 来自琥珀酰-CoA 合成酶，都不是磷酸戊糖途径的产物。
quiz.explain_en: The two dehydrogenation steps of the oxidative branch, G6PDH and 6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase, each yield NADPH, used for fatty acid and cholesterol synthesis and glutathione reduction. NADH comes from glycolytic GAPDH and the TCA cycle, FADH2 from succinate dehydrogenase and GTP from succinyl-CoA synthetase — none of them from this pathway.

quiz.q_zh: 老师说磷酸基团“带一个到两个负电荷”，其化学依据是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the chemical basis for his statement that phosphate carries one to two negative charges?

options.zh: 磷酸的负电荷要等 Mg²⁺ 解离之后出现
options.en: Its charge appears once bound Mg2+ leaves

options.zh: 磷酸在细胞内只以三价 PO4³⁻ 形式存在
options.en: Phosphate stays fully as PO4 3- in the cell

options.zh: 磷酸只在 pH 低于 3 时才电离出负电荷
options.en: Phosphate ionises only in an acidic solution

options.zh: 磷酸 pKa2 约 6.86，接近生理 pH
options.en: Its pKa2 near 6.86 sits close to cell pH

quiz.explain_zh: H2PO4⁻ 与 HPO4²⁻ 的 pKa2 ≈ 6.86，生理 pH 7.4 附近两种形态共存，对应一个和两个负电荷，这也让磷酸成为细胞内重要缓冲对。完全三价需要 pH 高于 12（pKa3 ≈ 12.3）；电离与是否结合镁离子无关；pH 越高电离越充分，pH 低于 3 时反而以中性的 H3PO4 为主（pKa1 ≈ 2.15），所以“只在强酸下电离”正好说反了。
quiz.explain_en: The H2PO4- / HPO4 2- pKa2 of about 6.86 means both species coexist near pH 7.4, giving one and two negative charges, and also makes phosphate an important intracellular buffer. The fully trivalent form needs pH above 12 (pKa3 about 12.3); ionisation has nothing to do with magnesium binding; and phosphate ionises more, not less, as pH rises — below pH 3 it is mostly neutral H3PO4 (pKa1 about 2.15), the opposite of the acid-only claim.

title_zh: 磷酸基团的三个作用：电荷与“上锁”、识别信号、储能
title_en: Three jobs of the phosphate group: charge and trapping, recognition signal, energy storage

points.zh: 他明确这里讨论的不再是核酸那章的盐桥作用，而是磷酸的电荷作用。
points.en: He flags that the topic now is not the salt bridges of the nucleic acid chapter but the charge itself.

points.zh: 带负电的磷酸接到一个电中性的小分子上，就让这个小分子带上了负电荷。
points.en: Attaching negatively charged phosphate to an electrically neutral small molecule makes that molecule negative.

points.zh: 带上负电荷之后，这个分子就不容易透过细胞膜。
points.en: Once negatively charged, the molecule no longer crosses the membrane easily.

points.zh: 他先说“磷酸使 ATP 比较容易透膜”，随即当场自我更正：说错了，是镁离子（约 13:45）。
points.en: He first says phosphate makes ATP cross the membrane easily, then corrects himself on the spot: he misspoke, it is magnesium (around 13:45).

points.zh: 更正后的说法是：镁离子带两个正电荷，中和 ATP 上磷酸的负电荷，使 ATP 偏中性，因而更容易透过脂质双分子层。
points.en: The corrected version: magnesium carries two positive charges, neutralises the phosphate charges on ATP, and so makes ATP more nearly neutral and easier to cross the lipid bilayer.

points.zh: 反过来，一个中性分子结合磷酸后带负电，更不容易透膜；他说这与糖酵解以及线粒体里的三羧酸循环关系密切。
points.en: Conversely a neutral molecule that picks up phosphate becomes negative and less able to cross, which he ties closely to glycolysis and to the TCA cycle in mitochondria.

points.zh: 他给出的化学理由是浓度：要让反应顺利正向进行，需要底物浓度尽可能高、产物浓度尽可能低。
points.en: His chemical reasoning is concentration: to drive a reaction forward you want substrate as high and product as low as possible.

points.zh: 所以磷酸的作用之一是让底物在局部浓度升高——一个东西磷酸化后透不过膜，就被牢牢困住；他此处说的是“困在线粒体的磷脂双分子层里边”。
points.en: So phosphate's first job is raising local substrate concentration: once phosphorylated a compound cannot cross and is trapped — though here he says trapped "inside the mitochondrial lipid bilayer".

points.zh: 作用之二是充当信号基团：一些酶进化出带正电荷的氨基酸来吸引带负电的磷酸，这就是酶那一章讲过的邻近效应，同样是提高底物的局部浓度；作用之三是保存能量，后面会反复见到高能磷酸键。
points.en: Second, phosphate acts as a recognition signal: enzymes evolve positively charged residues that attract it, the proximity effect from the enzyme chapter, again concentrating substrate locally. Third, it stores energy — the high-energy phosphate bonds seen repeatedly from here on.

extra.zh: 他说磷酸化后的分子“被牢牢困在线粒体的磷脂双分子层里边”（约 15:23）。他上一句讲的其实正是经典逻辑：葡萄糖被磷酸化成 G6P 后带负电，透不过质膜、也不再是 GLUT 的底物，于是被锁在细胞质里出不去细胞——这正是己糖激酶第一步的意义（“上锁”）。这与线粒体无关，线粒体内膜上也没有 G6P 的自由通道。做笔记时应改成细胞膜／细胞质。
extra.en: He says a phosphorylated compound is "firmly trapped inside the mitochondrial lipid bilayer" (around 15:23). The logic he was actually describing is the classic one: phosphorylation to G6P adds negative charge, so the molecule can neither cross the plasma membrane nor be carried by GLUT, and is locked in the cytosol — the whole point of the hexokinase step. This has nothing to do with mitochondria, whose inner membrane has no free G6P channel either. Note it as plasma membrane and cytosol.

extra.zh: 镁离子那一句他已经自我更正（13:45 说“这里说错，是镁离子”），不必再当错误记；但更正后的说法本身仍不准确：即使螯合了 Mg²⁺，ATP 的净电荷仍为负（MgATP²⁻），不能自由扩散过磷脂双分子层，线粒体内外的 ATP/ADP 交换靠腺苷酸转位酶 ANT（SLC25A4）等载体完成。Mg²⁺ 的真实意义是屏蔽磷酸负电荷、稳定过渡态，是几乎所有激酶的必需辅因子。另外他说“镁离子带有两个分子的正电荷”，应为两个单位正电荷。
extra.en: He already fixed the magnesium slip himself at 13:45, so do not card it again; but the corrected statement is still not accurate. Even chelated to Mg2+, ATP remains anionic (MgATP2-) and does not diffuse freely across a bilayer; mitochondrial ATP/ADP exchange is done by carriers such as the adenine nucleotide translocase (SLC25A4). What magnesium really does is shield the phosphate charges and stabilise the transition state, and it is an obligatory cofactor for essentially every kinase. Also, "two molecules of positive charge" should be two units of positive charge.

extra.zh: 给“高能磷酸键”配上数字（磷酰基转移势，ΔG°′ 水解值）：PEP ≈ −61.9、1,3-二磷酸甘油酸 ≈ −49.3、磷酸肌酸 ≈ −43.0、ATP → ADP + Pi ≈ −30.5、而 G6P 只有 ≈ −13.8 kJ/mol。糖酵解能在 PGK 和 PK 两步把磷酸转给 ADP 生成 ATP，正是因为 1,3-BPG 和 PEP 的转移势高于 ATP；反过来 G6P 低于 ATP，所以己糖激酶那一步不可逆。
extra.en: Numbers for the high-energy phosphates (phosphoryl transfer potential, ΔG°′ of hydrolysis): PEP about -61.9, 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate about -49.3, phosphocreatine about -43.0, ATP to ADP plus Pi about -30.5, and G6P only about -13.8 kJ/mol. Glycolysis can hand phosphate to ADP at PGK and PK precisely because 1,3-BPG and PEP outrank ATP; G6P ranks below it, which is why the hexokinase step is irreversible.

extra.zh: “高能磷酸键”不是说这根键本身特别强、里面存着能量——恰恰相反，键能高意味着难断。放能来自产物一侧：相邻负电荷分离、无机磷酸的共振稳定与更好的溶剂化，使水解产物比反应物稳定得多。所以不要说“能量存在键里”，要说“水解产物更稳定”。
extra.en: A high-energy phosphate bond does not mean an unusually strong bond with energy stored inside it — a strong bond would be hard to break. The energy comes from the product side: separation of adjacent negative charges, resonance stabilisation of inorganic phosphate and better solvation make the products far more stable than the reactant. Say the products are more stable, not that energy sits in the bond.

quiz.q_zh: 葡萄糖被磷酸化成 6-磷酸葡萄糖之后，它被“锁”在哪里？为什么？
quiz.q_en: Once glucose is phosphorylated to glucose-6-phosphate, where is it trapped and why?

options.zh: 锁在细胞外，因为磷酸化以后不能被摄取
options.en: Outside the cell; phosphorylation blocks its uptake

options.zh: 锁在线粒体基质，因为内膜没有它的载体
options.en: In the matrix; the inner membrane lacks its carrier

options.zh: 锁在细胞质里，因为带上负电透不过质膜
options.en: In the cytosol; its charge blocks the plasma membrane

options.zh: 锁在内质网腔，因为它与膜上的受体结合
options.en: In the ER lumen; it binds a receptor on that membrane

quiz.explain_zh: 磷酸化让原本电中性的葡萄糖带上负电，既透不过质膜也不再是 GLUT 转运体的底物，于是被锁在细胞质里，这正是己糖激酶第一步的意义。老师此处口误说成“困在线粒体的磷脂双分子层里”（约 15:23）：G6P 与线粒体无关；它也不是被受体扣在内质网腔里；更不会留在细胞外——磷酸化发生在葡萄糖已经进入细胞之后。
quiz.explain_en: Phosphorylation puts a negative charge on a previously neutral molecule, so it can neither cross the plasma membrane nor be carried by GLUT, and it stays in the cytosol — the point of the hexokinase step. His slip here places it "in the mitochondrial bilayer" (around 15:23), which is unrelated; nor is it held by an ER receptor; and it cannot be outside the cell, since phosphorylation happens only after glucose has entered.

quiz.q_zh: 关于镁离子与 ATP 的关系，正确的说法是？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about magnesium and ATP is correct?

options.zh: 镁离子只有在无氧条件下才与 ATP 结合
options.en: Mg2+ binds ATP only under anaerobic conditions

options.zh: 镁离子中和电荷后，ATP 可自由扩散过膜
options.en: Once neutralised by Mg2+, ATP diffuses across freely

options.zh: 镁离子是辅酶，与 NAD⁺、CoA 属同一类
options.en: Mg2+ is a coenzyme, like NAD+ and coenzyme A

options.zh: MgATP²⁻ 带负电，跨膜靠 ANT 载体
options.en: MgATP2- stays anionic; the ANT carrier moves it

quiz.explain_zh: 老师先说“磷酸使 ATP 容易透膜”，13:45 已自我更正为镁离子，这一改是对的；但更正后的说法仍不准：MgATP²⁻ 净电荷为负，不能自由扩散过脂双层，线粒体内外的 ATP/ADP 交换由腺苷酸转位酶 ANT（SLC25A4）完成。Mg²⁺ 属金属离子辅因子而非辅酶（辅酶专指 NAD⁺、FAD、CoA 这类有机小分子），它与 ATP 的螯合也与有氧无氧无关。
quiz.explain_en: He corrected phosphate to magnesium at 13:45, and that much was right; but the corrected claim still fails, because MgATP2- remains anionic and cannot diffuse across a bilayer — mitochondrial ATP/ADP exchange is done by the adenine nucleotide translocase (SLC25A4). Mg2+ is a metal-ion cofactor, not a coenzyme (that term is for organic molecules such as NAD+, FAD and CoA), and its chelation of ATP is unrelated to oxygen availability.

quiz.q_zh: “高能磷酸键”这个说法，正确的理解是什么？
quiz.q_en: How should the term high-energy phosphate bond be understood?

options.zh: 键里储存着一份能量，断开时被直接释放
options.en: Energy is stored inside the bond and let out on breaking

options.zh: 只有 ATP 分子才有高能键，其他分子没有
options.en: Only ATP has such bonds and no other molecule does

options.zh: 水解产物比反应物稳定得多，所以放能大
options.en: The products are far more stable, so much is released

options.zh: 这根共价键的键能特别高，因此很难断开
options.en: That covalent bond is unusually strong and hard to break

quiz.explain_zh: 放能来自产物一侧：相邻负电荷分离、无机磷酸的共振稳定和更好的溶剂化，使产物比反应物稳定得多（ATP 水解 ΔG°′ ≈ −30.5 kJ/mol）。键能高恰恰意味着难断而不是易放能；能量并不是“存在键里”的一包东西；转移势比 ATP 更高的分子有 PEP（≈ −61.9）、1,3-BPG（≈ −49.3）和磷酸肌酸（≈ −43.0 kJ/mol），糖酵解正是靠它们把磷酸转给 ADP。
quiz.explain_en: The energy comes from the product side: separated negative charges, resonance stabilisation of inorganic phosphate and better solvation make products far more stable than the reactant (ATP hydrolysis ΔG°′ about -30.5 kJ/mol). A strong bond would be hard to break, not energy-releasing; energy is not a packet held inside a bond; and molecules with higher transfer potential than ATP include PEP (about -61.9), 1,3-BPG (about -49.3) and phosphocreatine (about -43.0 kJ/mol), which is exactly how glycolysis hands phosphate to ADP.

title_zh: 动手画葡萄糖：六元吡喃环与羟基的固定朝向
title_en: Drawing glucose: the six-membered pyranose ring and the fixed orientation of its hydroxyls

points.zh: 前言讲完，开始一点一点拆解糖酵解，并同步把每一步画出来。
points.en: With the preamble done, the pathway is taken apart step by step and drawn along the way.

points.zh: 先把糖酵解的总图拖进 ChemDraw，缩放到合适大小——以画一个苯环“大概这么大”为参照。
points.en: The overview figure is dragged into ChemDraw and scaled, using the size of a drawn benzene ring as the reference.

points.zh: 糖酵解的第一步是葡萄糖的磷酸化，因为起始底物就是葡萄糖，所以先画葡萄糖。
points.en: Step one of glycolysis is phosphorylation of glucose, so glucose is drawn first as the starting substrate.

points.zh: 葡萄糖用六元环的形式画；用套索（lasso）工具可以选中整个环，把它拖动、放大并摆平。
points.en: Glucose is drawn as a six-membered ring; the lasso tool selects the whole ring so it can be moved, enlarged and laid flat.

points.zh: 他说“我们这个五碳糖其实是一个扁平的六边形”，并规定此后画所有的糖都用这个平面画法。
points.en: He says "this pentose of ours is really a flat hexagon" and sets that flat convention for every sugar drawn from here on.

points.zh: 画法细节：先在环上画一个向上的单键；环上的氧不是打字打出来的，而是从元素周期表面板点氧原子插入。
points.en: Mechanics: draw an upward single bond on the ring, and insert the ring oxygen by clicking the element in the periodic table panel rather than typing it.

points.zh: 然后把第 6 位的亚甲基画出来，并把末端的那个羟基标出来。
points.en: The C6 methylene is then drawn out and its terminal hydroxyl labelled.

points.zh: 其余位置的羟基一律以竖直上下的方式画，因为这里把糖当作一个平面来处理。
points.en: All the other hydroxyls are drawn straight up or down, since the sugar is being treated as a plane.

points.zh: 羟基只需在相应位置点一个 O，软件会自动识别成 OH（显示为红色）；点不到键的位置就只是一个孤立的 O。收尾时他强调：葡萄糖在水溶液里就是六元环形式，羟基的朝向是固定的，朝向一变就是另一种糖，只有左下角那个羟基朝上。
points.en: A hydroxyl is made by clicking a single O at the right position and the software recognises it as OH, shown in red; miss the bond and you get a stray O. He closes by stressing that glucose in aqueous solution is this six-membered ring, that the hydroxyl orientations are fixed, that changing one gives a different sugar, and that only the lower-left hydroxyl points up.

extra.zh: 他把葡萄糖叫成“五碳糖”（约 18:00，本讲后面还会重复，属稳定的口误而非一次口滑，他没有自我更正）。葡萄糖是六碳糖（己糖 hexose，C6H12O6）；它在水中形成的六元环是吡喃糖环（pyranose）——环上是 5 个碳加 1 个氧共 6 个原子，第 6 位碳（CH2OH，正是下一步被磷酸化的那个）在环外。他多半是把“环上有 5 个碳”说成了“五碳糖”。真正的五碳糖（戊糖）是核糖、脱氧核糖那一类，而戊糖成环时形成的是五元的呋喃糖环（4 个碳 + 1 个氧），正好与他画的六边形相反。
extra.en: He calls glucose a pentose (around 18:00, and repeats it later in the lecture, so it is a settled slip rather than a one-off, and he never corrects it). Glucose is a hexose, C6H12O6; the six-membered ring it forms in water is a pyranose — five carbons plus one oxygen, six atoms in the ring, with C6 (the CH2OH that is phosphorylated in the very next step) hanging outside it. He almost certainly turned "five carbons in the ring" into "pentose". True pentoses are ribose and deoxyribose, and when a pentose cyclises it gives a five-membered furanose ring (four carbons plus one oxygen) — the opposite of the hexagon he is drawing.

extra.zh: “水溶液里就是六元环”是对的，而且有数字：水中葡萄糖超过 99% 以吡喃环存在（β 型约 64%、α 型约 36%），开链醛式只占约 0.02%。正因为开链醛基几乎不存在、C1 是受限的半缩醛，第一步磷酸化才发生在环外自由的 C6 羟基上。
extra.en: His claim that it is the ring form in water is right and can be quantified: more than 99% of glucose in water is the pyranose ring (about 64% beta, 36% alpha) and only around 0.02% is the open-chain aldehyde. Because the free aldehyde is essentially absent and C1 is a constrained hemiacetal, the first phosphorylation goes to the free C6 hydroxyl outside the ring.

extra.zh: Haworth 式的“扁平六边形”只是画图约定，不是真实几何。真实的吡喃环是椅式构象（chair）；β-D-葡萄糖之所以是自然界最常见的单糖，一个结构原因就是它的所有大取代基（C1、C2、C3、C4 的 OH 和 C6 的 CH2OH）都能同时处于平伏（equatorial）位，空间位阻最小。老师说的“左下角羟基朝上”按 Haworth 画法对应 C3-OH，其余朝下，画的位置是正确的。
extra.en: The flat Haworth hexagon is a drawing convention, not real geometry. The actual pyranose ring is a chair; part of why beta-D-glucose is the commonest sugar in nature is that all its bulky substituents (the OH groups at C1, C2, C3, C4 and the CH2OH at C6) can sit equatorial at once, minimising strain. His "lower-left hydroxyl points up" corresponds to C3-OH in the Haworth projection, with the rest down — the positions he drew are right.

extra.zh: “羟基朝向一变就是另一种糖”指的正是差向异构体（epimer）：C4-OH 翻转得半乳糖 galactose，C2-OH 翻转得甘露糖 mannose。而 C1（异头碳）翻转只是 α/β 异头物，两者在水中可经开链形式互相转化，这就是变旋（mutarotation）；异头碳的差别在成苷以后才被固定下来，这也是麦芽糖（α-1,4）与纤维二糖（β-1,4）性质天差地别的根源。
extra.en: "Change an orientation and it is a different sugar" is exactly the definition of an epimer: invert C4-OH and you get galactose, invert C2-OH and you get mannose. Inverting C1, the anomeric carbon, only gives the alpha or beta anomer, and the two interconvert in water through the open chain — mutarotation. The anomeric configuration is locked only once a glycosidic bond forms, which is why maltose (alpha-1,4) and cellobiose (beta-1,4) behave so differently.

quiz.q_zh: 老师把画出来的葡萄糖六元环称作“五碳糖”，正确的说法是什么？
quiz.q_en: He called the six-membered glucose ring a pentose. What is the correct description?

options.zh: 葡萄糖是六碳糖，成的是五元呋喃糖环
options.en: A hexose forming a five-membered furanose ring

options.zh: 葡萄糖是五碳糖，成的是五元呋喃糖环
options.en: A pentose forming a five-membered furanose ring

options.zh: 葡萄糖是六碳糖，成的是六元吡喃糖环
options.en: A hexose forming a six-membered pyranose ring

options.zh: 葡萄糖是五碳糖，成的是六元吡喃糖环
options.en: A pentose forming a six-membered pyranose ring

quiz.explain_zh: 葡萄糖 C6H12O6 是己糖（hexose），在水中主要以吡喃糖六元环存在：环上 5 个碳加 1 个氧共 6 个原子，第 6 位碳（CH2OH，下一步被磷酸化的位置）在环外——老师大概是把“环上 5 个碳”说成了“五碳糖”，本讲他没有更正。核糖、脱氧核糖那类才是戊糖，而戊糖成环得到的是五元呋喃糖环（4 碳 + 1 氧），与他画的六边形正好相反。
quiz.explain_en: Glucose, C6H12O6, is a hexose and exists in water mainly as the six-membered pyranose ring: five carbons plus one oxygen in the ring, with C6 (the CH2OH phosphorylated in the next step) outside it. He evidently turned "five carbons in the ring" into pentose and never corrected it. Ribose and deoxyribose are the real pentoses, and a cyclised pentose gives a five-membered furanose ring of four carbons and one oxygen — the opposite of the hexagon on the board.

quiz.q_zh: 老师说“羟基朝向变了就是另一种糖”。把 C4 位的羟基翻转过来得到的是什么？
quiz.q_en: He said flipping a hydroxyl gives a different sugar. What do you get by inverting the C4 hydroxyl?

options.zh: β-D-葡萄糖，只是异头碳翻转后的构型
options.en: Beta-glucose, an anomeric flip at C1 only

options.zh: 甘露糖 mannose，与葡萄糖差在 C2 位
options.en: Mannose, which differs from glucose at C2

options.zh: 果糖 fructose，是葡萄糖的醛酮异构体
options.en: Fructose, the aldose-to-ketose isomer of it

options.zh: 半乳糖 galactose，差在 C4 位羟基
options.en: Galactose, which differs from glucose at C4

quiz.explain_zh: C4-OH 翻转给出半乳糖，C2-OH 翻转给出甘露糖，两者都是葡萄糖的差向异构体（epimer）。果糖与葡萄糖的差别不是某个羟基的朝向，而是醛糖与酮糖之别；C1 异头碳翻转只得到 α/β 异头物，在水中还能通过开链形式互变（变旋），并不算另一种糖。
quiz.explain_en: Inverting C4-OH gives galactose and inverting C2-OH gives mannose, both epimers of glucose. Fructose differs not by the orientation of one hydroxyl but by being a ketose rather than an aldose, and inverting C1 gives only the alpha or beta anomer, which interconvert in water through the open chain and are not a different sugar.

quiz.q_zh: 葡萄糖在水溶液中的存在形式，正确的是？
quiz.q_en: Which describes the form glucose takes in aqueous solution?

options.zh: 绝大多数为呋喃五元环，六元环极少见
options.en: Almost all furanose ring; pyranose is rare here

options.zh: 环式与开链式各占一半，比例大致相等
options.en: Ring and open chain sit at about fifty-fifty

options.zh: 开链醛式占多数，环式只在结晶时形成
options.en: Mostly open-chain aldehyde; rings form on crystals

options.zh: 绝大多数为吡喃六元环，开链醛式极少
options.en: Almost all pyranose ring; open chain is tiny

quiz.explain_zh: 水中葡萄糖超过 99% 为吡喃六元环（β 约 64%、α 约 36%），开链醛式只有约 0.02%，所以老师说“水溶液里就是六元环”是对的。正因为开链式几乎不存在，C1 的半缩醛反应性受限，第一步磷酸化才落在环外的 C6 羟基上。呋喃型对葡萄糖是极少数形态，环式与开链五五开更谈不上。
quiz.explain_en: Over 99% of glucose in water is the six-membered pyranose ring (about 64% beta, 36% alpha) and only some 0.02% is the open-chain aldehyde, so his statement about the ring form is correct. Because the open chain is essentially absent and the C1 hemiacetal is unreactive, the first phosphorylation lands on the free C6 hydroxyl. The furanose form is a tiny minority for glucose, and an even split with the open chain is far off.

title_zh: 葡萄糖的 Haworth 六元环、碳原子编号与第一步的磷酸化位点
title_en: Glucose as a Haworth six-membered ring, carbon numbering, and where the first phosphate goes

points.zh: 葡萄糖在水溶液里以六元环形式存在；画 Haworth 式时只有左下角那个羟基朝上，其余羟基一律朝下，羟基朝向一变就是另一种糖。
points.en: In aqueous solution glucose exists as a six-membered ring. In the Haworth drawing only the lower-left hydroxyl points up; all the others point down. Change one orientation and you have a different sugar.

points.zh: ChemDraw 操作：在 object setting 里把默认键长调大，环画出来更整齐；点到正确位置时软件会自动把 OH 识别出来并显红色。
points.en: ChemDraw: increase the default bond length in object setting to make the ring look cleaner; when you click the right spot the software recognises the OH and colours it red.

points.zh: 右边那张表是糖酵解的总览，最上面的底物 glucose 就是刚画的这个结构；接下来照着这张表一步一步把每个中间物画出来。
points.en: The table on the right is the glycolysis overview; its top substrate, glucose, is exactly the structure just drawn. The plan is to draw every intermediate step by step following that table.

points.zh: 板书配色约定：绿色标注的是能量的流向，橙色标注的是催化该步反应的酶。
points.en: Colour convention on the board: green marks the direction of energy flow, orange marks the enzyme catalysing the step.

points.zh: 葡萄糖的编号从环右侧那个碳开始数 1、2、3、4，成环的那个碳是 5，环外竖起来的那个碳是 6。
points.en: Glucose is numbered starting from the carbon at the right of the ring: 1, 2, 3, 4; the ring carbon is 5; the carbon standing outside the ring is 6.

points.zh: 糖酵解第一步就是在葡萄糖的 6 位——环外竖起来的那个 CH2OH——上接一个磷酸基团。
points.en: Step 1 of glycolysis puts a phosphate group on C6 of glucose, the CH2OH that stands outside the ring.

points.zh: 反应箭头用 ChemDraw 的箭头工具画；长按箭头图标会展开旁边可选的箭头样式。
points.en: The reaction arrow is drawn with the ChemDraw arrow tool; long-pressing the arrow icon expands the alternative arrow styles.

points.zh: 画产物的省事做法是 Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V 把整个葡萄糖复制一份，再在它 6 位的氧上接磷酸。
points.en: The efficient way to draw the product is Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V the whole glucose, then attach the phosphate to the oxygen on its C6.

extra.zh: 编号规则背后的道理：C1 是异头碳，也就是开链形式里的醛基碳，编号从离羰基最近的一端开始。因此 6 位一定是唯一那个环外的伯醇 CH2OH——这不是随便选的位置，而是分子里化学环境最不受阻、最容易被磷酸化的羟基。
extra.en: Why the numbering runs that way: C1 is the anomeric carbon, the aldehyde carbon of the open-chain form, and numbering starts from the end nearest the carbonyl. C6 is therefore necessarily the one exocyclic primary alcohol — not an arbitrary choice, but the least hindered and most easily phosphorylated hydroxyl in the molecule.

extra.zh: 葡萄糖在水中超过 99% 以六元吡喃环（pyranose）存在，α 与 β 端基异构体约 36:64；开链醛式所占比例远低于 1%。正是这极小比例的开链式让葡萄糖有还原性，也是第二步能够开环异构化的化学前提。
extra.en: Over 99% of glucose in water is the six-membered pyranose ring, with the α and β anomers at roughly 36:64; the open-chain aldehyde is far below 1%. That tiny open-chain fraction is what makes glucose a reducing sugar and is the chemical basis for the ring-opening isomerisation in step 2.

extra.zh: Haworth 式里 OH 朝上/朝下对应 Fischer 式的左/右：Fischer 右边即 Haworth 朝下。按此换算，α-D-吡喃葡萄糖只有 C3-OH 朝上，其余（C1、C2、C4）都朝下，正好是老师说的"只有左下角那个朝上"，他画的是 α 端基异构体。β 型只有 C1-OH 的朝向不同。
extra.en: In a Haworth projection, up/down encodes Fischer left/right: right in Fischer means down in Haworth. By that rule α-D-glucopyranose has only C3-OH pointing up, with C1, C2 and C4 down — exactly the teacher's "only the lower-left one points up". He drew the α anomer; the β anomer differs only at C1.

extra.zh: 己糖激酶并不挑 α/β 端基构型，两种异头物都能被磷酸化——溶液中它们通过开链式快速互变（变旋，mutarotation），所以画哪一个都不影响后面的反应逻辑。
extra.en: Hexokinase does not care about the α/β configuration; both anomers get phosphorylated, because in solution they interconvert rapidly through the open chain (mutarotation). Which anomer you draw therefore does not change the logic downstream.

quiz.q_zh: 糖酵解第一步磷酸化的是葡萄糖的哪个碳？
quiz.q_en: Which carbon of glucose is phosphorylated in step 1 of glycolysis?

options.zh: C5，与环内氧成键的那个碳
options.en: C5, the ring carbon bonded to the ring oxygen

options.zh: C1，开链时的醛基碳，也是异头碳
options.en: C1, the anomeric carbon, the open-chain aldehyde

options.zh: C4，羟基朝下的那个环上碳
options.en: C4, a ring carbon whose hydroxyl points down

options.zh: C6，环外竖起来的那个伯醇碳
options.en: C6, the exocyclic primary-alcohol carbon

quiz.explain_zh: C6 是分子里唯一的环外伯醇 CH2OH，己糖激酶把 ATP 的 γ-磷酸转到这个羟基的氧上。C1 是半缩醛碳，已经带一个 OH 加一个环内醚氧，这一步不动它——要等异构成 F6P 之后 C1 才会被 PFK-1 磷酸化。C5 上连的是氢并参与成环，没有可供酯化的羟基；C4-OH 在整条糖酵解通路里始终不变。
quiz.explain_en: C6 is the only exocyclic primary alcohol, and hexokinase transfers ATP's γ-phosphate onto that hydroxyl oxygen. C1 is the hemiacetal carbon, already carrying an OH plus the ring ether oxygen; it is untouched here and is only phosphorylated by PFK-1 after isomerisation to F6P. C5 carries a hydrogen and closes the ring, offering no hydroxyl to esterify, and C4-OH never changes anywhere in glycolysis.

quiz.q_zh: 葡萄糖在水溶液里的主要存在形式是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the predominant form of glucose in aqueous solution?

options.zh: 五元呋喃环，和果糖的成环方式完全相同
options.en: The five-membered furanose ring, the way fructose does

options.zh: 六元环与五元环各约一半，动态互变着
options.en: About half pyranose and half furanose, interconverting

options.zh: 六元吡喃环，占比 >99%，开链式极少
options.en: The six-membered pyranose ring, over 99% of the total

options.zh: 开链醛式，占比 >90%，成环的是少数
options.en: The open-chain aldehyde, over 90%; rings are a minority

quiz.explain_zh: 葡萄糖在水中几乎全部是六元吡喃环（α:β 约 36:64），开链醛式远低于 1%，但正是这极小比例赋予它还原性并让第二步的开环成为可能。五元呋喃环是果糖（酮糖）成环的方式，葡萄糖的 C5-OH 进攻 C1 醛基得到的是六元环；两种环也不是各占一半。
quiz.explain_en: Glucose in water is almost entirely the six-membered pyranose ring (α:β about 36:64); the open-chain aldehyde is far below 1%, yet that tiny fraction gives glucose its reducing character and makes step 2's ring opening possible. The five-membered furanose is how fructose, a ketose, cyclises; glucose's C5-OH attacks the C1 aldehyde to give a six-membered ring, and the two ring sizes are certainly not equally populated.

quiz.q_zh: 老师在板书上用橙色标注的是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does the teacher mark in orange on the board?

options.zh: 这一步能量的流向与去向
options.en: the direction in which energy flows

options.zh: 这一步的标准自由能变
options.en: the standard free-energy change

options.zh: 这一步产物的英文缩写
options.en: the English abbreviation of the product

options.zh: 催化这一步反应的那个酶
options.en: the enzyme that catalyses this step

quiz.explain_zh: 老师明确说绿色代表能量的流向、橙色代表催化的酶，这套配色贯穿整块板书。ΔG°′ 的数值他在这一段完全没有写在图上；产物缩写 G6P、F6P 是直接写在结构旁边的黑字，靠位置而不是颜色区分。
quiz.explain_en: The teacher states explicitly that green marks energy flow and orange marks the catalysing enzyme, and keeps that scheme across the whole board. He writes no ΔG°′ values at all in this stretch, and the product abbreviations G6P and F6P are plain black text beside each structure, distinguished by placement rather than colour.

title_zh: 中间物 G6P 的生成与命名，以及 kinase 的命名规则和磷酸供体
title_en: Forming and naming G6P, what the suffix kinase implies, and where its phosphate comes from

points.zh: 在葡萄糖 6 位的氧上接磷酸：中心写一个 P，四周全部补上氧；ChemDraw 里单键图标下面就是双键，点一下就能画出磷酸的 P=O。
points.en: Attach the phosphate to the oxygen on C6: write a P in the middle and put oxygens all around it. In ChemDraw the double bond sits right under the single-bond icon, one click gives the P=O of the phosphate.

points.zh: 老师说磷酸画一个双键或两个双键都可以，本节课不讨论这个写法上的争议，按他的画法写即可。
points.en: The teacher says drawing the phosphate with one or with two double bonds are both acceptable; he explicitly declines to argue that point in this class and asks students to follow his version.

points.zh: 建议把每一步发生变化的基团标成红色，这样一眼就能看出这一步到底改了哪里。
points.en: A study tip he gives: colour the group that changed in each step red, so you can see at a glance what that step actually did.

points.zh: 产物命名 G6P = Glucose-6-phosphate，其中的 6 就是接上磷酸的那个碳的编号。
points.en: The product is named G6P = glucose-6-phosphate, where the 6 is simply the number of the carbon that received the phosphate.

points.zh: 他强调只要记住 G6P 这个缩写就够了：说 G6P 大家都知道指的是什么。
points.en: He stresses that remembering the abbreviation G6P is enough — say G6P and everyone knows what you mean.

points.zh: 催化第一步的酶中文叫己糖激酶，英文名 hexokinase，写在图里那个小圆圈的位置。
points.en: The enzyme of step 1 is 己糖激酶 in Chinese, hexokinase in English, written in the small circle on the chart.

points.zh: 老师给的规则：凡是名字里带 kinase（激酶）的酶，一定是在操作磷酸基团——要么加上一个磷酸，要么去掉一个磷酸，因为很多激酶催化的反应是可逆的（此说法有问题，见 extra）。
points.en: His rule of thumb: any enzyme whose name contains kinase is handling a phosphate group — either adding one or removing one, because, as he puts it, many kinase reactions are reversible (this claim is problematic; see extra).

points.zh: 激酶用的磷酸一般来自 ATP；少数激酶用 GTP，但那类多见于信号通路，代谢这张图上谈的都是 ATP。
points.en: The phosphate a kinase uses generally comes from ATP; a minority of kinases use GTP, but those belong mostly to signalling pathways, whereas everything on this metabolic chart runs on ATP.

points.zh: 激酶要动 ATP 的磷酸就必须有镁离子参与，老师称之为"辅酶"（称呼有误，见 extra）；镁离子与 ATP 的 β、γ 磷酸结合，把电荷中和掉。
points.en: To move a phosphate off ATP the kinase needs magnesium, which he calls a coenzyme (wrong term; see extra). Mg²⁺ binds the β and γ phosphates of ATP and neutralises their charge.

extra.zh: 24:29 老师说"很多激酶催化的反应是可逆的，所以既可以上一个磷酸也可以去掉一个磷酸"。去磷酸是磷酸酶 phosphatase 的活，不是激酶的逆反应：ATP 依赖的磷酰基转移在细胞内 ΔG 很负，基本单向；磷酸化与去磷酸化由两个不同的酶各自催化，这正是它能当调控开关的原因（若同一个酶双向催化，开关就没有方向）。他自己在 27:08 讲己糖激酶时改口说"磷酸装不回 ATP，是单向过程"，后面这句才对。
extra.en: At 24:29 he says many kinase reactions are reversible, so a kinase can put a phosphate on or take one off. Removing phosphate is a phosphatase's job, not a kinase running backwards: ATP-dependent phosphoryl transfer has a strongly negative ΔG in the cell and is essentially unidirectional. Phosphorylation and dephosphorylation are catalysed by two different enzymes, which is precisely what makes the pair a switch — one enzyme running both ways would have no direction. He corrects himself at 27:08 when discussing hexokinase, saying the phosphate cannot be put back onto ATP; that later statement is the right one.

extra.zh: 25:00 他把 Mg²⁺ 叫作"辅酶"。Mg²⁺ 是辅因子 cofactor 中的金属离子；辅酶 coenzyme 专指 NAD⁺、FAD、CoA 这类有机小分子。这两个词在本课程的分类体系里不能互换，本讲范围内他没有改口。
extra.en: At 25:00 he calls Mg²⁺ a coenzyme. Mg²⁺ is a metal-ion cofactor; coenzyme is reserved for organic small molecules such as NAD⁺, FAD and CoA. The two terms are not interchangeable in this course's taxonomy, and he does not correct it anywhere in this stretch.

extra.zh: 激酶真正识别的底物是 Mg·ATP²⁻ 复合物，不是游离 ATP。ATP 水解的 ΔG°′ ≈ −30.5 kJ/mol，而己糖激酶整步的 ΔG°′ ≈ −16.7 kJ/mol：一半多的能量被"花掉"，换来的就是把这一步锁死成单向反应。
extra.en: The substrate a kinase actually recognises is the Mg·ATP²⁻ complex, not free ATP. ATP hydrolysis has ΔG°′ ≈ −30.5 kJ/mol while the whole hexokinase step is ΔG°′ ≈ −16.7 kJ/mol: more than half the energy is spent, and what it buys is locking the step into one direction.

extra.zh: 命名格式值得一次记清：glucose-6-phosphate 里的连字符加数字表示磷酸酯所在的碳位；后面出现的 fructose-1,6-bisphosphate 用 bis- 而不是 di-，因为两个磷酸各自独立成酯挂在 1 位和 6 位，而 di-（如 ADP 的 diphosphate）指两个磷酸首尾串成焦磷酸链。
extra.en: Worth fixing the naming format once: the hyphen-plus-number in glucose-6-phosphate gives the carbon bearing the phosphate ester. The later fructose-1,6-bisphosphate uses bis-, not di-, because the two phosphates are esterified independently at C1 and C6, whereas di- (as in ADP's diphosphate) denotes two phosphates linked head-to-tail into a pyrophosphate chain.

quiz.q_zh: 对"激酶催化的反应可以反过来把磷酸去掉"这一说法，正确的评价是什么？
quiz.q_en: How should the claim "a kinase reaction can run backwards and remove the phosphate" be judged?

options.zh: 正确，ATP/ADP 比值低时就会自发逆转
options.en: Right — a low ATP/ADP ratio drives the reaction backwards in vivo

options.zh: 错误，磷酸一旦加上细胞就不再移除它
options.en: Wrong — a phosphate once added is never removed inside the cell

options.zh: 正确，激酶反应接近平衡可以双向进行
options.en: Right — kinase reactions are near equilibrium and readily reverse

options.zh: 错误，脱磷酸是磷酸酶的活，属另一个酶
options.en: Wrong — removing phosphate is a phosphatase's job, another enzyme

quiz.explain_zh: ATP 依赖的磷酰基转移在细胞内 ΔG 很负，远离平衡，实际上不可逆；把磷酸卸下来的是磷酸酶，是另一个基因编码的另一个酶。正因为加与卸由两个酶分别控制，磷酸化才能充当可调的开关。ATP/ADP 比值下降会降低正向通量，但不足以让反应真的倒过来。细胞当然会移除磷酸——蛋白磷酸酶、葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶都在做这件事，只是不由激酶来做。
quiz.explain_en: ATP-dependent phosphoryl transfer has a strongly negative ΔG in the cell, sits far from equilibrium and is effectively irreversible; the phosphate is taken off by a phosphatase, a different enzyme from a different gene. Because addition and removal are controlled by two separate enzymes, phosphorylation can work as a tunable switch. A falling ATP/ADP ratio slows the forward flux but does not genuinely reverse the reaction. And cells certainly do remove phosphates — protein phosphatases and glucose-6-phosphatase do exactly that — just not via the kinase.

quiz.q_zh: 己糖激酶反应里的 Mg²⁺ 应该归为哪一类？
quiz.q_en: How should the Mg²⁺ in the hexokinase reaction be classified?

options.zh: 辅因子 cofactor，具体是金属离子
options.en: a metal-ion cofactor, chelating the ATP

options.zh: 辅酶 coenzyme，与 NAD⁺、FAD 同类
options.en: a coenzyme, in the same class as NAD+ and FAD

options.zh: 辅基 prosthetic group，共价结合
options.en: a prosthetic group covalently held by the enzyme

options.zh: 别构激活剂，结合在 allosteric site
options.en: an allosteric activator at a regulatory site

quiz.explain_zh: Mg²⁺ 是金属离子辅因子，与 ATP 螯合成 Mg·ATP 才是激酶真正的底物，这也是老师此处口误的地方。辅酶 coenzyme 专指 NAD⁺、FAD、CoA 这类有机小分子；辅基是共价或极紧密结合在酶上、不随反应解离的辅因子，比如血红素，而 Mg²⁺ 是随底物来去的。它也不结合别构位点，不起变构激活作用。
quiz.explain_en: Mg²⁺ is a metal-ion cofactor; chelated to ATP it forms Mg·ATP, the species the kinase actually binds — this is where the teacher misspoke. Coenzyme is reserved for organic small molecules such as NAD⁺, FAD and CoA. A prosthetic group is a cofactor covalently or very tightly held by the enzyme and not released during turnover, such as haem, whereas Mg²⁺ comes and goes with the substrate. Nor does it occupy an allosteric site or act as an allosteric activator.

quiz.q_zh: 代谢途径里的激酶所用的磷酸基团通常来自哪里？
quiz.q_en: Where does the phosphate used by kinases in metabolic pathways usually come from?

options.zh: 无机磷酸 Pi，从溶液中直接结合上去
options.en: inorganic phosphate Pi, bound straight from solution

options.zh: ATP 的 γ-磷酸，也就是最外侧那个
options.en: the γ-phosphate of ATP, the outermost phosphate

options.zh: 磷酸肌酸，肌肉里的高能磷酸储库
options.en: phosphocreatine, the muscle high-energy phosphate store

options.zh: GTP 的 γ-磷酸，信号通路里最常见
options.en: the γ-phosphate of GTP, most common in signalling

quiz.explain_zh: 代谢通路里的激酶几乎都用 ATP，转移的是离腺苷最远、能量最高的 γ-磷酸。GTP 依赖的激酶确实存在，但集中在信号转导，不是糖酵解这张图的情形。无机 Pi 直接加成不是激酶的机制——糖酵解里唯一直接用 Pi 的是 GAPDH，而它是脱氢酶不是激酶。磷酸肌酸是肌肉的 ATP 缓冲库，它先经肌酸激酶把磷酸交给 ADP 生成 ATP，己糖激酶并不直接取用它。
quiz.explain_en: Kinases in metabolism almost always use ATP, transferring the γ-phosphate, the one furthest from adenosine and highest in transfer potential. GTP-dependent kinases exist but cluster in signal transduction, not on this glycolysis chart. Direct addition of inorganic Pi is not a kinase mechanism — the one glycolytic step that uses Pi directly is GAPDH, which is a dehydrogenase, not a kinase. Phosphocreatine is the muscle's ATP buffer: creatine kinase hands its phosphate to ADP to make ATP first, and hexokinase never draws on it directly.

title_zh: γ-磷酸的转移、Mg²⁺ 的作用，以及第一步的耗能与不可逆
title_en: Transferring the γ-phosphate, the role of Mg²⁺, and why step 1 costs ATP and cannot run back

points.zh: 老师说中和电荷以后 ATP 才能跨膜；他同时指出现阶段反应还在细胞质里进行，但认为 ATP 天然倾向与镁离子结合以屏蔽电荷（跨膜这一条有误，见 extra）。
points.en: He says that once the charge is neutralised ATP can cross the membrane; he notes in the same breath that this stage still happens in the cytosol, but holds that ATP naturally tends to bind magnesium to shield its charge (the membrane part is wrong; see extra).

points.zh: 在镁离子帮助下，己糖激酶把 ATP 上的 γ-磷酸——也就是那个高能磷酸——转移到葡萄糖 6 位的羟基上。
points.en: With magnesium's help, hexokinase transfers the γ-phosphate of ATP, the high-energy one, onto the hydroxyl at C6 of glucose.

points.zh: 这一步消耗一分子 ATP，所以糖酵解虽然总体是净赚能量的，第一步实际上是先投入了一分子 ATP 的能量。
points.en: This step consumes one ATP, so although glycolysis nets energy overall, step 1 is in fact an up-front investment of one ATP.

points.zh: 反应结束后葡萄糖的 6 位带上了磷酸基团，这就是第一步反应的全过程。
points.en: At the end of the reaction C6 of glucose carries a phosphate group; that is the whole of step 1.

points.zh: Hexo- 表示这个酶不专一于某一种六碳糖：只要是六个碳组成的糖，它大多都能识别，并在其 6 位上加一个磷酸，底物特异性不高。
points.en: The prefix hexo- signals that the enzyme is not specific for one particular six-carbon sugar: it recognises most hexoses and phosphorylates them at position 6. Its substrate specificity is low.

points.zh: 但这个酶催化的反应是不可逆的：细胞里只要识别到六碳糖就很容易给它加上磷酸，加上以后不能把磷酸重新装回 ATP，是一个单向过程。
points.en: The reaction it catalyses is nonetheless irreversible: in the cell it readily phosphorylates any hexose it recognises, but once added the phosphate cannot be loaded back onto ATP. It is a one-way process.

points.zh: 镁离子必须参与的原因，老师给了两条：一是屏蔽 ATP 上的负电荷、让 ATP 更容易跨膜流动；二是让磷酸基团更容易发生转移。
points.en: He gives two reasons why magnesium is required: it shields the negative charge on ATP so that ATP can move across membranes more easily, and it makes phosphate transfer easier.

points.zh: 第二条说得更具体：镁离子可以稍微降低 γ-磷酸的活化能，让这个磷酸更容易装载到葡萄糖上去。
points.en: He makes the second reason more concrete: magnesium lowers the activation energy for moving the γ-phosphate, so it loads onto glucose more readily.

points.zh: 讲完反应本身后，他转入这一步的调控，先从酶名里的 Hexo- 说起。
points.en: Having finished the chemistry, he turns to regulation of this step, starting from the Hexo- in the enzyme's name.

extra.zh: 25:31 和 27:40 他两次说中和电荷是"为了让 ATP 能跨膜"。糖酵解全程在细胞质里，这一步的 ATP 根本不需要跨膜；而且 ATP 即使螯合了 Mg²⁺ 净电荷仍为负（MgATP²⁻），不能自由扩散过磷脂双分子层，线粒体内外的 ATP/ADP 交换靠腺苷酸转位酶 ANT（SLC25A4）这类载体蛋白完成。他在 25:31 已经意识到"现在还在细胞质里"这个矛盾，但没有撤回"跨膜"的说法。他给的第二条理由——屏蔽电荷、降低 γ-磷酸转移的活化能——是对的。
extra.en: At 25:31 and again at 27:40 he says charge neutralisation is what lets ATP cross the membrane. All of glycolysis runs in the cytosol and the ATP in this step never crosses anything; moreover, even chelated to Mg²⁺ the complex is still anionic (MgATP²⁻) and cannot diffuse through a lipid bilayer — ATP/ADP exchange across the mitochondrial inner membrane is carried out by the adenine nucleotide translocase (ANT/SLC25A4). He notices the tension at 25:31, remarking that this stage is still in the cytosol, but never withdraws the membrane claim. His second reason — shielding charge and lowering the activation barrier for γ-phosphate transfer — is correct.

extra.zh: Mg²⁺ 的真实作用有三条：① 与 ATP 的 β、γ 磷酸螯合成 Mg·ATP，这才是激酶真正识别的底物；② 屏蔽负电荷，降低葡萄糖 6-OH 这个亲核试剂靠近 γ-磷时的静电排斥；③ 把三磷酸链固定成利于在线（in-line）转移的构象，并稳定带负电的过渡态。三条都在活性中心里发生，与膜无关。
extra.en: Mg²⁺ actually does three things: it chelates the β and γ phosphates into Mg·ATP, the species the kinase really binds; it shields negative charge, reducing the electrostatic repulsion as the nucleophilic glucose 6-OH approaches the γ-phosphorus; and it holds the triphosphate chain in a conformation suited to in-line transfer while stabilising the negatively charged transition state. All three happen inside the active site and have nothing to do with membranes.

extra.zh: 己糖激酶为什么不会白白水解 ATP：葡萄糖结合后酶的两个结构域夹闭包住底物，把水从活性中心排挤出去（诱导契合 induced fit）。若没有这一步，水就会取代葡萄糖当受体，ATP 被白白水解成 ADP + Pi。所以酶不只是加速反应，还负责"选对受体"，这是催化特异性的一个经典例子。
extra.en: Why hexokinase does not simply hydrolyse ATP: when glucose binds, the two lobes of the enzyme close around it and squeeze water out of the active site (induced fit). Without that, water would substitute for glucose as the acceptor and the ATP would be wasted as ADP + Pi. The enzyme therefore does more than accelerate a reaction — it selects the right acceptor, a textbook case of catalytic specificity.

extra.zh: 己糖激酶这一步 ΔG°′ ≈ −16.7 kJ/mol，细胞内实际 ΔG 更负，这才是它"不可逆"的真正来源。不可逆性来自自由能变大幅为负，而不是来自"消耗了 ATP"这件事本身——糖酵解第 10 步的丙酮酸激酶是产 ATP 的，同样不可逆。
extra.en: The hexokinase step has ΔG°′ ≈ −16.7 kJ/mol and an even more negative actual ΔG in the cell; that is where its irreversibility comes from. Irreversibility follows from a large negative free-energy change, not from the fact that ATP was spent — pyruvate kinase, step 10, produces ATP and is equally irreversible.

quiz.q_zh: Mg²⁺ 在己糖激酶反应中的作用，下列哪一条是准确的？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about the role of Mg²⁺ in the hexokinase reaction is accurate?

options.zh: 屏蔽电荷使 ATP 可以自由扩散过质膜
options.en: It shields charge so ATP can freely cross the plasma membrane

options.zh: 作为亲核试剂直接进攻 ATP 的 γ-磷
options.en: It acts as the nucleophile attacking ATP's γ-phosphorus

options.zh: 与葡萄糖 6-OH 配位并夺走它的质子
options.en: It coordinates glucose 6-OH and strips off its proton

options.zh: 与 ATP 的 β、γ 磷酸螯合成底物
options.en: It chelates ATP's β and γ phosphates into the substrate

quiz.explain_zh: Mg·ATP 复合物才是激酶识别的底物，Mg²⁺ 同时屏蔽负电荷、稳定过渡态。ATP 即使结合了镁仍是 MgATP²⁻，净电荷为负，不能自由扩散过膜（膜两侧的 ATP/ADP 交换靠 ANT 载体），这正是老师此处说反的地方。真正进攻 γ-磷的亲核试剂是葡萄糖 6 位羟基的氧；帮它脱质子的是活性中心的天冬氨酸残基，不是镁离子。
quiz.explain_en: The Mg·ATP complex is what the kinase binds, and Mg²⁺ simultaneously shields negative charge and stabilises the transition state. Even with magnesium bound the species is MgATP²⁻, still anionic and unable to diffuse across a bilayer — ATP/ADP exchange across membranes is done by the ANT carrier, which is exactly where the teacher goes wrong here. The nucleophile that attacks the γ-phosphorus is the oxygen of glucose's C6 hydroxyl, and it is deprotonated by an active-site aspartate, not by magnesium.

quiz.q_zh: 己糖激酶这一步之所以"不可逆"，根本原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the fundamental reason the hexokinase step is irreversible?

options.zh: 因为镁离子把产物锁在了活性中心里
options.en: Magnesium locks the product inside the active site

options.zh: 因为它消耗了 ATP，耗能反应都不可逆
options.en: It spends ATP, and all ATP-spending reactions are one-way

options.zh: 因为该步 ΔG 大幅为负，远离平衡状态
options.en: Its ΔG is strongly negative, far from equilibrium

options.zh: 因为细胞内不存在任何相应的磷酸酶
options.en: No corresponding phosphatase exists inside the cell

quiz.explain_zh: 不可逆是个热力学判断：细胞内实际 ΔG 大幅为负，反应远离平衡，回头需要越过很大的能垒。"耗能所以不可逆"这个推理不成立——糖酵解第 10 步的丙酮酸激酶是产 ATP 的，照样不可逆。磷酸酶其实是存在的：肝脏的葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶就水解 G6P，但那是另一个酶催化的水解反应，不是这一步的逆反应。镁离子随底物来去，不参与产物的去留。
quiz.explain_en: Irreversibility is a thermodynamic verdict: the in-cell ΔG is strongly negative, the reaction sits far from equilibrium, and running it backwards means climbing a large barrier. The reasoning "it costs ATP, so it is one-way" fails — pyruvate kinase, step 10, produces ATP and is equally irreversible. A phosphatase does in fact exist: hepatic glucose-6-phosphatase hydrolyses G6P, but that is a separate hydrolytic reaction catalysed by a different enzyme, not the reverse of this step. Magnesium comes and goes with the substrate and has no say in product release.

quiz.q_zh: hexokinase 名字里的 hexo- 提示的是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does the prefix hexo- in hexokinase tell you?

options.zh: 该酶由六个相同亚基组成的寡聚体
options.en: the enzyme is an oligomer of six identical subunits

options.zh: 该酶把磷酸接到底物的 6 位碳上
options.en: the enzyme puts the phosphate on carbon 6 of its substrate

options.zh: 该酶需要六个氢键才能固定底物
options.en: the enzyme needs six hydrogen bonds to hold the substrate

options.zh: 该酶可作用于多种六碳糖类底物
options.en: the enzyme acts on a range of six-carbon sugar substrates

quiz.explain_zh: hexo- 来自 hexose（己糖、六碳糖），指的是底物类别：己糖激酶 I–III 对葡萄糖、果糖、甘露糖都有活性，底物特异性不高，这正是老师强调的一点。磷酸确实接在 6 位，但命名依据的是底物类别而不是磷酸接的位置，这是最容易被数字"6"带偏的一个陷阱。亚基数目和氢键数目都与这个词根毫无关系。
quiz.explain_en: Hexo- comes from hexose, a six-carbon sugar, and refers to the substrate class: hexokinases I–III act on glucose, fructose and mannose alike, with low substrate specificity — the very point the teacher makes. The phosphate does land on C6, but the name is built from the substrate class, not the position of the phosphate; the coincidence of the number 6 is the trap here. Subunit count and hydrogen-bond count have nothing to do with this root.

title_zh: 己糖激酶与葡萄糖激酶：组织分布、专一性和 G6P 的产物反馈抑制
title_en: Hexokinase versus glucokinase: tissue distribution, specificity, and product feedback by G6P

points.zh: 人体内除己糖激酶外还有一个功能比较类似的酶叫葡萄糖激酶；老师说它"不是同工酶"，只是功能相似（此说法有误，见 extra）。
points.en: Besides hexokinase the body has another enzyme of similar function called glucokinase; the teacher says it is not an isozyme, merely similar in function (this is wrong; see extra).

points.zh: 葡萄糖激酶在这张糖酵解图里没有画出来，但在人体内确实存在。
points.en: Glucokinase does not appear on this glycolysis chart, but it certainly exists in the body.

points.zh: 分布上的区别：己糖激酶在人体各个组织都存在，葡萄糖激酶主要存在于肝脏。
points.en: Distribution differs: hexokinase is present in tissues throughout the body, whereas glucokinase is found mainly in the liver.

points.zh: 葡萄糖激酶对 D 型葡萄糖的专一性比较高，是一个比较专一地识别底物的酶，不像己糖激酶那样各种六碳糖都收。
points.en: Glucokinase has high specificity for D-glucose and is a comparatively selective enzyme, unlike hexokinase which takes hexoses indiscriminately.

points.zh: 两者最大的区别：葡萄糖激酶不会被 G6P 抑制，而己糖激酶会被 G6P 抑制。
points.en: The biggest difference: glucokinase is not inhibited by G6P, while hexokinase is.

points.zh: 产物反馈抑制的含义：反应从葡萄糖生成 G6P，这个产物反过来抑制己糖激酶的活性，产物越多酶活越低。
points.en: What product feedback inhibition means: the reaction converts glucose to G6P, and that product turns around and inhibits hexokinase — the more product, the lower the activity.

points.zh: 反过来说，产物越少反应越快；细胞里若已经积了很多 G6P，己糖激酶的功能就会很大程度上受抑制，不再继续把葡萄糖变成 G6P。
points.en: Conversely, the less product, the faster the reaction; if a cell has already accumulated a lot of G6P, hexokinase is largely shut down and stops converting further glucose into G6P.

points.zh: 老师说葡萄糖激酶的作用是在肝糖原变成葡萄糖以后持续把葡萄糖变成 G6P，源源不断地从肝脏分解糖原来维持血糖平衡（方向讲反了，见 extra）。
points.en: He describes glucokinase as continuously converting glucose into G6P after liver glycogen has been broken down to glucose, steadily mobilising hepatic glycogen to maintain blood sugar (the direction is reversed; see extra).

points.zh: 小结这一步的调控：己糖激酶的抑制剂就是它自己的产物 G6P，这是糖酵解第一步的调控要点。
points.en: Summing up the regulation: hexokinase's inhibitor is its own product, G6P, and that is the regulatory point of step 1 of glycolysis.

extra.zh: 28:12 老师说葡萄糖激酶和己糖激酶"不是同工酶"。恰恰相反：葡萄糖激酶就是己糖激酶 IV（hexokinase IV），是己糖激酶家族的同工酶 isozyme——催化同一个反应、由不同基因编码、组织分布与动力学不同。他随后讲的所有区别（肝脏、专一性高、不被 G6P 抑制）本身都是对的，只有"不是同工酶"这一句错，本讲范围内他没有改口。
extra.en: At 28:12 he says glucokinase and hexokinase are not isozymes. The opposite is true: glucokinase is hexokinase IV, an isozyme of the hexokinase family — same reaction, different gene, different tissue distribution and kinetics. Every difference he then lists (liver, high specificity, not inhibited by G6P) is correct; only the "not isozymes" line is wrong, and he does not correct it in this stretch.

extra.zh: 29:15–29:45 他说葡萄糖激酶"源源不断地从肝脏里分解糖原来维持血糖"。方向反了。肝糖原分解走的是另一条路：糖原磷酸化酶把糖原磷酸解成 G1P，磷酸葡萄糖变位酶转成 G6P，再由葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶水解成游离葡萄糖出肝入血，全程不经过葡萄糖激酶。葡萄糖激酶干的恰恰相反：餐后血糖高时把进入肝细胞的葡萄糖磷酸化成 G6P 存起来（合成糖原和脂肪），属于"降血糖、清除血糖"的一侧。他说的"维持血糖平衡"这个总说法勉强成立（餐后清除也是稳态的一半），但归给它的那条路径是错的。
extra.en: At 29:15–29:45 he has glucokinase steadily mobilising hepatic glycogen to sustain blood glucose. The direction is reversed. Glycogen breakdown in liver takes a different route: glycogen phosphorylase phosphorolyses glycogen to G1P, phosphoglucomutase converts it to G6P, and glucose-6-phosphatase hydrolyses that to free glucose for export to the blood — glucokinase is nowhere in that chain. Glucokinase does the opposite: after a meal it phosphorylates incoming glucose to G6P for storage as glycogen and fat, on the glucose-clearing side. His broad phrase "maintaining blood glucose homeostasis" survives (post-meal clearance is half of homeostasis), but the pathway he assigns to the enzyme is wrong.

extra.zh: 两者的动力学差两个数量级：己糖激酶 I–III 的 Km ≈ 0.1 mM，葡萄糖激酶的 S₀.₅ ≈ 10 mM，而空腹血糖约 5 mM。结果是肌肉和脑在低血糖时仍能以接近满速取糖（酶已饱和），肝脏则只在餐后血糖升高时摄取量才明显上升。再加上葡萄糖激酶不被 G6P 抑制、动力学呈正协同（Hill 系数约 1.7），它在餐后能不饱和地持续工作，这正是"肝脏当血糖缓冲器"的分子基础。
extra.en: Their kinetics differ by two orders of magnitude: hexokinases I–III have Km ≈ 0.1 mM, glucokinase has S₀.₅ ≈ 10 mM, and fasting blood glucose is about 5 mM. Muscle and brain therefore take up glucose at near-maximal rate even when blood sugar is low (their enzyme is already saturated), while hepatic uptake rises appreciably only after a meal. Add that glucokinase escapes G6P inhibition and shows positive cooperativity (Hill coefficient about 1.7), and it can keep working unsaturated after a meal — the molecular basis for the liver acting as a glucose buffer.

extra.zh: "不被 G6P 抑制"不等于"不受调控"。葡萄糖激酶另有一套机制：葡萄糖激酶调节蛋白 GKRP。血糖低时 F6P 促进 GKRP 把 GK 扣留在肝细胞核内；血糖升高（以及果糖-1-磷酸出现，提示有糖进来）时 GK 被释放到胞质工作。这是一种靠亚细胞定位实现的调控，与产物反馈抑制是完全不同的机制。
extra.en: Escaping G6P inhibition is not the same as escaping regulation. Glucokinase has its own mechanism: the glucokinase regulatory protein GKRP. When blood glucose is low, F6P promotes GKRP-mediated sequestration of GK in the hepatocyte nucleus; when glucose rises (and fructose 1-phosphate appears, signalling incoming sugar) GK is released into the cytosol to work. This is regulation by subcellular localisation, a completely different mechanism from product feedback inhibition.

quiz.q_zh: 葡萄糖激酶与己糖激酶之间是什么关系？
quiz.q_en: What is the relationship between glucokinase and hexokinase?

options.zh: 同一个酶被磷酸化与去磷酸化的两态
options.en: the phosphorylated and dephosphorylated states of it

options.zh: 己糖激酶家族的同工酶 HK IV
