Locking the molecule in the mitochondrial matrix misplaces the compartment: glycolysis is cytosolic, and the charge keeps intermediates from leaving the cell, not the mitochondrion. Lowering Km treats binding affinity as the purpose, whereas the real purpose is product symmetry and downstream energy recovery.

quiz.q_zh: 老师说醛缩酶这一步「主要由底物驱动」。按化学平衡应该怎么表述？
quiz.q_en: The teacher called the aldolase step "substrate-driven". How should it be phrased in equilibrium terms?

options.zh: 是底物驱动：F-1,6-BP 大量堆积，靠底物浓度把反应推向右
options.en: Substrate-driven: F-1,6-BP piles up and pushes the reaction to the right

options.zh: 是产物移除：产物被抽走，按 Le Chatelier 右移
options.en: Product removal: draining the products shifts equilibrium rightward

options.zh: 是酶驱动：醛缩酶的高 kcat 使正反应速率远大于逆反应速率
options.en: Enzyme-driven: the high kcat of aldolase outpaces the reverse reaction

options.zh: 是能量驱动：裂解释放的热量被下一步吸收，形成能量偶联
options.en: Energy-driven: heat released by cleavage is absorbed by the next step

quiz.explain_zh: 他描述的现象是 DHAP 转成 GAP、GAP 又进入下一步，也就是产物被持续抽走，按 Le Chatelier 原理平衡右移，规范说法是产物移除。说底物堆积推动反应，与事实不符：F-1,6-BP 在细胞里浓度很低，被 PFK-1 的调控卡着，并没有堆积。说酶的高 kcat 决定方向是概念错误：酶对正逆反应加速的倍数相同，永远改变不了平衡位置。说裂解放热被下一步吸收，把热量当成了可以定向传递的偶联媒介，而且这一步标准条件下是吸能的，根本没有热量可放。
quiz.explain_en: What he describes — DHAP becoming GAP and GAP entering the next reaction — is continuous removal of products, which shifts the equilibrium rightward by Le Chatelier's principle; the standard term is product removal. Substrate build-up does not fit the facts: F-1,6-BP is held at low concentration by PFK-1 regulation and does not accumulate. Attributing direction to a high kcat is a conceptual error, since an enzyme accelerates forward and reverse equally and can never move the equilibrium position. Heat from cleavage being absorbed downstream treats heat as a directed coupling medium, and in any case the step is endergonic under standard conditions, so there is no heat to release.

title_zh: ΔG、熵与自发性；第一阶段全程复盘
title_en: ΔG, entropy and spontaneity; a full recap of phase one

points.zh: 他说一个化学反应要能自发进行，它的 ΔG 肯定要小于零；小于零就是发生反应放出能量，「它的熵是增加的，自然界是熵增的过程」。
points.en: He said a reaction can only be spontaneous if its ΔG is below zero; below zero means the reaction releases energy and "its entropy increases, since nature runs toward increasing entropy".

points.zh: 由此他把 ΔG 大于零的这两步称作「熵减的过程」，并说熵减的过程一般来说不能自发反应。
points.en: He therefore called these two positive-ΔG steps "entropy-decreasing processes", and said such processes generally cannot occur spontaneously.

points.zh: 但这两个反应仍能进行，是因为 GAP 源源不断地进入下一步反应，底物更倾向于转变成产物。
points.en: They still proceed, he explained, because GAP is continuously drawn into the next reaction, so the substrate tends to convert into product.

points.zh: 他还顺口说了一句「一般这个 ΔG 都是大于零的吧」。
points.en: He also remarked in passing that "ΔG is generally greater than zero, isn't it".

points.zh: 他说这两步不那么重要，因为既没有增加也没有减少基团，也没有能量的转移，只是结构在变来变去。
points.en: He rated these two steps as less important, since no group is added or removed and no energy is transferred — only the structure shuffles about.

points.zh: 他随后说，整个糖酵解和三羧酸循环里只会在这个位置提到 ΔG 大于零，其他反应基本上 ΔG 都是小于零的，只有这一步大于零。
points.en: He then said that in all of glycolysis and the TCA cycle a positive ΔG is mentioned only here, other reactions being essentially negative, and only this step positive.

points.zh: 他把磷酸标成红色，这样就能看清每个磷酸从哪来：左右各一个磷酸，断开后分别落到两个分子上，DHAP 再转成 GAP。
points.en: He coloured the phosphates red so their provenance is visible: one at each end, distributed to the two fragments upon cleavage, with DHAP then converting to GAP.

points.zh: Step 1 全程复盘：一个葡萄糖，第一步不可逆，用一分子 ATP 上一个磷酸变成 G6P；G6P 折腾一下把右边那个碳解放出来；再用一分子 ATP，这一步也不可逆，右边也上一个磷酸；再下一步用一个逆阿道尔缩合把它分解成两个。
points.en: The full recap of step 1: one glucose; an irreversible first step spends one ATP to add a phosphate and give G6P; G6P is rearranged to free up the carbon on the right; another ATP is spent in a second irreversible step to phosphorylate that end; then a retro-aldol condensation splits the molecule in two.

points.zh: 学生问这几步是不是都不可逆，他回答只有这两步不可逆，就是上磷酸基团的第一步和第三步，并把这两个箭头单独标出来。
points.en: Asked whether all these steps are irreversible, he answered that only two are — the first and the third, the ones that add a phosphoryl group — and marked those two arrows separately.

extra.zh: 这一段最需要修正的是把 ΔG 和熵 S 混为一谈。正确关系是 ΔG = ΔH − TΔS：自发与否由焓和熵共同决定，熵只是其中一项，ΔS 的符号单独决定不了任何事。ΔG<0 的反应完全可以是熵减的（焓驱动，比如很多放热的成键反应）；ΔG>0 也不等于体系熵减。真正「总是增加」的是宇宙（体系+环境）的总熵，不是反应体系自身的熵。因此他这一整段里所有用「熵减」指代的地方，都应当读作「ΔG>0、非自发」——只有这样卡片才和视频对得上。
extra.en: The passage most in need of correction conflates ΔG with entropy. The correct relation is ΔG = ΔH − TΔS: spontaneity is decided jointly by enthalpy and entropy, entropy being only one term, and the sign of ΔS alone decides nothing. A reaction with ΔG < 0 may well decrease entropy (enthalpy-driven, as in many exothermic bond-forming reactions), and ΔG > 0 does not imply that the system's entropy falls. What always increases is the total entropy of the universe (system plus surroundings), not that of the reacting system. Every place he says "entropy decrease" in this passage should therefore be read as "ΔG > 0, non-spontaneous".

extra.zh: 他先顺口说「一般这个 ΔG 都是大于零的吧」，这与本讲的事实相反——糖酵解绝大多数步骤的 ΔG°′ 是小于零的。他在 00:58:14 起自己说反了回来：「其他反应基本上 ΔG 都是小于零的，只有这一步是大于零的」。按这句更正后的说法记即可，不必把前一句当成结论。
extra.en: He first remarks offhand that "ΔG is generally greater than zero", which is the opposite of the facts in this lecture, since most glycolytic steps have negative ΔG°′. He reverses himself from 00:58:14: "other reactions are basically all negative, only this one is positive". Take the corrected version and disregard the earlier remark.

extra.zh: 「只有这一步 ΔG>0」不能写成硬结论。按标准条件 ΔG°′，糖酵解中为正的不止醛缩酶一步：醛缩酶 +23.8、磷酸丙糖异构酶 +7.5、磷酸甘油酸变位酶 +4.4、烯醇化酶 +1.8 kJ/mol。他说了「基本上」，算是留了余地。真正对每一步都 ≤0 的是细胞内的实际 ΔG——因为细胞不在标准态，各中间物浓度都被下游持续拉低。
extra.en: "Only this step has ΔG > 0" should not be written down as a hard conclusion. Under standard conditions more than aldolase is positive: aldolase +23.8, triose phosphate isomerase +7.5, phosphoglycerate mutase +4.4 and enolase +1.8 kJ/mol. His "basically" leaves room. What is genuinely ≤ 0 at every step is the actual in-cell ΔG, because the cell is not at the standard state and every intermediate is held low by downstream consumption.

extra.zh: 糖酵解的不可逆步骤是三个，不是两个：己糖激酶、PFK-1，还有第 10 步的丙酮酸激酶。丙酮酸激酶不但不消耗 ATP，反而产生 ATP，所以「消耗能量所以回不去」这个理由本身也不成立——不可逆性来自实际 ΔG 大幅为负，与耗不耗能无关。这三个位点正是糖异生必须绕开、另派一套酶的三个位点（葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶、FBPase-1，以及丙酮酸羧化酶＋PEP 羧激酶）。他这时只在讲第一阶段，但「别的步骤都是可逆的」是笼统说出来的，本段内没有自我更正。
extra.en: Glycolysis has three irreversible steps, not two: hexokinase, PFK-1, and pyruvate kinase at step 10. Pyruvate kinase does not spend ATP — it makes ATP — so the rationale "it costs energy, therefore it cannot run back" fails on its own terms; irreversibility comes from a strongly negative in-cell ΔG, regardless of energy expenditure. These three sites are exactly the ones gluconeogenesis must bypass with different enzymes (glucose-6-phosphatase, FBPase-1, and pyruvate carboxylase plus PEP carboxykinase). He was discussing only phase one at this point, but "all the other steps are reversible" was stated as a generality, and he does not correct it here.

quiz.q_zh: 老师把 ΔG<0 说成「熵增」、ΔG>0 说成「熵减」。热力学上正确的关系是什么？
quiz.q_en: The teacher equated ΔG < 0 with rising entropy and ΔG > 0 with falling entropy. What is the correct relation?

options.zh: ΔG = ΔH − TΔS，熵只是一项，不单独决定自发性
options.en: ΔG = ΔH − TΔS; entropy is one term and the sign of ΔS decides nothing alone

options.zh: ΔG 就是熵变的另一种写法，二者的数值相等而符号必然相反
options.en: ΔG is just another way of writing ΔS, equal in size and opposite in sign

options.zh: 自发与否完全只由 ΔS 决定，ΔH 只影响反应达到平衡的快慢
options.en: Spontaneity depends on ΔS alone, while ΔH only sets how fast it goes

options.zh: 只要体系的熵减少，反应在任何温度下都不可能自发进行
options.en: If system entropy falls the reaction cannot be spontaneous at any temperature

quiz.explain_zh: 自发性由 ΔG 判断，而 ΔG 同时含焓项和熵项：焓驱动的放热成键反应可以在熵减的情况下 ΔG<0，温度高低还会改变 TΔS 的权重。说 ΔG 就是熵变的另一种写法，量纲都对不上——ΔG 的单位是能量，ΔS 的单位是能量除以温度。说只由 ΔS 决定，正是老师这段的错误；而 ΔH 影响的是自发性而不是速度，速度由活化能决定。说熵减在任何温度下都不能自发，忽略了 TΔS 这一项可以被足够负的 ΔH 压倒，低温下这类反应恰恰更容易发生。
quiz.explain_en: Spontaneity is judged by ΔG, which contains both an enthalpy and an entropy term: an enthalpy-driven exothermic bond-forming reaction can have ΔG < 0 while entropy falls, and temperature reweights the TΔS term. Saying ΔG is another way of writing ΔS fails on units alone — ΔG is an energy, ΔS an energy per kelvin. Making ΔS the sole criterion is precisely the error in this passage, and ΔH affects spontaneity rather than speed, which is set by activation energy. Claiming entropy loss forbids spontaneity at any temperature ignores that a sufficiently negative ΔH can outweigh TΔS, which is why such reactions are favoured at low temperature.

quiz.q_zh: 按标准条件 ΔG°′，糖酵解中哪些步骤的自由能变化为正？
quiz.q_en: Under standard conditions, which glycolytic steps have a positive ΔG°′?

options.zh: 只有醛缩酶一步，其余九步的 ΔG°′ 全部都是负值
options.en: Only aldolase; all nine remaining steps have a negative ΔG°′

options.zh: 醛缩酶、TPI、磷酸甘油酸变位酶、烯醇化酶都是正值
options.en: Aldolase, TPI, phosphoglycerate mutase and enolase are all positive

options.zh: 三个不可逆步骤，即己糖激酶、PFK-1 与丙酮酸激酶
options.en: The three irreversible steps: hexokinase, PFK-1 and pyruvate kinase

options.zh: 全部十步都为正值，靠 ATP 偶联使整体成为放能过程
options.en: All ten are positive, and ATP coupling makes the whole run exergonic

quiz.explain_zh: ΔG°′ 为正的有四步：醛缩酶 +23.8、磷酸丙糖异构酶 +7.5、磷酸甘油酸变位酶 +4.4、烯醇化酶 +1.8 kJ/mol；它们在细胞里靠下游持续抽走产物、使实际 ΔG 落到零以下而照常运行。说只有醛缩酶一步为正，是老师课上略作保留的说法，写成硬结论就错了。说三个不可逆步骤为正，恰好把符号弄反——正因为它们的 ΔG 大幅为负，才不可逆。说十步全为正也不成立：那样整条通路无论怎么偶联都不可能净产 2 ATP。
quiz.explain_en: Four steps are positive under standard conditions: aldolase +23.8, triose phosphate isomerase +7.5, phosphoglycerate mutase +4.4 and enolase +1.8 kJ/mol; in cells they run normally because downstream removal of products drives the actual ΔG below zero. Restricting the list to aldolase is the hedged version given in class and becomes wrong if written as a firm conclusion. Naming the three irreversible steps inverts the sign — they are irreversible precisely because their ΔG is strongly negative. All ten being positive is impossible, since no amount of coupling would then yield a net gain of 2 ATP.

quiz.q_zh: 老师说糖酵解只有第 1、3 步不可逆，理由是「消耗能量所以回不去」。正确的说法是？
quiz.q_en: He said only steps 1 and 3 are irreversible because "they spend energy so cannot run back". What is correct?

options.zh: 有三个，多出的是 GAPDH；不可逆源于该步产生了 NADH
options.en: Three, the extra being GAPDH, made irreversible by its NADH output

options.zh: 确实只有这两步，因为只有它们消耗 ATP，逆向无法回收
options.en: Right: only those two consume ATP and cannot be reversed in the cell

options.zh: 有四个不可逆步骤，多出的是醛缩酶和磷酸丙糖异构酶
options.en: There are four: aldolase and triose phosphate isomerase are the extras

options.zh: 有三个，还包括丙酮酸激酶；不可逆来自实际 ΔG 极负
options.en: Three — pyruvate kinase too; it comes from a very negative in-cell ΔG

quiz.explain_zh: 己糖激酶、PFK-1 和第 10 步的丙酮酸激酶都不可逆，糖异生必须用另外的酶绕开这三个位点。丙酮酸激酶不消耗 ATP 反而产生 ATP，因此「耗能所以不可逆」这个理由站不住；不可逆性来自细胞内实际 ΔG 大幅为负。把醛缩酶和 TPI 算作不可逆正好讲反——这两步的 ΔG°′ 还是正的，在细胞里接近平衡，是典型的可逆步骤。把 GAPDH 算进去也不对：它与磷酸甘油酸激酶偶联后整体接近平衡，糖异生正是沿原路返回经过它的。
quiz.explain_en: Hexokinase, PFK-1 and pyruvate kinase at step 10 are all irreversible, and gluconeogenesis must bypass these three sites with different enzymes. Pyruvate kinase produces ATP rather than consuming it, so the "it costs energy" rationale collapses; irreversibility comes from a strongly negative in-cell ΔG. Counting aldolase and TPI inverts the picture: their ΔG°′ values are positive and they sit near equilibrium in cells, the very definition of reversible. Including GAPDH is also wrong, since coupled to phosphoglycerate kinase it lies near equilibrium and gluconeogenesis runs straight back through it.

title_zh: 准备阶段收尾：不可逆步骤、六碳糖裂解与 PFK-1 限速
title_en: Closing the preparatory phase: irreversible steps, hexose cleavage, PFK-1 as the rate-limiting step

points.zh: 他把第 1 步（葡萄糖 + ATP → G6P）和第 3 步（F6P + ATP → F-1,6-BP）用箭头标成不可逆，并总结说「只有这两步是不可逆的，别的步骤都是可逆的」。
points.en: He marks step 1 (glucose + ATP to G6P) and step 3 (F6P + ATP to F-1,6-BP) with arrows as irreversible and concludes that these are the only two irreversible steps, everything else being reversible.

points.zh: 他给出的理由是：这两步在消耗能量，反应不可能倒过来把能量重新产生出来，所以不可逆。
points.en: His stated reason: both steps spend energy, and a reaction cannot run backwards and re-create that energy, therefore they are irreversible.

points.zh: 上了两个磷酸基团之后，糖在中间被裂解成两半，左边一半带一个磷酸，右边一半也带一个磷酸（他把被裂解的糖称作「五碳糖」）。
points.en: After two phosphates have been attached, the sugar is cleaved in the middle into two halves, each carrying one phosphate (he calls the cleaved sugar a pentose).

points.zh: 左边那一半（DHAP）经过「一番折腾」转变成 GAP；他说 DHAP 的结构自己看图也不太认得出来。
points.en: The left half (DHAP) is converted into GAP after some rearrangement; he admits he cannot fully read the DHAP structure off the slide.

points.zh: GAP 是整个糖酵解第二阶段的核心原料，第一阶段的任务就是把葡萄糖变成它。
points.en: GAP is the key starting material of the second phase of glycolysis; the whole job of phase one is to turn glucose into it.

points.zh: 他在图上只框出三处「重要反应」：两个不可逆的磷酸化步骤，加上 PFK-1 这一步，其余反应不必细抠。
points.en: He boxes only three reactions as important: the two irreversible phosphorylations plus the PFK-1 step; the rest need not be studied in detail.

points.zh: PFK-1 那一步是「重中之重」，因为它是整个糖酵解的限速步骤，糖酵解跑多快取决于它。
points.en: The PFK-1 step is singled out as the most important, because it is the rate-limiting step and the flux of the whole pathway depends on it.

points.zh: 限速步骤的快慢取决于身体需不需要能量，具体由 ATP/ADP 比例读出：ATP 越多代表越不需要能量，PFK 的酶活性就越受抑制。
points.en: The rate-limiting step is set by whether the body needs energy, read out from the ATP/ADP ratio: more ATP means less need, and PFK activity is inhibited accordingly.

points.zh: 他说第二个决定因素是氢离子：「你越不缺能量，你体内的氢离子浓度就越高」；其余步骤口试只要记住酶名和底物大致怎么变，建议每天默写一两步。
points.en: He names H+ as the second determinant, saying that the less energy you lack the higher your proton concentration; for the oral exam the other steps only need enzyme names and roughly how the substrate changes, written out one or two steps a day.

extra.zh: 他说「只有这两步不可逆」。实际上糖酵解有三个不可逆步骤：hexokinase（第 1 步）、PFK-1（第 3 步）和 pyruvate kinase（第 10 步）。而且丙酮酸激酶不但不耗 ATP，反而产 ATP，所以「耗能所以不可逆」这个理由本身也站不住——不可逆性来自细胞内 ΔG 大幅为负。这三步恰恰是糖异生必须绕开的三处：G6P 由 glucose-6-phosphatase 水解、F-1,6-BP 由 FBPase-1 水解、丙酮酸由 pyruvate carboxylase + PEPCK 两步绕回 PEP。本段内他没有自我更正。
extra.en: He says only these two steps are irreversible. Glycolysis has three: hexokinase (1), PFK-1 (3) and pyruvate kinase (10). Pyruvate kinase makes ATP rather than spending it, so his reasoning (energy-consuming therefore irreversible) also fails; irreversibility comes from a strongly negative in-cell delta-G. These three are exactly the steps gluconeogenesis must bypass: glucose-6-phosphatase, FBPase-1, and the pyruvate carboxylase plus PEPCK detour. He does not correct himself within this stretch.

extra.zh: 他把被醛缩酶切开的糖叫「五碳糖」。醛缩酶的底物是果糖-1,6-二磷酸，六碳糖（hexose），在 C3—C4 之间断开，得到两个三碳产物 DHAP 与 GAP。3 + 3 = 6 的算术只有在六碳时才成立。同一堂课里他多次把葡萄糖、果糖、F-1,6-BP 说成五碳糖，指的其实是环上有 5 个碳（吡喃环）或成的是五元环（呋喃环），不是碳数。
extra.en: He calls the cleaved sugar a pentose. Aldolase acts on fructose-1,6-bisphosphate, a hexose, cutting between C3 and C4 to give the two three-carbon products DHAP and GAP; 3 + 3 = 6 only works for a hexose. Elsewhere in the lecture he makes the same slip, meaning either the five ring carbons of a pyranose or the five-membered furanose ring, not the carbon count.

extra.zh: 「越不缺能量，氢离子浓度越高」这条因果链是反的。PFK-1 确实被 H+（低 pH）抑制，但生理上胞质酸化来自剧烈无氧糖酵解产生乳酸，也就是能量紧缺的时候；低 pH 关小 PFK-1 是防止乳酸酸中毒的负反馈。能被用来合成 ATP 的质子梯度在线粒体内膜两侧，与胞质 pH 是两个完全不同的 H+ 池。
extra.en: The causal chain is reversed. PFK-1 is indeed inhibited by H+ (low pH), but cytosolic acidification comes from lactate produced by hard anaerobic glycolysis, i.e. when energy is short; low pH throttling PFK-1 is negative feedback against lactic acidosis. The proton gradient that can make ATP sits across the inner mitochondrial membrane and is a different proton pool from cytosolic pH.

extra.zh: 课上只给了 ATP/ADP 和 H+ 两个信号，漏掉了体内最强的 PFK-1 变构激活剂：果糖-2,6-二磷酸（F-2,6-BP）。它由双功能酶 PFK-2/FBPase-2 生成和降解，胰高血糖素经 PKA 磷酸化这个双功能酶使 F-2,6-BP 下降，于是糖酵解关小、糖异生打开。此外 AMP 激活 PFK-1、柠檬酸抑制 PFK-1，都是标准考点。
extra.en: Only ATP/ADP and H+ are given; the strongest physiological allosteric activator of PFK-1, fructose-2,6-bisphosphate, is not mentioned. It is made and destroyed by the bifunctional PFK-2/FBPase-2; glucagon acting through PKA phosphorylates that enzyme, F-2,6-BP falls, glycolysis is throttled and gluconeogenesis opens. AMP activates and citrate inhibits PFK-1 as well.

quiz.q_zh: 糖酵解中真正不可逆、也正是糖异生必须绕开的是哪一组步骤？
quiz.q_en: Which set of glycolytic steps is genuinely irreversible and must be bypassed in gluconeogenesis?

options.zh: 己糖激酶、PFK-1、丙酮酸激酶这三步
options.en: hexokinase, PFK-1 and pyruvate kinase

options.zh: PFK-1、GAPDH、丙酮酸激酶这三步
options.en: PFK-1, GAPDH and pyruvate kinase alone

options.zh: 己糖激酶、醛缩酶、烯醇化酶这三步
options.en: hexokinase, aldolase and enolase

options.zh: 己糖激酶与 PFK-1 这两步，别的都可逆
options.en: hexokinase and PFK-1 only, no others

quiz.explain_zh: 不可逆的是己糖激酶、PFK-1 和丙酮酸激酶，糖异生分别用 glucose-6-phosphatase、FBPase-1 和 pyruvate carboxylase + PEPCK 绕开。醛缩酶与烯醇化酶在细胞内接近平衡、可双向使用，糖异生直接沿用同一个酶；GAPDH 同样是可逆的共用步骤。只数两步会漏掉丙酮酸激酶，而它恰恰说明「不可逆」不等于「耗 ATP」——它是产 ATP 的。
quiz.explain_en: The irreversible steps are hexokinase, PFK-1 and pyruvate kinase, bypassed respectively by glucose-6-phosphatase, FBPase-1 and pyruvate carboxylase plus PEPCK. Aldolase and enolase sit near equilibrium and gluconeogenesis reuses them, as it reuses GAPDH. Counting only two steps drops pyruvate kinase, which is precisely the case showing irreversibility is not the same as spending ATP: that step makes ATP.

quiz.q_zh: PFK-1 被 H+ 抑制，其真实的生理意义是什么？
quiz.q_en: PFK-1 is inhibited by protons. What is the actual physiological point of that?

options.zh: 胞质 H+ 可直接被用来合成 ATP，越多说明能荷越高
options.en: Cytosolic protons are converted directly into ATP yield

options.zh: H+ 由三羧酸循环产生后回流胞质，报告代谢充足
options.en: Protons leak back from the TCA cycle to signal plenty

options.zh: H+ 与 ATP 争夺 PFK-1 活性位点，属竞争性抑制
options.en: Protons compete with ATP for the PFK-1 active site

options.zh: 乳酸堆积使胞质酸化，负反馈关小酵解以防酸中毒
options.en: Lactate acidifies the cytosol, throttling glycolysis

quiz.explain_zh: 低 pH 来自无氧酵解产乳酸，酸化反过来关小 PFK-1，限制通量、防止乳酸酸中毒。胞质 H+ 不能被拿去合成 ATP，能合成 ATP 的是线粒体内膜两侧的质子动力势；TCA 循环也不会把质子送回胞质来做反馈信号；H+ 抑制 PFK-1 是通过改变酶的质子化状态与变构性质，而不是和 ATP 抢同一个活性位点（ATP 本身是在别构位点上抑制的）。
quiz.explain_en: Low pH comes from lactate made by anaerobic glycolysis, and the acidification throttles PFK-1 to prevent lactic acidosis. Cytosolic protons cannot be spent on ATP synthesis; that is the job of the proton-motive force across the inner mitochondrial membrane. The TCA cycle does not return protons to the cytosol as a feedback signal, and proton inhibition works through protonation and allosteric state, not by competing with ATP at the active site (ATP itself inhibits at an allosteric site).

quiz.q_zh: 醛缩酶（aldolase）催化的裂解，底物和产物分别是什么？
quiz.q_en: In the aldolase reaction, what is cleaved and what is produced?

options.zh: F-1,6-BP 裂解成三碳的 GAP 与 DHAP
options.en: F-1,6-BP is cleaved between C3 and C4

options.zh: 六碳糖被切成两个二碳单位，同时脱去一分子 CO2
options.en: the hexose is split into two C2 units plus CO2

options.zh: 五碳的 F-1,6-BP 裂解成 GAP 与二碳的 DHAP
options.en: a pentose is split into a C3 GAP and a C2 DHAP

options.zh: 六碳的 G6P 在 C3—C4 之间裂解成两分子 GAP
options.en: G6P is cleaved between C3 and C4 into two GAP

quiz.explain_zh: 底物是六碳的果糖-1,6-二磷酸，在 C3—C4 之间发生逆羟醛缩合，得到三碳的 GAP 和三碳的 DHAP，两者都带一个磷酸。说成五碳糖与算术不符（3+3=6）；DHAP 是三碳不是二碳；被切的也不是 G6P，G6P 还没有第二个磷酸，而且两个产物并不相同，DHAP 要由磷酸丙糖异构酶再转成 GAP；裂解过程不脱 CO2，糖酵解全程不放 CO2。
quiz.explain_en: The substrate is the hexose fructose-1,6-bisphosphate, cut between C3 and C4 by a retro-aldol reaction into GAP and DHAP, each with one phosphate. Calling it a pentose contradicts the arithmetic (3+3=6); DHAP is a three-carbon, not a two-carbon, compound; the substrate is not G6P, which lacks the second phosphate, and the two products are not identical since DHAP still needs triose phosphate isomerase; no CO2 is lost anywhere in glycolysis.

title_zh: 【可跳过·非课程内容】结构生物学工具与一篇人工设计水解酶文章的闲聊
title_en: [Skippable · not course material] Chat about structural-biology tools and a designed-hydrolase paper

points.zh: 学生说老板布置了一个任务：从一段 DNA 序列出发得到蛋白的三维结构，再做比对。
points.en: The student describes a task from her supervisor: start from a DNA sequence, get to the protein's 3D structure, then run a comparison.

points.zh: 任务的后半段是用 PyMOL 做结构比对，把相互交联/接触的部分全部标出来。
points.en: The second half of the task is a structural comparison in PyMOL, marking all the interacting or cross-linked parts.

points.zh: 老师由此想到蛋白结构预测与设计领域的 David Baker。
points.en: That reminds the teacher of David Baker in protein structure prediction and design.

points.zh: 他提到 Baker 组一篇「人工设计水解酶」的文章，说是与一位中国学者合作的。
points.en: He mentions a designed-hydrolase paper from the Baker group, said to be a collaboration with a Chinese scientist.

points.zh: 他描述这项工作是比对 PDB 数据库里所有丝氨酸水解酶催化三联体 catalytic triad 的结构特征。
points.en: He describes the work as surveying the catalytic-triad structural features of all serine hydrolases in the PDB.

points.zh: 他说作者做了一个小工具：给定一段蛋白序列（可以自己反推成 DNA/RNA 序列），就能在数据库里比对相似的二级结构。
points.en: He says the authors built a small tool: give it a protein sequence (which you can back-translate to DNA/RNA yourself) and it searches the database for similar secondary structure.

points.zh: 他翻到文章方法部分，提到用了 Biopython 之类的包和一个 ensemble PDB package，说自己常用这两个工具、之后可以教学生，并建议她读这篇文章。
points.en: Looking at the methods, he points out Biopython and an ensemble PDB package, says he uses these often and can teach her later, and recommends she read the paper.

extra.zh: 文章与作者姓名是口头提到的，视频里没有给出题目、期刊和年份（他自己也说不准是「去年还是前年的 Science」）。做笔记时不要把这条当成可引用的文献，需要自己到 PubMed/Google Scholar 上核对后再引。
extra.en: The paper and the collaborator's name are only mentioned in passing; no title, journal or year is given on screen and he is unsure whether it was Science last year or the year before. Do not treat this as a citable reference without checking it yourself on PubMed or Google Scholar.

extra.zh: 「把蛋白序列反推成 DNA/RNA 序列再去比对」这一步在结构比对里并不需要。序列到结构的常规流程是：蛋白序列 → AlphaFold2/3、ESMFold 预测或 PDB 里已有的坐标 → 用 PyMOL 的 align/super 或 TM-align 做叠合，报告 RMSD 和 TM-score。而且遗传密码简并，反推核酸序列本身也不唯一。
extra.en: Back-translating the protein to DNA/RNA is not a step in structure comparison. The standard route is protein sequence, then predicted coordinates from AlphaFold2/3 or ESMFold (or an existing PDB entry), then superposition with PyMOL align/super or TM-align, reporting RMSD and TM-score. Back-translation is also non-unique because the genetic code is degenerate.

extra.zh: 顺便复习他提到的催化三联体：丝氨酸水解酶用 Ser-His-Asp，His 作通用碱夺走 Ser 的羟基质子，Ser 的烷氧负离子亲核进攻底物羰基，Asp 通过氢键把 His 的咪唑环定向并稳定其正电中间体；四面体中间体由主链酰胺 NH 组成的氧负离子洞 oxyanion hole 稳定。半胱氨酸蛋白酶换成 Cys-His-Asn，苏氨酸蛋白酶用 Thr，机理骨架相同。
extra.en: A reminder on the catalytic triad he mentions: serine hydrolases use Ser-His-Asp. His acts as general base and deprotonates the serine hydroxyl, the resulting alkoxide attacks the substrate carbonyl, and Asp hydrogen-bonds the histidine imidazole to orient it and stabilise its protonated form; the tetrahedral intermediate is held by an oxyanion hole of backbone amide NH groups. Cysteine proteases use Cys-His-Asn and threonine proteases use Thr, on the same mechanistic skeleton.

quiz.q_zh: 丝氨酸水解酶的催化三联体由哪三个残基组成？
quiz.q_en: Which three residues make up the catalytic triad of a serine hydrolase?

options.zh: 丝氨酸、组氨酸、天冬氨酸（Ser-His-Asp）
options.en: serine, histidine and aspartate (Ser-His-Asp)

options.zh: 丝氨酸、赖氨酸、天冬酰胺（Ser-Lys-Asn）
options.en: serine, lysine and asparagine (Ser-Lys-Asn)

options.zh: 苏氨酸、组氨酸与天冬氨酸三者（Thr-His-Asp）
options.en: threonine, histidine and aspartate (Thr-His-Asp)

options.zh: 半胱氨酸、组氨酸、谷氨酸（Cys-His-Glu）
options.en: cysteine, histidine and glutamate (Cys-His-Glu)

quiz.explain_zh: 丝氨酸水解酶（胰凝乳蛋白酶、胰蛋白酶、乙酰胆碱酯酶等）用 Ser-His-Asp：Asp 稳定 His，His 夺质子，Ser 亲核。Cys-His-Asn 是木瓜蛋白酶那一类半胱氨酸蛋白酶的三联体，亲核基团是巯基而不是羟基；Thr 作亲核残基见于蛋白酶体的苏氨酸蛋白酶，用的是 N 端 Thr 而不是这套三联体；Ser-Lys 二联体确实存在于某些 β-内酰胺酶和 LexA 类蛋白酶，但那是二联体，且不含 Asn 作第三个成员。
quiz.explain_en: Serine hydrolases (chymotrypsin, trypsin, acetylcholinesterase) use Ser-His-Asp: Asp orients and stabilises His, His deprotonates, Ser attacks. Cys-His-Asn is the papain-type cysteine protease triad with a thiolate nucleophile. Threonine proteases such as the proteasome use an N-terminal Thr, not this triad. Ser-Lys dyads do occur in some beta-lactamases and LexA-type proteases, but they are dyads and do not include an asparagine.

quiz.q_zh: 要把一段蛋白序列和数据库中的已知结构做比较，标准做法是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the standard route from a protein sequence to a comparison against known structures?

options.zh: 先反推 DNA 序列，在核酸层面比对以判断结构相似性
options.en: back-translate to DNA and compare at the nucleic level

options.zh: 用 PyMOL 直接比较两条一级序列的字母得到叠合
options.en: let PyMOL compare the two letter strings directly

options.zh: 比较两者的 Km 与 kcat，动力学相近即折叠相同
options.en: compare Km and kcat, similar kinetics means same fold

options.zh: 先获得三维坐标，再用 TM-align 做结构叠合
options.en: get or predict coordinates, then superpose them

quiz.explain_zh: 结构比对必须在三维坐标层面进行：先从 PDB 取实验结构或用 AlphaFold/ESMFold 预测，再用 PyMOL 的 align/super 或 TM-align 叠合并给出 RMSD、TM-score。反推核酸序列既不唯一也不含结构信息；PyMOL 的 align 虽然会用到序列信息，但它比的是坐标而不是字母串，单纯比一级序列只能得到同源性而非叠合；动力学参数反映功能条件，折叠完全不同的酶也可以有相近的 Km。
quiz.explain_en: Structure comparison happens on coordinates: take an experimental structure from the PDB or predict one with AlphaFold or ESMFold, then superpose with PyMOL align/super or TM-align and report RMSD and TM-score. Back-translation is non-unique and carries no structural information. PyMOL's align does use sequence internally but operates on coordinates; comparing letter strings alone gives homology, not a superposition. Kinetic constants reflect conditions and substrates, and enzymes with unrelated folds can share a similar Km.

title_zh: 第二阶段（放能相）开始：GAPDH 与「脱氢酶」这个名字
title_en: The payoff phase begins: GAPDH and the word dehydrogenase

points.zh: 他回到糖酵解，说第二阶段有个名字叫「放能阶段」。
points.en: He returns to glycolysis and introduces the second phase by its name, the energy-releasing (payoff) phase.

points.zh: 理由是：第一阶段完全在消耗能量，用人体自身的 ATP 去把葡萄糖拆开；第二阶段才是真正的产能阶段。
points.en: His reason: phase one only spends energy, using the body's own ATP to take glucose apart, while phase two is where energy is actually produced.

points.zh: 放能相第一步以 GAP 为原料，被氧化成 1,3-二磷酸甘油酸。
points.en: The first step of the payoff phase takes GAP as substrate and oxidises it to 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate.

points.zh: 他提醒这一段开始「很绕」，所以要一步一步把结构画出来：先画 GAP，再用黑色箭头往下走。
points.en: He warns that this stretch gets convoluted and draws the structures step by step, starting from GAP with a black arrow.

points.zh: 这是第 6 个酶，中文名 GAP 脱氢酶，英文 glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase（GAPDH）。
points.en: This is enzyme number 6, glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase, GAPDH.

points.zh: 他说中文「脱氢酶」这个叫法很迷惑人：「你看这不是一个氧上来了吗」，这种过程一般叫氧化，他觉得叫「GAP 氧化酶」更合适。
points.en: He finds the name confusing: an oxygen has been added, and we would normally call that oxidation, so in his view GAP oxidase would be a better name.

points.zh: 他查过英文名同样是 dehydrogenase，所以最后还是按 GAP 脱氢酶记。
points.en: He checks that the English name is also dehydrogenase, so the name is kept as it is.

points.zh: 脱的氢是醛基上的那个氢；脱掉一分子氢的同时，这个位置又上了一分子磷酸基团，他强调这是「比较奇怪的点」，所以要画出来才好记。
points.en: The hydrogen removed is the one on the aldehyde group; at the same position a phosphate group is added, which he flags as the odd feature of this step and draws out explicitly.

points.zh: 画法：把羰基氧挪到上边，横着再接一个磷酸基团，并把新加的磷酸单独圈出来、换成蓝色，表示这是第二个磷酸。
points.en: In the drawing he moves the carbonyl oxygen up, attaches the phosphate horizontally, circles the new phosphate and switches it to blue to mark it as the second one.

extra.zh: 「你看这不是一个氧上来了吗」容易让人以为是加氧酶反应。这一步新增的氧来自游离的无机磷酸 Pi，不是来自 O2 或水；被拿走的是醛基碳上的氢负离子，交给 NAD+。总反应是 GAP + Pi + NAD+ ⇌ 1,3-BPG + NADH + H+，全程不涉及分子氧，所以在无氧条件下照样能跑。
extra.en: Saying an oxygen has come in invites the idea of an oxygenase. The added oxygen comes from free inorganic phosphate, not from O2 or water, and what is removed is a hydride from the aldehyde carbon, handed to NAD+. The overall reaction, GAP + Pi + NAD+ to 1,3-BPG + NADH + H+, involves no molecular oxygen, which is why it still runs anaerobically.

extra.zh: 真实机理值得记：活性位点 Cys 的巯基先与醛基加成生成硫代半缩醛，NAD+ 从这个中间体上夺走氢负离子，把它氧化成高能硫酯（酰基–酶中间体），随后无机磷酸亲核进攻硫酯发生磷酸解，生成 1,3-BPG 并把酶释放出来。关键在于氧化释放的自由能没有散成热，而是被「存」进了酰基磷酸键里。碘乙酸就是烷基化这个 Cys 而抑制 GAPDH 的经典试剂。
extra.en: The real mechanism is worth memorising: the active-site cysteine thiol adds to the aldehyde to give a thiohemiacetal, NAD+ removes a hydride to oxidise it to a high-energy thioester (the acyl-enzyme), and inorganic phosphate then attacks that thioester in a phosphorolysis, releasing 1,3-BPG and free enzyme. The point is that the free energy of oxidation is not lost as heat but trapped in the acyl phosphate bond. Iodoacetate is the classic inhibitor, alkylating that cysteine.

extra.zh: 这是糖酵解中唯一一步把游离的无机磷酸直接装进底物的反应（另一处磷酸都来自 ATP）。产物 1,3-BPG 是酰基磷酸（混合酸酐），水解 ΔG°′ 约 −49.3 kJ/mol，明显大于 ATP 的 −30.5 kJ/mol，所以下一步才有能力把磷酸推到 ADP 上去。GAPDH 这一步本身 ΔG°′ 约 +6.3 kJ/mol，是被下游拉着走的。
extra.en: This is the only glycolytic step that incorporates free inorganic phosphate directly into the substrate; every other phosphate comes from ATP. The product 1,3-BPG is an acyl phosphate (a mixed anhydride) whose hydrolysis has a standard free energy near -49.3 kJ/mol, well above the -30.5 kJ/mol of ATP, which is what makes the next step possible. The GAPDH step itself is about +6.3 kJ/mol and is pulled along by what follows.

extra.zh: 酶的命名按电子受体分：dehydrogenase 把氢/电子交给 NAD+、NADP+ 或 FAD；oxidase 以 O2 为最终电子受体（产物是 H2O 或 H2O2，如细胞色素 c 氧化酶、葡萄糖氧化酶）；oxygenase 才把氧原子真正装进底物（单加氧酶如 P450 装一个，双加氧酶装两个）。GAPDH 是不折不扣的 dehydrogenase，改叫氧化酶反而错。
extra.en: The naming follows the electron acceptor. A dehydrogenase passes hydrogen or electrons to NAD+, NADP+ or FAD; an oxidase uses O2 as the terminal acceptor, giving water or hydrogen peroxide (cytochrome c oxidase, glucose oxidase); an oxygenase actually inserts oxygen atoms into the substrate (one for a monooxygenase such as P450, two for a dioxygenase). GAPDH is a dehydrogenase in the strict sense, and renaming it an oxidase would be wrong.

quiz.q_zh: GAPDH 这一步中，新接到底物上的那个磷酸/氧来自哪里？
quiz.q_en: In the GAPDH step, where does the newly attached phosphate come from?

options.zh: 来自游离的无机磷酸 Pi，不是来自 O2 或水
options.en: from free inorganic phosphate, not from O2

options.zh: 来自 ATP 的 γ 磷酸，由激酶活性直接转移
options.en: from the gamma phosphate of ATP, via kinase

options.zh: 来自 O2 分子，属于加氧酶 oxygenase 反应
options.en: from molecular O2, as in an oxygenase step

options.zh: 来自 NAD+ 携带的磷酸基团，随氢一起交换过去
options.en: from a phosphate carried in by NAD+ itself

quiz.explain_zh: GAP + Pi + NAD+ ⇌ 1,3-BPG + NADH + H+，磷酸来自胞质中游离的无机磷酸，这是糖酵解里唯一一处不动用 ATP 就装上磷酸的地方。若来自 ATP，这一步就要耗能，和「放能相」的定位矛盾；反应不需要分子氧，所以无氧条件下照样进行，谈不上加氧酶；NAD+ 分子里虽然含磷酸，但它只做氢负离子的受体，磷酸部分不参与转移。
quiz.explain_en: The reaction is GAP + Pi + NAD+ to 1,3-BPG + NADH + H+, and the phosphate is free cytosolic Pi, the only phosphate in glycolysis attached without spending ATP. If it came from ATP the step would cost energy, contradicting its place in the payoff phase. No molecular oxygen is involved, which is why the step runs anaerobically and is not an oxygenase reaction. NAD+ does contain phosphates, but it acts purely as the hydride acceptor and transfers none of them.

quiz.q_zh: GAPDH 催化过程的正确化学顺序是？
quiz.q_en: What is the correct chemical sequence in GAPDH catalysis?

options.zh: NAD+ 先把醛氧化成羧酸，Pi 再与羧酸脱水成酸酐
options.en: NAD+ makes the acid first, then Pi forms an anhydride

options.zh: Cys 巯基加成成硫代半缩醛，氧化成硫酯再被磷酸解
options.en: Cys forms a thiohemiacetal, oxidised to a thioester

options.zh: His 先与醛基形成席夫碱，Pi 再取代席夫碱得到产物
options.en: His forms a Schiff base that Pi then displaces

options.zh: Pi 先亲核进攻醛基生成磷酸半缩醛，再由 NAD+ 氧化
options.en: Pi attacks the aldehyde first, then NAD+ oxidises it

quiz.explain_zh: 顺序是：活性位点 Cys 巯基加成到醛基上生成硫代半缩醛 → NAD+ 夺走氢负离子，中间体氧化成高能硫酯 → 无机磷酸进攻硫酯发生磷酸解，放出 1,3-BPG。让 Pi 先加到醛上得不到高能中间体，氧化的能量就白白散掉；先氧化成游离羧酸同样是不可逆的能量泄漏，之后再脱水成酸酐反而要额外供能；席夫碱（赖氨酸参与）是醛缩酶 I 类的机理，不是 GAPDH 的。
quiz.explain_en: The order is: the active-site cysteine adds to the aldehyde forming a thiohemiacetal, NAD+ removes a hydride to oxidise it to a high-energy thioester, and inorganic phosphate then attacks that thioester to release 1,3-BPG. Adding Pi to the aldehyde first gives no high-energy intermediate and wastes the energy of oxidation. Oxidising to a free carboxylic acid also throws the energy away, and dehydrating it back to an anhydride would then need energy put in. A Schiff base with lysine is the class I aldolase mechanism, not this one.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么这个酶叫 dehydrogenase 而不是 oxidase？
quiz.q_en: Why is this enzyme a dehydrogenase rather than an oxidase?

options.zh: 因为它把底物上的氧脱掉，方向与氧化酶相反
options.en: because it removes oxygen, the reverse of an oxidase

options.zh: 因为氢交给 NAD+ 而不是交给 O2
options.en: because the hydride is passed to NAD+, not O2

options.zh: 因为它只在无氧条件下工作，有氧时由氧化酶接手
options.en: because it only works anaerobically, oxidase aerobically

options.zh: 因为它需要 Mg2+，而氧化酶都以血红素铁为辅因子
options.en: because it needs Mg2+ while oxidases use heme iron

quiz.explain_zh: 命名依据是电子受体：氢（以氢负离子形式）交给 NAD+ 的叫脱氢酶，以 O2 为最终受体的才叫氧化酶。这一步不脱氧反而加了含氧的磷酸基团；GAPDH 在有氧无氧条件下都是同一个酶催化同一步，只是 NAD+ 的再生方式不同，并没有一个氧化酶来「接手」；辅因子也不是判据，GAPDH 不需要 Mg2+，而氧化酶里含黄素的（如葡萄糖氧化酶）并不含血红素。
quiz.explain_en: The name follows the electron acceptor: hydride to NAD+ makes it a dehydrogenase, while an oxidase hands electrons to O2. Nothing is deoxygenated here; an oxygen-bearing phosphate is added. The same enzyme catalyses the same step with or without oxygen, only NAD+ regeneration differs, so no oxidase takes over. Cofactors are not the criterion either: GAPDH needs no Mg2+, and flavin oxidases such as glucose oxidase contain no heme.

title_zh: 1,3-BPG 的生成：产能第一步、NAD+ → NADH 与游离 H+ 的来源
title_en: Making 1,3-BPG: the first energy-yielding step, NAD+ to NADH, and where the free proton comes from

points.zh: 他把新加的那个磷酸单独换成蓝色，代表这是分子上的第二个磷酸，便于和 C3 位原有的磷酸区分。
points.en: He recolours the new phosphate blue to mark it as the second phosphate on the molecule, distinct from the one already at C3.

points.zh: 他用深蓝色把这一步圈出来，标注为「产能的第一步」——前面画的两步都是在消耗能量。
points.en: He circles the step in dark blue and labels it the first energy-producing step, in contrast to the two energy-consuming steps drawn earlier.

points.zh: 产的能来自一个辅酶 NAD+：它把脱下来的那一分子氢接收走，变成 NADH。
points.en: The energy comes out as NADH: the coenzyme NAD+ accepts the hydrogen removed in the reaction.

points.zh: 他复习 NAD 的来源：NAD 属于维生素 B 家族，维生素 B3 就是维生素 PP，是 NAD 的组成部分。
points.en: He revisits where NAD comes from: it belongs to the B-vitamin family, vitamin B3 (vitamin PP) being its building block.

points.zh: 他补充说 VB3 再加上别的一些部件，共同组成 NAD 这「一大坨东西」。
points.en: He adds that vitamin B3 plus some further pieces together make up the whole NAD molecule.

points.zh: 他说反应里那个游离的氢来自磷酸分子上原本带的氢：磷酸接到底物上时少了一个氢，所以这个氢被释放成游离的。
points.en: He says the free proton comes from a hydrogen originally on the phosphate: when phosphate attaches to the substrate it loses one, and that hydrogen is set free.

points.zh: 结论是这个反应过程生成了一分子 NADH。
points.en: The conclusion is that the reaction generates one molecule of NADH.

points.zh: 他说 NADH 在之后的电子传递链里会产生 2.5 分子 ATP，所以这一步算作产能过程。
points.en: He states that NADH will yield 2.5 ATP later in the electron transport chain, which is why this counts as an energy-producing step.

extra.zh: 「游离的 H+ 来自磷酸自带的氢」是配平上的记账说法，不是机理。生理 pH 下无机磷酸以 HPO4^2- 进入反应；机理上 NAD+ 拿走的是醛基碳上的氢负离子（H-，氢核带两个电子），而释放到溶液里的那个 H+ 来自酶–底物硫代半缩醛中间体的羟基。方程式 GAP + Pi + NAD+ → 1,3-BPG + NADH + H+ 两边配平没问题，但不能据此说这个质子「是磷酸上的」。
extra.en: Attributing the free proton to a hydrogen carried in on phosphate is bookkeeping, not mechanism. At physiological pH inorganic phosphate enters as HPO4(2-). Mechanistically NAD+ takes a hydride (hydrogen with both electrons) from the aldehyde carbon, and the proton released into solution comes from the hydroxyl of the enzyme-bound thiohemiacetal intermediate. The equation GAP + Pi + NAD+ to 1,3-BPG + NADH + H+ balances, but that does not make the proton a phosphate proton.

extra.zh: 记账要按每分子葡萄糖算：一分子葡萄糖裂解出两分子三碳糖，所以这一步产 2 分子 NADH。另外 2.5 ATP/NADH 是线粒体基质中 NADH 的现代共识值，而糖酵解产的 NADH 在胞质，NADH 本身过不了线粒体内膜，必须靠穿梭系统：苹果酸–天冬氨酸穿梭把还原当量送成基质 NADH，仍约 2.5 ATP；甘油-3-磷酸穿梭交给 FAD 层次，只有约 1.5 ATP。所以每分子葡萄糖有氧氧化的总产率会写成 30 或 32 ATP 两个版本。
extra.en: Count per glucose: one glucose gives two trioses, so this step produces two NADH. The 2.5 ATP per NADH figure is the modern consensus for NADH in the mitochondrial matrix, but glycolytic NADH is cytosolic and cannot cross the inner membrane. The malate-aspartate shuttle delivers reducing equivalents as matrix NADH, still about 2.5 ATP; the glycerol-3-phosphate shuttle feeds them in at the FAD level for about 1.5. This is why total aerobic yield per glucose is quoted as either 30 or 32 ATP.

extra.zh: NAD+/NADH 与 NADP+/NADPH 结构上只差腺苷核糖 2′ 位的一个磷酸，分工却几乎不重叠：NAD+ 收电子，服务分解代谢产能；NADPH 给电子，服务还原性生物合成（脂肪酸、胆固醇合成）与抗氧化（谷胱甘肽还原酶）。细胞把 NAD+/NADH 维持在高度氧化态、NADP+/NADPH 维持在高度还原态，多数酶严格识别其中一种。VB3（烟酸/烟酰胺）缺乏导致糙皮病 pellagra，典型三 D：皮炎 dermatitis、腹泻 diarrhoea、痴呆 dementia。
extra.en: NAD+/NADH and NADP+/NADPH differ by a single phosphate at the 2' position of the adenosine ribose, yet their roles barely overlap: NAD+ collects electrons for catabolic energy production, NADPH donates them for reductive biosynthesis (fatty acids, cholesterol) and antioxidant defence (glutathione reductase). The cell keeps the NAD pool oxidised and the NADP pool reduced, and most enzymes discriminate strictly. Vitamin B3 deficiency causes pellagra, with its three Ds: dermatitis, diarrhoea, dementia.

extra.zh: 这一步真正的瓶颈是 NAD+ 必须被再生：细胞里 NAD 总量很小，若 NADH 不被氧化回 NAD+，GAPDH 立刻停摆，整条糖酵解跟着停。有氧时靠穿梭系统 + 电子传递链完成；无氧时靠乳酸脱氢酶把丙酮酸还原成乳酸（或酵母经乙醛→乙醇）。发酵存在的意义不是产能——它一分子 ATP 都不多产——而是再生 NAD+ 让第 6 步能继续。
extra.en: The real bottleneck here is NAD+ regeneration. The cellular NAD pool is small, so if NADH is not reoxidised, GAPDH stalls and the whole pathway with it. Aerobically this is done by the shuttles plus the electron transport chain; anaerobically, lactate dehydrogenase reduces pyruvate to lactate (or yeast goes via acetaldehyde to ethanol). Fermentation exists not to make ATP, since it makes none extra, but to regenerate NAD+ so step 6 can keep running.

quiz.q_zh: 在 GAP + Pi + NAD+ → 1,3-BPG + NADH + H+ 中，NAD+ 直接接收的是什么？
quiz.q_en: In GAP + Pi + NAD+ to 1,3-BPG + NADH + H+, what does NAD+ actually accept?

options.zh: 一个完整的氢分子 H2，随后在辅酶上被裂解
options.en: a whole H2 molecule, later split on the coenzyme

options.zh: 醛基碳上的氢负离子 H-，即氢带两个电子
options.en: a hydride from the aldehyde carbon, H with 2e-

options.zh: 磷酸上原本带的那个质子，随磷酸接上时释放
options.en: the proton released as phosphate becomes attached

options.zh: 羟基上的一个孤对电子，配位后把氢一起带走
options.en: a lone pair from the hydroxyl, dragging H along

quiz.explain_zh: 烟酰胺环 C4 位接收的是氢负离子 H-（一个氢核加两个电子），这是所有 NAD 依赖脱氢酶的共同化学。方程右边那个游离 H+ 是另一回事，来自酶–底物中间体的羟基，把它说成磷酸自带的氢只是配平记账；孤对电子转移属于配位/亲核化学，不构成氧化还原当量的传递；生物体系中没有游离 H2 参与脱氢酶反应，那需要氢化酶 hydrogenase 才行。
quiz.explain_en: The nicotinamide C4 receives a hydride, one proton with two electrons, and this is the common chemistry of every NAD-dependent dehydrogenase. The free proton on the right side of the equation is a separate matter, coming from the hydroxyl of the enzyme-bound intermediate; assigning it to phosphate is only bookkeeping. Donating a lone pair is coordination chemistry, not transfer of a reducing equivalent, and free H2 plays no part in dehydrogenase reactions, which would require a hydrogenase.

quiz.q_zh: 胞质 NADH 经甘油-3-磷酸穿梭进入线粒体后，每分子大约产多少 ATP？
quiz.q_en: How much ATP does one cytosolic NADH yield via the glycerol-3-phosphate shuttle?

options.zh: 约 3.5，因为穿梭过程本身还额外产一分子
options.en: about 3.5, the shuttle itself adds one more ATP

options.zh: 0，穿梭只负责搬运，不产生任何 ATP
options.en: zero, the shuttle only moves, it makes no ATP

options.zh: 约 2.5，与线粒体基质中的 NADH 完全相同
options.en: about 2.5, the same as matrix NADH would give

options.zh: 约 1.5，电子进入的是 FADH2 层次
options.en: about 1.5, electrons enter at the FAD level

quiz.explain_zh: 甘油-3-磷酸穿梭把还原当量交给内膜上的 FAD 依赖甘油-3-磷酸脱氢酶，电子经 Q 库进入，绕过复合体 I，泵出的质子少，因此约 1.5 ATP。约 2.5 是苹果酸–天冬氨酸穿梭（把还原当量还原成基质 NADH）或基质自产 NADH 的产率；穿梭本身不产 ATP，也不会让产率超过 NADH 的上限；说完全不产 ATP 则与整条氧化磷酸化的存在矛盾——还原当量确实被送进了呼吸链。
quiz.explain_en: The glycerol-3-phosphate shuttle hands reducing equivalents to an FAD-dependent dehydrogenase on the inner membrane, so electrons enter through the Q pool and bypass complex I, pumping fewer protons: about 1.5 ATP. The 2.5 figure belongs to the malate-aspartate shuttle, which regenerates matrix NADH, or to NADH made in the matrix. The shuttle makes no ATP of its own and cannot exceed the NADH ceiling, and saying it yields nothing contradicts the fact that the electrons do reach the respiratory chain.

quiz.q_zh: NAD+/NADH 与 NADP+/NADPH 在代谢中的分工是什么？
quiz.q_en: How are the roles of NAD(H) and NADP(H) divided in metabolism?

options.zh: NADPH 比 NAD+ 多一个腺嘌呤，电位因此更高
options.en: NADPH carries an extra adenine, so its potential is higher

options.zh: NAD+ 收电子供产能，NADPH 供还原性生物合成
options.en: NAD+ takes electrons for catabolic ATP production

options.zh: 两者完全可以互换，细胞按浓度高低随机选用一种
options.en: they are interchangeable, chosen by concentration

options.zh: NADPH 主要供给电子传递链，NAD+ 只用于糖酵解
options.en: NADPH feeds the chain, NAD+ serves only glycolysis

quiz.explain_zh: 细胞把 NAD 池维持在氧化态用于分解代谢收电子，把 NADP 池维持在还原态用于脂肪酸/胆固醇合成和谷胱甘肽还原等。两者不可互换，多数脱氢酶严格识别 2′ 位有没有那个磷酸；进入电子传递链的是 NADH 而不是 NADPH；两者相差的是核糖 2′ 位的一个磷酸基团而不是腺嘌呤，标准氧化还原电位几乎相同，差别在于细胞维持的比值不同。
quiz.explain_en: The cell keeps the NAD pool oxidised to collect electrons in catabolism and the NADP pool reduced for fatty acid and cholesterol synthesis and for glutathione reduction. They are not interchangeable: most dehydrogenases read the presence or absence of the 2' phosphate. It is NADH, not NADPH, that feeds the respiratory chain. The structural difference is a phosphate on the ribose 2' position, not an extra adenine, and their standard potentials are nearly identical; what differs is the ratio the cell maintains.

title_zh: 1,3-二磷酸甘油酸的命名拆解，与「NADH 是尚未兑现的能量」
title_en: Parsing the name 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate, and NADH as energy not yet cashed in

points.zh: 生成的产物叫 1,3-二磷酸甘油酸（1,3-bisphosphoglycerate），他说这个名字很复杂，要一步一步拆开看。
points.en: The product is 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate; he calls the name complicated and takes it apart piece by piece.

points.zh: 先定位号数：原料 3-磷酸甘油醛在底下那个位置是 C3，带的磷酸不变，所以名字里的「3」是原有的磷酸。
points.en: He fixes the numbering first: in the substrate glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate the lower position is C3, and that phosphate is unchanged, so the 3 in the name is the pre-existing phosphate.

points.zh: 新上去的磷酸在 C1 位，所以变成 1、3 两个位置各一个磷酸，写作 1,3-bisphosphate。
points.en: The newly added phosphate sits at C1, giving one phosphate at each of positions 1 and 3, written as 1,3-bisphosphate.

points.zh: 词根 glycerate 是甘油酸；因为 C1 上现在是一个含氧的羧基/酰基形式，所以名字从「甘油醛」变成了「甘油酸」。
points.en: The root glycerate means glyceric acid: since C1 now carries an oxygenated carboxyl/acyl form, the name changes from glyceraldehyde to glycerate.

points.zh: 他说这一步「稍微讲一下」，最该记住的一点是：它产生了糖酵解的第一分子 NADH。
points.en: He says the one thing to remember from this step is that it produces the first NADH of glycolysis.

points.zh: 中途出现网络卡顿，双方确认信号后他把结论重复了一遍：这一步重要在于产能、产的是一分子 NADH。
points.en: A connection glitch interrupts; after checking the signal he repeats the conclusion that the step matters because it yields energy in the form of one NADH.

points.zh: 他再次说明 NADH 在电子传递链里又能产生 2.5 分子 ATP，所以我们把 NADH 也叫做一种能量。
points.en: He repeats that NADH will give 2.5 ATP in the electron transport chain, which is why NADH itself counts as energy.

points.zh: 他给 NADH 一个定位：它是「还没有被转化成 ATP 的能量」，这一步要记住的产物就是它。
points.en: He frames NADH as energy that has not yet been converted into ATP, and the product to remember from this step.

extra.zh: bis- 与 di- 不能混：1,3-BPG 和 F-1,6-BP 用 bisphosphate，因为两个磷酸各自独立地酯化在不同的碳上；diphosphate（如 ADP 的 adenosine diphosphate）指两个磷酸彼此以酸酐键相连成焦磷酸链。老教材里写的 fructose-1,6-diphosphate 是旧称，考试按 bisphosphate 写。
extra.en: Do not mix up bis- and di-. 1,3-BPG and F-1,6-BP are bisphosphates because the two phosphates are esterified independently on different carbons; a diphosphate, as in adenosine diphosphate, has the two phosphates joined to each other by an anhydride bond. Older textbooks write fructose-1,6-diphosphate; the current name is bisphosphate.

extra.zh: C1 位并不是普通羧基，而是酰基磷酸（羧酸与磷酸形成的混合酸酐）。这一点决定了它的高能性质：混合酸酐里两个吸电子的酰基/磷酰基争夺同一个氧，水解后产物共振稳定化大幅增加，因此磷酸基团转移势能很高（ΔG°′ 水解约 −49.3 kJ/mol）。C3 位那个则是普通的磷酸酯，能量很低，不能用来做磷酰基转移。
extra.en: C1 is not an ordinary carboxyl but an acyl phosphate, a mixed anhydride of a carboxylic acid and phosphoric acid. That is the source of its high group-transfer potential: two electron-withdrawing groups compete for the same oxygen and the hydrolysis products gain much more resonance stabilisation, giving a standard hydrolysis free energy near -49.3 kJ/mol. The phosphate at C3 is an ordinary low-energy ester and cannot drive phosphoryl transfer.

extra.zh: GAPDH 这一步标准条件下 ΔG°′ 约 +6.3 kJ/mol，其实略微吸能；它靠下一步磷酸甘油酸激酶（ΔG°′ 约 −18.5 kJ/mol）不断抽走 1,3-BPG 而被拉着往前走，两步偶联后总体为负。这是「热力学上不利的一步靠下游拉动」的典型例子，与前面醛缩酶（+23.8 kJ/mol）被 TPI 和 GAPDH 拉动是同一个道理。
extra.en: Under standard conditions the GAPDH step is about +6.3 kJ/mol, slightly endergonic. It is pulled forward because the next step, phosphoglycerate kinase at about -18.5 kJ/mol, continuously removes 1,3-BPG; coupled, the two are strongly negative. This is the same logic by which the aldolase step (+23.8 kJ/mol) is pulled along by triose phosphate isomerase and GAPDH downstream.

extra.zh: 红细胞里 1,3-BPG 还有一条支路：Rapoport–Luebering 支路，由 BPG 变位酶生成 2,3-BPG，再由 2,3-BPG 磷酸酶水解回 3-磷酸甘油酸。这条支路完全跳过磷酸甘油酸激酶，不产 ATP，代价换来的是 2,3-BPG——它结合去氧血红蛋白的中央腔，降低 Hb 对 O2 的亲和力，使氧更容易在组织中卸载（高原适应、慢性缺氧时升高）。
extra.en: In red cells 1,3-BPG has a side route, the Rapoport-Luebering shunt: BPG mutase makes 2,3-BPG, and 2,3-BPG phosphatase hydrolyses it back to 3-phosphoglycerate. The shunt skips phosphoglycerate kinase entirely and yields no ATP; what it buys is 2,3-BPG, which binds the central cavity of deoxyhaemoglobin, lowers its oxygen affinity and helps unload O2 in tissues. It rises at altitude and in chronic hypoxia.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么 1,3-BPG 写作 bisphosphate 而不是 diphosphate？
quiz.q_en: Why is 1,3-BPG called a bisphosphate rather than a diphosphate?

options.zh: 因为两个磷酸通过酸酐键相连成一条焦磷酸链
options.en: because the two phosphates form a pyrophosphate chain

options.zh: 因为它净带两个负电荷，bis- 专门表示电荷数
options.en: because it bears two charges, and bis- means charge

options.zh: 因为 di- 只用于核苷酸，糖类命名一律用 bis-
options.en: because di- is reserved for nucleotides, bis- for sugars

options.zh: 因为两个磷酸分别连在不同的碳上，互不相连
options.en: because the two phosphates sit on separate carbons

quiz.explain_zh: bis- 表示两个互不相连的取代基分别酯化在 C1 和 C3 上；若两个磷酸彼此以酸酐键串成焦磷酸链，那才叫 diphosphate（ADP 就是这种），而 1,3-BPG 的两个磷酸之间没有键。前缀与电荷数无关，磷酸基团在生理 pH 下带的电荷也不止两个；命名规则也不是按「糖 vs 核苷酸」分家，而是按取代基之间连不连。
quiz.explain_en: Bis- marks two independent substituents esterified separately at C1 and C3. Two phosphates joined to each other by an anhydride bond form a pyrophosphate chain and are called a diphosphate, as in ADP; in 1,3-BPG the two phosphates are not bonded to each other. The prefix says nothing about charge, and the phosphate groups carry more than two negative charges at physiological pH. Nor does the rule split by sugars versus nucleotides; it depends on whether the substituents are linked.

quiz.q_zh: 1,3-BPG 的 C1 位是什么基团，为什么说它是高能化合物？
quiz.q_en: What group sits at C1 of 1,3-BPG, and why is it a high-energy compound?

options.zh: 是磷酸二酯键，双酯水解释放大量自由能
options.en: a phosphodiester, whose hydrolysis is very large

options.zh: 是酰基磷酸，水解自由能高于 ATP
options.en: an acyl phosphate, higher in energy than ATP

options.zh: 是普通羧酸，靠共振稳定所以能量高
options.en: an ordinary acid, stabilised by resonance

options.zh: 是醛基，醛基本身是最高能的官能团
options.en: an aldehyde, the highest-energy group there is

quiz.explain_zh: C1 是酰基磷酸（羧酸–磷酸混合酸酐），水解 ΔG°′ 约 −49.3 kJ/mol，超过 ATP 的 −30.5 kJ/mol，因此足以把磷酸推给 ADP 生成 ATP。普通羧酸恰恰因为共振稳定而处于低能态，不能驱动磷酰基转移；醛基已经在上一步被氧化掉，且醛并非高能磷酸化合物；磷酸二酯是 DNA 骨架那类键，属于低能磷酸酯，水解自由能远小于 ATP。
quiz.explain_en: C1 is an acyl phosphate, a mixed anhydride of a carboxylic acid and phosphate, whose hydrolysis is about -49.3 kJ/mol against -30.5 for ATP, enough to phosphorylate ADP. A plain carboxylic acid is low in energy precisely because it is resonance-stabilised and cannot drive phosphoryl transfer. The aldehyde was consumed in the preceding oxidation and is not a high-energy phosphate anyway. Phosphodiesters, as in the DNA backbone, are low-energy esters with hydrolysis energies well below ATP.

title_zh: 题外话：砒霜为什么能毒死人——砷与 GAPDH 这一步
title_en: Digression: why arsenic kills, and its action at the GAPDH step

points.zh: 他说这一步比较容易被砷、也就是砒霜干扰，砒霜之所以能把人毒死就是因为它严重干扰了这一步。
points.en: He says this step is readily disrupted by arsenic, and that arsenic trioxide kills precisely because it interferes here.

points.zh: 他给出的元素依据是：砷和氧属于同一家族，「氧、硫、砷」往下排，所以化学性质很相似。
points.en: His stated periodic-table basis: arsenic is in the same family as oxygen, going down oxygen, sulfur, arsenic, so their chemistry is similar.

points.zh: 由此他推论砷在一定程度上可以取代磷酸。
points.en: From this he infers that arsenic can to some extent substitute for phosphate.

points.zh: 他说砒霜是 As2O3（三氧化二砷），进入人体后会水解，水解成砷酸。
points.en: He states that arsenic trioxide, As2O3, hydrolyses in the body to give arsenate.

points.zh: 砷酸在这一步很容易被 GAP 脱氢酶当成磷酸，接到 GAP 上去。
points.en: That arsenate is then readily taken by GAPDH in place of phosphate and attached to GAP.

points.zh: 他说砷酸在这个位置形成的键不如磷酸的稳定，刚连上去就会水解散开。
points.en: He explains that the bond arsenate forms there is less stable than the phosphate bond, so it hydrolyses apart as soon as it forms.

points.zh: 他的结论：底物一形成产物，产物又变回去，这一步「直接被堵死」，机体就不能产能了。
points.en: His conclusion: the product reverts to substrate as soon as it forms, so the step is blocked outright and the body can no longer make energy.

points.zh: 所以他说人吃了砒霜最终死于没有 ATP：包括心脏跳动、肺在内的全身器官都没有能量供应。
points.en: Hence, in his account, arsenic poisoning kills through lack of ATP, with heart and lungs left without an energy supply.

extra.zh: 周期表的关系说反了。砷（As）在第 15 族（VA），与 N、P、Sb、Bi 同族，正好在磷的正下方；氧、硫、硒、碲是第 16 族，硫下面是硒不是砷。他的结论（砷酸能顶替磷酸）是对的，但推出结论的依据正好搞错了——砷酸能冒充磷酸恰恰因为 As 在 P 的下方，AsO4^3- 与 PO4^3- 的电荷、大小和四面体几何几乎相同。本段内他没有自我更正。
extra.en: The periodic-table claim is backwards. Arsenic is in group 15 with N, P, Sb and Bi, sitting directly below phosphorus; oxygen, sulfur, selenium and tellurium are group 16, and below sulfur is selenium, not arsenic. His conclusion that arsenate can replace phosphate is right, but the reasoning is inverted: arsenate mimics phosphate because As lies below P, so AsO4(3-) and PO4(3-) share charge, size and tetrahedral geometry. He does not correct this within this stretch.

extra.zh: As2O3 水解得到的是亚砷酸/亚砷酸盐 arsenite，即三价砷 As(III)（H3AsO3），不是砷酸。能在 GAPDH 这一步顶替 Pi、发生砷酸解 arsenolysis 的是五价的砷酸 arsenate，As(V)、AsO4^3-。三价与五价砷在体内可相互转化，但毒理机制完全不同，考试时不能混为一谈。
extra.en: As2O3 hydrolyses to arsenite, trivalent As(III) as H3AsO3, not to arsenate. What substitutes for Pi at GAPDH and undergoes arsenolysis is pentavalent arsenate, As(V) as AsO4(3-). The two oxidation states do interconvert in vivo, but their toxicology is different and they must not be conflated.

extra.zh: 砷酸解的结果不是「堵死」，而是解偶联（uncoupling）。GAPDH 照常催化，生成 1-砷酸-3-磷酸甘油酸；这个酰基砷酸键极不稳定，在酶外自发水解成 3-磷酸甘油酸 + 砷酸，通路继续往下跑，只是跳过了磷酸甘油酸激酶那一步——那一步的底物水平磷酸化没了，ATP 收益丢失。也就是说糖酵解没停，只是白干。他要的结论（最终没有 ATP）对，中间「产物变回底物、通路堵死」的描述不对。
extra.en: Arsenolysis does not block the step, it uncouples it. GAPDH works as usual and makes 1-arseno-3-phosphoglycerate; that acyl arsenate is highly unstable and hydrolyses spontaneously off the enzyme to 3-phosphoglycerate plus arsenate, so the pathway keeps running but skips phosphoglycerate kinase and loses that step's substrate-level phosphorylation. Glycolysis continues and simply yields no ATP there. His endpoint (no ATP) is right; the described mechanism (product reverting, pathway blocked) is not.

extra.zh: 三价砷的主要毒性机制完全是另一条：亚砷酸盐与邻二硫醇（vicinal dithiol）高亲和结合，典型靶点是丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体 E2 上的硫辛酰胺（还有 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶），把丙酮酸→乙酰CoA 卡住，因此临床上看到的是乳酸堆积。解毒剂二巯基丙醇（BAL, dimercaprol）正是提供一对邻二硫醇去竞争螯合砷。另外 As2O3（ATO）今天是急性早幼粒细胞白血病（APL）的一线药物，与全反式维甲酸联用，作用于 PML-RARα 融合蛋白。
extra.en: Trivalent arsenic works by a different route: arsenite binds vicinal dithiols with high affinity, the classic target being the lipoamide on E2 of the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex (and of alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase), stalling pyruvate to acetyl-CoA, which is why lactate accumulates clinically. The antidote dimercaprol (BAL) works by offering a competing vicinal dithiol. Separately, arsenic trioxide is today a first-line drug for acute promyelocytic leukaemia, used with all-trans retinoic acid and acting on the PML-RAR-alpha fusion protein.

quiz.q_zh: 砷酸能在 GAPDH 这一步冒充磷酸，化学上的根据是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the chemical basis for arsenate impersonating phosphate at GAPDH?

options.zh: 砷正在磷的下方，砷酸与磷酸大小电荷相近
options.en: arsenic sits just below phosphorus in group 15

options.zh: 砷与碳同族，能形成同样的四面体骨架
options.en: arsenic shares carbon's group and its geometry

options.zh: 砷属于过渡金属，可与磷酸竞争同一个金属位点
options.en: arsenic is a transition metal binding the same site

options.zh: 砷与氧同属第 16 族，硫的下面就是砷
options.en: arsenic is in group 16, right below sulfur

quiz.explain_zh: 砷是第 15 族元素，在磷的正下方，AsO4^3- 与 PO4^3- 的电荷、离子半径和四面体几何几乎一致，所以酶的磷酸结合位点分辨不出来。第 16 族是氧、硫、硒、碲，硫下面是硒；砷与碳既不同族，价态和成键方式也不同；砷更不是过渡金属（它是类金属），这一步的机制也不是抢金属离子位点，而是直接被当作底物装上去。
quiz.explain_en: Arsenic is a group 15 element directly below phosphorus, and arsenate matches phosphate closely in charge, ionic radius and tetrahedral geometry, so a phosphate-binding site cannot tell them apart. Group 16 runs oxygen, sulfur, selenium, tellurium, and below sulfur is selenium. Arsenic is not in carbon's group and differs in valence and bonding. It is a metalloid rather than a transition metal, and the mechanism here is being accepted as a substrate, not competing for a metal site.

quiz.q_zh: 砷酸解（arsenolysis）对糖酵解的实际后果是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does arsenolysis actually do to glycolysis?

options.zh: 通路改道进入磷酸戊糖途径，改产 NADPH
options.en: flux is rerouted to the pentose phosphate pathway

options.zh: 通路继续运转，但这一步的 ATP 收益丢失
options.en: the pathway runs on, but that step's ATP is lost

options.zh: 通路在 GAPDH 处彻底停住，底物无法再转化
options.en: the pathway halts at GAPDH, no turnover at all

options.zh: 通路加速运行，砷酸使 GAPDH 活性上升数倍
options.en: the pathway speeds up, GAPDH activity rises sharply

quiz.explain_zh: GAPDH 照常把砷酸装上去生成 1-砷酸-3-磷酸甘油酸，该酰基砷酸自发水解成 3-磷酸甘油酸，通路继续，但磷酸甘油酸激酶无底物可用，那一步的底物水平磷酸化没了——这叫解偶联而不是阻断。若真被彻底堵死，NAD+ 也无法再生、代谢物应大量堆积，与观察不符；砷酸并不激活 GAPDH，只是被误用为底物；进入磷酸戊糖途径的分叉点在 G6P，远在这一步的上游，砷酸解不改变分流。
quiz.explain_en: GAPDH incorporates arsenate normally to give 1-arseno-3-phosphoglycerate, which hydrolyses spontaneously to 3-phosphoglycerate, so flux continues while phosphoglycerate kinase is left without substrate and its substrate-level phosphorylation is lost. That is uncoupling, not blockade. A true block would also stop NAD+ regeneration and pile up intermediates, which is not what is seen. Arsenate does not activate GAPDH, it is merely mistaken for substrate, and the branch to the pentose phosphate pathway leaves at G6P far upstream and is unaffected.

quiz.q_zh: 砒霜 As2O3 溶解水解后得到的主要物种及其主要毒性机制是？
quiz.q_en: What species does As2O3 give on hydrolysis, and how does it mainly poison?

options.zh: 得到砷酸 As(V)，在 GAPDH 步顶替 Pi 而解偶联
options.en: arsenate, As(V), replacing Pi at the GAPDH step

options.zh: 得到亚砷酸盐 As(III)，结合硫辛酰胺等二硫醇
options.en: arsenite, As(III), which binds vicinal dithiols

options.zh: 得到单质砷 As(0)，沉积在内膜上阻断电子传递
options.en: elemental arsenic, blocking electron transport

options.zh: 得到砷酸 As(V)，直接抑制丙酮酸激酶的活性位点
options.en: arsenate, As(V), blocking the pyruvate kinase site

quiz.explain_zh: As2O3 水解给出三价的亚砷酸/亚砷酸盐，其主要毒性来自与邻二硫醇结合，典型靶点是丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体 E2 的硫辛酰胺，从而卡住丙酮酸氧化脱羧。砷酸解那条机制属于五价砷酸，不是 As2O3 的直接水解产物；亚砷酸盐并不选择性抑制丙酮酸激酶；As2O3 在体内也不会被还原成单质砷沉积到内膜上。
quiz.explain_en: As2O3 hydrolyses to trivalent arsenite, whose main toxicity comes from binding vicinal dithiols, classically the lipoamide on E2 of the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, stalling oxidative decarboxylation of pyruvate. The arsenolysis mechanism belongs to pentavalent arsenate, which is not the direct hydrolysis product. Arsenite is not a selective pyruvate kinase inhibitor, and As2O3 is not reduced to elemental arsenic depositing on the inner membrane.

title_zh: 学生提问：糖酵解与三羧酸循环的关系，丙酮酸的地位
title_en: Student question: how glycolysis relates to the TCA cycle, and the status of pyruvate

points.zh: 学生提问：糖酵解不是在无氧环境下用得比较多吗？真正产能的主力应该是 Krebs cycle（三羧酸循环）吧？
points.en: The student asks whether glycolysis is not mostly used under anaerobic conditions, with the Krebs cycle being the real energy producer.

points.zh: 老师说这是从产能角度看：糖酵解主要在无氧条件下少量供能，三羧酸循环主要在有氧条件下大量供能。
points.en: He answers from the energy-yield angle: glycolysis supplies a small amount of energy mainly anaerobically, the TCA cycle a large amount aerobically.

points.zh: 但他强调糖酵解是三羧酸循环的前提：一分子葡萄糖必须先经糖酵解变成丙酮酸。
points.en: But he stresses that glycolysis is the precondition for the TCA cycle: glucose must first be turned into pyruvate.

points.zh: 他说丙酮酸才最终进入三羧酸循环；没有糖酵解就产生不了丙酮酸，三羧酸循环就没法进行。
points.en: He says it is pyruvate that finally enters the TCA cycle, and without glycolysis there is no pyruvate and no cycle.

points.zh: 学生追问：丙酮（酸）不是有点毒、还臭臭的吗，为什么突然变成一个很重要的东西？
points.en: The student follows up: is acetone/pyruvate not somewhat toxic and smelly, so why does it suddenly become important?

points.zh: 老师回答：丙酮是比较毒的，丙酮酸实际上也是比较毒的。
points.en: He replies that acetone is fairly toxic and that pyruvate is fairly toxic as well.

points.zh: 但他说丙酮酸在体内不会大量积累：糖酵解一把它产生出来，它马上就进入三羧酸循环被转化掉。
points.en: He adds that pyruvate never accumulates: as soon as glycolysis makes it, it goes straight into the cycle and is converted onward.

points.zh: 学生确认「丙酮酸基本只能由糖酵解产生、这条路一堵人就死了」，老师说对；他补充人也可以用少部分脂质/脂肪产生丙酮酸，但那不是主要途径。
points.en: The student checks that pyruvate essentially comes only from glycolysis and that blocking it is fatal, and he agrees, adding that a small amount can come from lipids but that this is not the main route.

extra.zh: 「糖酵解主要在无氧条件下」是常见简化，但字面不准确。有氧条件下糖酵解同样全速运行，而且是丙酮酸→乙酰CoA→三羧酸循环的必经上游；真正只在无氧（或缺线粒体，如成熟红细胞）时才走的是丙酮酸→乳酸这个分支，由乳酸脱氢酶催化，其目的是再生 NAD+ 而不是产能。
extra.en: Saying glycolysis is mainly for anaerobic conditions is a common simplification but literally inaccurate. Glycolysis runs at full speed aerobically and is the obligatory upstream of pyruvate to acetyl-CoA to the TCA cycle. What is genuinely anaerobic (or specific to cells without mitochondria, such as mature red cells) is the branch from pyruvate to lactate catalysed by lactate dehydrogenase, whose purpose is regenerating NAD+, not making energy.

extra.zh: 丙酮酸并不直接进入三羧酸循环。它先经线粒体丙酮酸载体 MPC 进入基质，由丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体（PDH）氧化脱羧成乙酰CoA，同时放出 CO2 和 NADH；真正与草酰乙酸缩合成柠檬酸、从而「进入循环」的是乙酰CoA。PDH 需要五种辅因子：TPP（VB1）、硫辛酰胺、CoA（VB5）、FAD（VB2）、NAD+（VB3），这也是 VB1 缺乏（脚气病、Wernicke 脑病）会造成丙酮酸和乳酸堆积的原因。
extra.en: Pyruvate does not enter the TCA cycle directly. It crosses into the matrix via the mitochondrial pyruvate carrier and is oxidatively decarboxylated by the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex to acetyl-CoA, releasing CO2 and NADH; it is acetyl-CoA that condenses with oxaloacetate to give citrate. PDH needs five cofactors: TPP (B1), lipoamide, CoA (B5), FAD (B2) and NAD+ (B3), which is why thiamine deficiency (beriberi, Wernicke encephalopathy) causes pyruvate and lactate to accumulate.

extra.zh: 丙酮酸本身不是毒物，它是正常的代谢中间物——丙酮酸钠是常规细胞培养基成分，也作为膳食补充剂使用。学生问的丙酮（acetone）确有轻度毒性和特殊气味，老师把丙酮的属性顺延给了丙酮酸。他讲的「不积累是因为很快被用掉」这部分是对的，但原因是通量高、下游酶亲和力强，不是因为有毒必须清除。
extra.en: Pyruvate is not a poison, it is a normal metabolic intermediate; sodium pyruvate is a routine cell-culture ingredient and is sold as a supplement. Acetone, which the student asked about, is mildly toxic and does have a characteristic smell, and that property was carried over to pyruvate by mistake. His point that it does not accumulate because it is used up quickly is correct, but the reason is high flux and avid downstream enzymes, not the need to clear a toxin.

extra.zh: 丙酮酸不止来自糖酵解：乳酸经乳酸脱氢酶氧化回丙酮酸（Cori 循环，肝脏用它做糖异生原料）、丙氨酸经丙氨酸转氨酶转氨生成丙酮酸（葡萄糖–丙氨酸循环，肌肉的氮转运方式）、苹果酸经苹果酸酶脱羧、丝氨酸经丝氨酸脱水酶等，都是标准来源。作为「主要途径」的简化可以接受，但不能记成绝对唯一。
extra.en: Pyruvate has several sources besides glycolysis: lactate reoxidised by lactate dehydrogenase (the Cori cycle, feeding hepatic gluconeogenesis), alanine transaminated by ALT (the glucose-alanine cycle by which muscle exports nitrogen), malate decarboxylated by malic enzyme, and serine via serine dehydratase. Calling glycolysis the main route is acceptable; calling it the only one is not.

quiz.q_zh: 丙酮酸在进入三羧酸循环之前必须先经过什么？
quiz.q_en: What must happen to pyruvate before it can enter the TCA cycle?

options.zh: 直接与草酰乙酸缩合成柠檬酸，无需任何转化
options.en: nothing, it condenses with oxaloacetate as is

options.zh: 经丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体脱羧成乙酰CoA
options.en: oxidative decarboxylation to acetyl-CoA by PDH

options.zh: 经乳酸脱氢酶还原成乳酸后再进入线粒体
options.en: reduction to lactate before entering mitochondria

options.zh: 经磷酸化生成磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸后入基质
options.en: phosphorylation to PEP before crossing inward

quiz.explain_zh: 丙酮酸经 MPC 进入线粒体基质，由丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体氧化脱羧成乙酰CoA（放 CO2、生成 NADH），乙酰CoA 才与草酰乙酸缩合成柠檬酸。还原成乳酸是无氧条件下的出路，方向恰好离开三羧酸循环；从丙酮酸生成 PEP 是糖异生的绕道，方向向上而不是进入循环；丙酮酸本身不是循环的中间物，柠檬酸合酶只接受乙酰CoA 作为二碳供体。
quiz.explain_en: Pyruvate enters the matrix through the mitochondrial pyruvate carrier and is oxidatively decarboxylated by the PDH complex to acetyl-CoA, releasing CO2 and NADH, and acetyl-CoA then condenses with oxaloacetate to citrate. Reduction to lactate is the anaerobic exit and leads away from the cycle. Making PEP from pyruvate is the gluconeogenic bypass, running upward rather than into the cycle. Pyruvate is not a cycle intermediate, and citrate synthase accepts only acetyl-CoA as the two-carbon donor.

quiz.q_zh: 对「糖酵解主要在无氧条件下才用」这句话，正确的理解是什么？
quiz.q_en: How should the claim that glycolysis is mainly for anaerobic conditions be corrected?

options.zh: 有氧时糖酵解照常运行，无氧的只是产乳酸这一分支
options.en: glycolysis runs either way, only lactate is anaerobic

options.zh: 有氧时糖酵解逆向运行，把丙酮酸重新合成葡萄糖
options.en: aerobically it reverses, remaking glucose from pyruvate

options.zh: 有氧时糖酵解完全停止，改由 TCA 直接分解葡萄糖
options.en: aerobically it stops and the TCA cycle takes glucose

options.zh: 有氧时葡萄糖走磷酸戊糖途径进入 TCA，绕开糖酵解
options.en: aerobically glucose detours via the pentose pathway

quiz.explain_zh: 糖酵解在有氧条件下同样全速运行，它是通向丙酮酸、进而通向乙酰CoA 和三羧酸循环的唯一主干；只有丙酮酸→乳酸这一分支属于无氧代谢，用来再生 NAD+。三羧酸循环没有直接分解葡萄糖的能力，它的入口是乙酰CoA；磷酸戊糖途径从 G6P 分出、产 NADPH 与核糖-5-磷酸，碳骨架最后还要以 F6P 和 GAP 回到糖酵解；糖酵解的三个不可逆步骤决定它不能简单逆转，糖异生要靠不同的酶绕开。
quiz.explain_en: Glycolysis runs at full rate aerobically and is the sole trunk route to pyruvate and hence to acetyl-CoA and the TCA cycle; only the pyruvate to lactate branch is anaerobic, serving NAD+ regeneration. The TCA cycle cannot take glucose directly, its entry point being acetyl-CoA. The pentose phosphate pathway leaves at G6P to make NADPH and ribose-5-phosphate and returns carbon to glycolysis as F6P and GAP. And the three irreversible steps mean glycolysis cannot simply run backwards; gluconeogenesis needs different enzymes to bypass them.

title_zh: 生酮饮食的说法；第 7 步磷酸甘油酸激酶与第一次产 ATP
title_en: The ketogenic-diet aside, and step 7: phosphoglycerate kinase makes the first ATP

points.zh: 他用减肥的「生酮法」举例：完全不摄入碳水，整个糖酵解途径基本上被堵死。
points.en: He uses the ketogenic diet as an example: eating no carbohydrate essentially shuts down the glycolytic pathway.

points.zh: 他说堵死之后，机体会用比较「不经济」的方法把脂肪拆解成为丙酮酸，让丙酮酸再供三羧酸循环使用。
points.en: He says the body then uses an uneconomical route to break fat down into pyruvate, which feeds the TCA cycle.

points.zh: 因此理论上生酮可以很大程度地消耗脂肪。
points.en: In principle, therefore, the diet can burn a large amount of fat.

points.zh: 但他强调脂肪拆解成丙酮酸是不经济的方法，人体平时不会常用这条路。
points.en: But he stresses this route is uneconomical and the body does not normally use it.

points.zh: 只有在极度缺葡萄糖、一点葡萄糖都没有、只剩脂肪可用的时候才会走。
points.en: It is used only under extreme glucose deprivation, when nothing but fat is left.

points.zh: 回到反应：得到 1,3-BPG 之后，下一步同样是一个产能反应。
points.en: Returning to the pathway: once 1,3-BPG is formed, the next step is also energy-yielding.

points.zh: 它直接和一分子 ADP（他形容为「没有那个高能磷酸的 ADP」）结合，把刚拿到的磷酸基团转移到 ATP 上。
points.en: It reacts with ADP, which he describes as the form lacking that high-energy phosphate, transferring the newly acquired phosphate to make ATP.

points.zh: 命名规则：只要涉及 ATP 上磷酸基团的转移，一般都叫激酶 kinase；这个酶是 phosphoglycerate kinase，中文磷酸甘油酸激酶，他说叫「甘油酸磷酸激酶」把两个词调过来也没问题。
points.en: Naming rule: any enzyme transferring a phosphate to or from ATP is called a kinase; this one is phosphoglycerate kinase, and he notes the two words can be said in either order in Chinese.

points.zh: 他补充：只要涉及 ATP 的反应肯定都有镁离子参与，这一点以后不再重复说了。
points.en: He adds that any ATP-involving reaction certainly requires magnesium, and that he will not repeat this each time.

extra.zh: 脂肪并不「拆解成丙酮酸」。脂肪酸经 β-氧化生成的是乙酰CoA，直接进入三羧酸循环，全程不经过丙酮酸；而且哺乳动物不能把乙酰CoA 净转化成丙酮酸或葡萄糖（丙酮酸脱氢酶反应不可逆）。甘油三酯里只有甘油骨架能经甘油激酶 → 3-磷酸甘油 → DHAP 进入糖酵解或糖异生，占的碳量很小。生酮状态下真正替代葡萄糖供给大脑的是酮体：乙酰乙酸、β-羟丁酸（还有自发脱羧产生的丙酮）。
extra.en: Fat is not broken down into pyruvate. Beta-oxidation of fatty acids gives acetyl-CoA, which enters the TCA cycle directly and never passes through pyruvate, and mammals cannot make a net conversion of acetyl-CoA into pyruvate or glucose because the PDH reaction is irreversible. Only the glycerol backbone of a triglyceride can enter glycolysis or gluconeogenesis, via glycerol kinase and glycerol-3-phosphate to DHAP, and it carries little of the carbon. What actually replaces glucose for the brain in ketosis are the ketone bodies acetoacetate and beta-hydroxybutyrate (plus acetone from spontaneous decarboxylation).

extra.zh: PGK 这一步是糖酵解的第一次底物水平磷酸化（substrate-level phosphorylation）：高能的酰基磷酸把磷酰基直接交给 ADP，不需要氧、不需要膜、不需要质子梯度，与线粒体的氧化磷酸化是完全不同的机制。这正是成熟红细胞（无线粒体）和剧烈无氧运动的肌肉唯一能产 ATP 的方式。糖酵解的另一次底物水平磷酸化在第 10 步丙酮酸激酶。
extra.en: This is glycolysis' first substrate-level phosphorylation: a high-energy acyl phosphate hands its phosphoryl group straight to ADP, with no oxygen, no membrane and no proton gradient, a mechanism entirely different from mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation. It is the only way mature red cells, which have no mitochondria, and muscle in hard anaerobic work can make ATP. The other substrate-level phosphorylation is step 10, pyruvate kinase.

extra.zh: 收支要按每分子葡萄糖记：一分子葡萄糖裂解成两分子三碳糖，所以 PGK 这一步产 2 分子 ATP，刚好抵消准备阶段己糖激酶和 PFK-1 消耗的 2 分子 ATP，走到这里是收支平衡。真正的净收益要等第 10 步丙酮酸激酶再产 2 ATP，最终每分子葡萄糖净得 2 ATP，外加 2 NADH。PGK 这一步 ΔG°′ 约 −18.5 kJ/mol。
extra.en: Count per glucose: one glucose gives two trioses, so this step makes 2 ATP, exactly repaying the 2 ATP spent by hexokinase and PFK-1 in the preparatory phase, leaving the books balanced at this point. The net gain comes from step 10, pyruvate kinase, with another 2 ATP, giving a net 2 ATP plus 2 NADH per glucose. The PGK step has a standard free energy of about -18.5 kJ/mol.

extra.zh: 「激酶=磷酸化」是对的，但激酶的逆反应不是去磷酸化：把磷酸从蛋白或代谢物上摘下来是磷酸酶（phosphatase）的活，两者是不同的酶，这正是磷酸化开关能作为调控手段的原因。另外要区分两件事：PGK 催化的这个反应本身在细胞内接近平衡、可逆，糖异生直接沿用同一个酶反向走；而己糖激酶、PFK-1、丙酮酸激酶那三步才不可逆、必须旁路。他说的镁离子严格讲是辅因子（cofactor）中的金属离子，不是辅酶（coenzyme）——真正的底物是 Mg-ATP 复合物。
extra.en: Kinase does mean phosphorylation, but the reverse of a kinase reaction is not dephosphorylation: removing a phosphate is the job of a phosphatase, a different enzyme, which is exactly why phosphorylation works as a regulatory switch. Note also that the PGK reaction itself is near equilibrium and reversible, so gluconeogenesis reuses the same enzyme, whereas hexokinase, PFK-1 and pyruvate kinase are the irreversible steps needing bypasses. Strictly, magnesium is a metal-ion cofactor rather than a coenzyme, and the true substrate is the Mg-ATP complex.

quiz.q_zh: 生酮状态下，脂肪酸分解产物的真实去向是什么？
quiz.q_en: In ketosis, where do the products of fatty acid breakdown actually go?

options.zh: β-氧化生成丙酮酸，丙酮酸再进入三羧酸循环
options.en: beta-oxidation to pyruvate, which feeds the cycle

options.zh: 直接水解成葡萄糖，经糖酵解重新产生 ATP
options.en: direct hydrolysis to glucose, burnt in glycolysis

options.zh: 转变成甘油后经糖异生大量合成血糖
options.en: conversion to glycerol, then bulk gluconeogenesis

options.zh: β-氧化生成乙酰CoA，过剩者转成酮体
options.en: beta-oxidation to acetyl-CoA, surplus to ketones

quiz.explain_zh: 脂肪酸 β-氧化的产物是乙酰CoA，可直接进三羧酸循环；当草酰乙酸被糖异生抽走、乙酰CoA 过剩时，肝脏把它转成酮体（乙酰乙酸、β-羟丁酸）供脑和心肌使用。β-氧化不产生丙酮酸，哺乳动物也不能把乙酰CoA 净转成丙酮酸或葡萄糖；脂肪当然不能水解成葡萄糖；甘油三酯里只有甘油骨架能进糖异生，碳量很小，不足以「大量」合成血糖。
quiz.explain_en: Beta-oxidation yields acetyl-CoA, which can enter the TCA cycle directly; when oxaloacetate is drained into gluconeogenesis and acetyl-CoA is in excess, the liver converts it to the ketone bodies acetoacetate and beta-hydroxybutyrate for brain and heart. Beta-oxidation makes no pyruvate, and mammals cannot convert acetyl-CoA net into pyruvate or glucose. Fat cannot be hydrolysed to glucose, and only the glycerol backbone reaches gluconeogenesis, far too little carbon to supply blood glucose in bulk.

quiz.q_zh: 磷酸甘油酸激酶（PGK）这一步产 ATP，属于哪一类机制？
quiz.q_en: By what mechanism does the phosphoglycerate kinase step make ATP?

options.zh: 底物水平磷酸化，磷酸直接交给 ADP
options.en: substrate-level phosphorylation, direct to ADP

options.zh: 光合磷酸化，靠光激发的电子传递链驱动
options.en: photophosphorylation, driven by excited electrons

options.zh: 腺苷酸激酶反应，由两分子 ADP 歧化生成
options.en: adenylate kinase, disproportionating two ADP

options.zh: 氧化磷酸化，靠内膜两侧的质子梯度驱动
options.en: oxidative phosphorylation, driven by the gradient

quiz.explain_zh: 1,3-BPG 上的酰基磷酸把磷酰基直接转给 ADP 生成 ATP，全程在胞质、不需要膜和氧，这就是底物水平磷酸化，也是无线粒体的红细胞唯一的产 ATP 方式。氧化磷酸化发生在线粒体内膜、由 ATP 合酶利用质子动力势驱动，与此无关；光合磷酸化只见于叶绿体和光合细菌；腺苷酸激酶（2 ADP ⇌ ATP + AMP）确实存在，但它只是重新分配已有的高能磷酸，不是糖酵解的产能步骤。
quiz.explain_en: The acyl phosphate of 1,3-BPG transfers its phosphoryl group straight to ADP in the cytosol, needing neither membrane nor oxygen: that is substrate-level phosphorylation, and it is the only route to ATP in red cells, which lack mitochondria. Oxidative phosphorylation happens at the inner mitochondrial membrane through ATP synthase using the proton-motive force. Photophosphorylation occurs only in chloroplasts and photosynthetic bacteria. Adenylate kinase (2 ADP to ATP plus AMP) is real but merely redistributes existing high-energy phosphate.

quiz.q_zh: 每分子葡萄糖走完整条糖酵解，ATP 的收支应该怎么记？
quiz.q_en: What is the ATP balance sheet for one glucose through glycolysis?

options.zh: 产 4 耗 0，净 4，准备阶段并不消耗 ATP
options.en: 4 made and none spent, the prep phase is free

options.zh: 产 2 耗 1，净 1，只有 PGK 一步产生 ATP
options.en: 2 made, 1 spent, net one, only PGK makes ATP

options.zh: 产 4 耗 2，净 2，PGK 与丙酮酸激酶各产 2
options.en: 4 made, 2 spent, net two, from PGK and PK

options.zh: 产 2 耗 2，净 0，能量全部以 NADH 形式保存
options.en: 2 made, 2 spent, net zero, energy all as NADH

quiz.explain_zh: 准备阶段己糖激酶和 PFK-1 各耗 1 ATP，共耗 2；放能相因为有两分子三碳糖，PGK 产 2、丙酮酸激酶产 2，共产 4，净得 2 ATP，另加 2 NADH。说净 0 忽略了放能相的两步各发生两次；说不耗 ATP 与两步不可逆的磷酸化事实矛盾；只算 PGK 一步则漏掉第 10 步丙酮酸激酶，那一步的底物 PEP 是糖酵解中磷酸基团转移势能最高的化合物。
quiz.explain_en: The preparatory phase spends 1 ATP each at hexokinase and PFK-1, two in all. In the payoff phase, because there are two trioses, PGK makes 2 and pyruvate kinase makes 2, four in all, for a net 2 ATP plus 2 NADH. Claiming net zero forgets that both payoff steps occur twice. Claiming nothing is spent contradicts the two irreversible phosphorylations. Counting only PGK omits step 10, whose substrate PEP has the highest phosphoryl transfer potential in the pathway.

title_zh: 磷酸甘油酸激酶：糖酵解第一次底物水平磷酸化
title_en: Phosphoglycerate kinase: the first substrate-level phosphorylation

points.zh: 老师把 1,3-BPG C1 位上刚装上去的那个磷酸从图上擦掉，转给 ADP，标注「+ATP」：这一步直接得到一分子 ATP。
points.en: He erases the phosphate that had just been added to C1 of 1,3-BPG and hands it to ADP, writing "+ATP" on the board: this step yields one ATP directly.

points.zh: 磷酸丢出去以后，C1 位「永久地被氧化成酸」——从醛经酰基磷酸最终固定为羧酸，产物是 3-磷酸甘油酸。
points.en: Once the phosphate leaves, C1 is "permanently oxidised to an acid": aldehyde to acyl phosphate to carboxylate, giving 3-phosphoglycerate.

points.zh: 凡是涉及 ATP 上磷酸基团转移的酶都叫 kinase 激酶；这个酶是 phosphoglycerate kinase，中文叫磷酸甘油酸激酶（他说甘油酸磷酸激酶也可以）。
points.en: Any enzyme that moves a phosphoryl group to or from ATP is a kinase; this one is phosphoglycerate kinase (he notes the two Chinese word orders are both acceptable).

points.zh: 他用蓝色把这一步圈出来：这是糖酵解里第一个真正意义上的直接产能步骤。
points.en: He rings the step in blue: this is the first step in glycolysis that makes energy directly.

points.zh: 对比上一步 GAPDH：它产生的是 NADH，属于「间接产能」，要到后面才换成 ATP；这一步才是直接产出一分子 ATP。
points.en: Contrast with the preceding GAPDH step, which makes NADH — energy "indirectly", cashed in later; only this step puts out ATP itself.

points.zh: 这个反应同样需要 Mg²⁺。他给的通则：所有 kinase 都需要 Mg²⁺，因为 kinase 要操纵 ATP，Mg²⁺ 先结合 ATP，结合了 Mg²⁺ 的 ATP 才能再结合到酶上。
points.en: The reaction needs Mg²⁺, and he generalises: every kinase does, because Mg²⁺ binds ATP first and only the Mg-bound ATP then binds the enzyme.

points.zh: 他强调这一步没有什么特别需要强调的，因为它不容易被调控；凡是对糖酵解速率有调控作用的步骤，他都会专门圈出来强调。
points.en: He flags the step as unremarkable because it is not readily regulated; every step that does control glycolytic flux, he says, gets circled explicitly.

points.zh: 课堂互动：学生反映画得太快、糖环结构跟不上；老师答应把文件发过去，并建议把环结构默写几遍就能记住。
points.en: Classroom aside: a student says the ring structures are going by too fast; he promises to send the file and suggests redrawing the ring from memory a few times.

extra.zh: 1,3-BPG 的酰基磷酸（混合酸酐）水解 ΔG°′ ≈ −49.3 kJ/mol，远比 ATP 的 −30.5 kJ/mol 高，所以磷酸转给 ADP 在标准条件下就放能；PGK 反应本身 ΔG°′ ≈ −18.5 kJ/mol，但胞内接近平衡，可以反向运行（糖异生用的正是同一个 PGK）。
extra.en: The acyl phosphate of 1,3-BPG has ΔG°′ of hydrolysis ≈ −49.3 kJ/mol against ATP's −30.5, so transfer to ADP is downhill even at standard state; PGK itself is ΔG°′ ≈ −18.5 kJ/mol but near equilibrium in the cell and runs backwards in gluconeogenesis.

extra.zh: 这里是底物水平磷酸化 substrate-level phosphorylation：磷酸来自底物自己的高能键，不需要氧、不需要线粒体、不需要 ATP 合酶。氧化磷酸化才依赖质子梯度。成熟红细胞没有线粒体，它全部的 ATP 就靠 PGK 和丙酮酸激酶这两步。
extra.en: This is substrate-level phosphorylation: the phosphoryl group comes from a high-energy bond on the substrate itself — no O₂, no mitochondrion, no ATP synthase. Mature erythrocytes, which have no mitochondria, get all their ATP from PGK and pyruvate kinase.

extra.zh: Mg²⁺ 是金属离子辅因子 cofactor，不是辅酶 coenzyme（辅酶指 NAD⁺、FAD、CoA 这类有机小分子）。它的真实作用不是帮 ATP 过膜，而是与 β/γ 磷酸螯合成 Mg·ATP——激酶真正的底物——屏蔽负电荷、降低亲核进攻的静电排斥并稳定过渡态。
extra.en: Mg²⁺ is a metal-ion cofactor, not a coenzyme (that word is for NAD⁺, FAD, CoA). Its job is not to help ATP cross membranes but to chelate the β/γ phosphates into Mg·ATP — the true kinase substrate — screening charge and stabilising the transition state.

extra.zh: PGK 的可逆性有直接用途：糖异生时同一个酶反向运行，消耗 1 ATP 把 3-磷酸甘油酸变回 1,3-BPG。糖酵解十步里只有己糖激酶、PFK-1、丙酮酸激酶三步需要糖异生另设旁路酶，PGK 不在其中。
extra.en: PGK's reversibility is used: gluconeogenesis runs the same enzyme backwards, spending 1 ATP to regenerate 1,3-BPG. Of the ten steps only hexokinase, PFK-1 and pyruvate kinase need bypass enzymes; PGK does not.

quiz.q_zh: 磷酸甘油酸激酶这一步生成的 ATP，其磷酸基团直接来自哪里？
quiz.q_en: In the phosphoglycerate kinase step, where does the phosphoryl group of the new ATP come from?

options.zh: 游离无机磷酸 Pi 直接与 ADP 缩合
options.en: Free inorganic phosphate condensing onto ADP

options.zh: NADH 携带的高能磷酸再转交给 ADP
options.en: A high-energy phosphate handed over by NADH

options.zh: 线粒体内膜质子梯度驱动合酶合成的 ATP
options.en: ATP synthase driven by the proton gradient

options.zh: 1,3-BPG C1 位上的酰基磷酸键
options.en: The acyl phosphate on C1 of 1,3-BPG itself

quiz.explain_zh: 磷酸来自底物自身 C1 位的混合酸酐，是底物水平磷酸化。NADH 只携带电子和氢负离子，不带磷酸；质子梯度合成 ATP 是氧化磷酸化，与胞质里的这一步无关；Pi 与 ADP 直接缩合在细胞内是强吸能反应，不会自发发生。
quiz.explain_en: The phosphoryl group comes from the substrate's own mixed anhydride at C1 — substrate-level phosphorylation. NADH carries electrons and a hydride, never a phosphate; proton-gradient-driven synthesis is oxidative phosphorylation, not this cytosolic step; direct condensation of Pi onto ADP is strongly endergonic and does not occur spontaneously.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么几乎所有激酶反应都必须有 Mg²⁺ 参与？
quiz.q_en: Why does essentially every kinase reaction require Mg²⁺?

options.zh: Mg²⁺ 与 β/γ 磷酸螯合为 MgATP
options.en: It chelates the β/γ phosphates into Mg·ATP

options.zh: Mg²⁺ 作为辅酶提供反应中被转移的磷酸基团
options.en: It acts as a coenzyme donating that phosphate

options.zh: Mg²⁺ 中和电荷使 ATP 能扩散过细胞膜
options.en: It masks ATP charge so that it crosses membranes

options.zh: Mg²⁺ 直接氧化底物的醛基生成羧酸产物
options.en: It oxidises the substrate aldehyde to an acid

quiz.explain_zh: 激酶真正的底物是 Mg·ATP 复合物，Mg²⁺ 屏蔽磷酸链负电荷、固定构象、稳定过渡态。Mg²⁺ 是金属离子辅因子而非辅酶，也不提供磷酸；ATP 即使螯合 Mg²⁺ 净电荷仍为负，跨线粒体膜靠 ANT 载体而不是自由扩散；氧化醛基的是 NAD⁺ 依赖的 GAPDH，与 Mg²⁺ 无关。
quiz.explain_en: The real kinase substrate is the Mg·ATP complex: Mg²⁺ screens the phosphate charges, fixes the conformation and stabilises the transition state. It is a metal cofactor, not a coenzyme, and donates no phosphate; even Mg-bound ATP stays anionic and crosses membranes via the ANT carrier, not by diffusion; aldehyde oxidation is done by NAD⁺-dependent GAPDH.

title_zh: 磷酸甘油酸变位酶：把磷酸从 C3 挪到 C2
title_en: Phosphoglycerate mutase: moving the phosphate from C3 to C2

points.zh: 下一步是一个「变位」反应，老师把英文名念作 phospho glycerol mutase。
points.en: The next step is a mutase reaction; he reads the English name aloud as "phospho glycerol mutase".

points.zh: 他拆词根解释：mutase 来自 mutate（变异、变种），所以他先叫它「变种酶／变异酶」，随后说中文规范名是变位酶。
points.en: He parses the root: mutase from "mutate", so he first calls it a "mutation enzyme" before settling on the standard Chinese term for a mutase.

points.zh: 他把结构复制（不是剪切）下来对照画：磷酸从三位转移到二位，原来带磷酸的 C3 位变回一个羟基。
points.en: He copies (not cuts) the structure to compare side by side: the phosphate moves from C3 to C2, and C3 reverts to a free hydroxyl.

points.zh: 他给 mutase 下的定义：只把某个基团在分子内换一个位置的酶。
points.en: His working definition of a mutase: an enzyme that merely relocates a group within the molecule.

points.zh: 他强调这个转移不是一步到位，而是「经过一个中间体」完成的。
points.en: He stresses that the transfer is not direct but goes "through an intermediate".

points.zh: 这个中间体有名字：2,3-二磷酸甘油酸，即 2,3-BPG（bis-phosphate glycerate，两个磷酸）。
points.en: That intermediate has a name: 2,3-bisphosphoglycerate, 2,3-BPG — glycerate carrying two phosphates.

points.zh: 他把它接回第一讲的血红蛋白内容：2,3-BPG 可以结合到血红蛋白上，促进血红蛋白把氧气释放出来。
points.en: He links it back to the haemoglobin lecture: 2,3-BPG binds haemoglobin and promotes O₂ release.

points.zh: 他解释为什么平时轮不到它去结合血红蛋白：它在细胞里是瞬时产生、很快又被转化成下一步产物的中间体。
points.en: He explains why it usually cannot reach haemoglobin: in the cell it is made transiently and is quickly converted onward.

extra.zh: 英文名他念成 phosphoglycerol mutase，正确是 phosphoglycerate mutase（磷酸甘油酸变位酶）——底物是 3-磷酸甘油酸，不是甘油 glycerol。他给的中文名「磷酸甘油酸」是对的，只有英文词根说错；中文他先说「变种酶／变异酶」，规范名是变位酶（他自己随后也改用了「变位」）。
extra.en: He says "phosphoglycerol mutase"; the enzyme is phosphoglycerate mutase — the substrate is 3-phosphoglycerate, not glycerol. His Chinese name is right; only the English root is wrong, and he does switch to the standard Chinese term moments later.

extra.zh: 机制是双置换：酶活性中心一个 His 残基先被磷酸化，它把磷酸给底物 C2，生成酶结合态的 2,3-BPG；随后酶再取走 C3 上原来的磷酸，恢复磷酸-组氨酸状态。所以「挪过去」的并不是同一个磷酸原子，而是进一个、出一个。
extra.en: The mechanism is double displacement: an active-site His is phosphorylated, donates that phosphate to C2 giving enzyme-bound 2,3-BPG, then takes the original C3 phosphate back to regenerate phospho-His. The phosphate that arrives is not the one that leaves.

extra.zh: ΔG°′ ≈ +4.4 kJ/mol，接近平衡、可逆，靠下游抽走产物拉动。因为机制需要磷酸-His，酶必须有催化量的 2,3-BPG 才能启动——细胞里 2,3-BPG 一旦被彻底耗尽，这个酶就停摆。
extra.en: ΔG°′ ≈ +4.4 kJ/mol — near equilibrium, pulled by downstream consumption. Because the mechanism needs phospho-His, the enzyme requires catalytic amounts of 2,3-BPG to prime it; strip 2,3-BPG away completely and it stalls.

extra.zh: mutase 与 isomerase 不能混：mutase 是分子内基团移位（磷酸甘油酸变位酶、磷酸葡萄糖变位酶 G1P↔G6P），分子骨架不变；isomerase 是骨架异构（磷酸葡糖异构酶醛糖↔酮糖、TPI 的 DHAP↔GAP）。
extra.en: Keep mutase and isomerase apart: a mutase relocates a group within the molecule (phosphoglycerate mutase, phosphoglucomutase G1P↔G6P); an isomerase rearranges the skeleton (phosphoglucose isomerase aldose↔ketose, TPI DHAP↔GAP).

quiz.q_zh: 磷酸甘油酸变位酶催化的到底是什么变化？
quiz.q_en: What change does phosphoglycerate mutase actually catalyse?

options.zh: 把 3-磷酸甘油酸直接脱水生成 PEP
options.en: 3-phosphoglycerate is dehydrated to give PEP

options.zh: 把 C1 位的磷酸转给 ADP 生成 ATP
