options.en: Transfer of the C1 phosphate to ADP, making ATP

options.zh: 把 C3 位上的磷酸转移到 C2 位上
options.en: The C3 phosphate is moved to the C2 position

options.zh: 把 C1 位的醛基异构成 C2 位的酮基
options.en: The C1 aldehyde is isomerised to a C2 ketone

quiz.explain_zh: 变位酶只做分子内的磷酸移位，产物是 2-磷酸甘油酸。把磷酸交给 ADP 是上一步的磷酸甘油酸激酶；醛糖变酮糖是第二步的磷酸葡糖异构酶；脱水生成 PEP 是下一步的烯醇化酶，而且底物是 2-磷酸甘油酸不是 3-磷酸甘油酸。
quiz.explain_en: A mutase only relocates the phosphate, giving 2-phosphoglycerate. Handing a phosphate to ADP is the preceding PGK step; aldose-to-ketose is phosphoglucose isomerase in step 2; dehydration to PEP is the next step, enolase, and its substrate is 2-phosphoglycerate, not the 3-isomer.

quiz.q_zh: 变位酶催化循环中，磷酸真正的直接供体是什么？
quiz.q_en: In the mutase catalytic cycle, what is the immediate phosphoryl donor?

options.zh: NAD⁺ 先接受磷酸再传给底物 C2 位
options.en: NAD⁺ picking the phosphate up and passing it on

options.zh: 酶活性中心被磷酸化的组氨酸残基 His
options.en: A phosphorylated histidine in the active site

options.zh: ATP 提供 γ 磷酸接到底物 C2 位上
options.en: ATP donating its γ phosphate onto substrate C2

options.zh: 游离无机磷酸 Pi 直接结合到 C2 位上
options.en: Free inorganic phosphate binding directly at C2

quiz.explain_zh: 磷酸-组氨酸把磷酸给 C2，生成酶结合态的 2,3-BPG，再取走 C3 磷酸恢复自身，属双置换机制。这一步不消耗 ATP，也不用游离 Pi（用 Pi 的是 GAPDH），NAD⁺ 只做氢负离子受体，从不携带磷酸。
quiz.explain_en: Phospho-His donates to C2, giving enzyme-bound 2,3-BPG, then retrieves the C3 phosphate — a double-displacement cycle. The step consumes no ATP and no free Pi (that is GAPDH's role), and NAD⁺ is a hydride acceptor that never carries phosphate.

title_zh: 2,3-BPG 与放氧，以及烯醇化酶的脱水
title_en: 2,3-BPG and O₂ release, then the enolase dehydration

points.zh: 老师的推理：2,3-BPG 只是中间体，很快被消化成下一步产物；如果它在细胞内大量积累到能额外去结合血红蛋白，说明这一步已经比较「拥堵」。
points.en: His reasoning: 2,3-BPG is only an intermediate, normally consumed at once; if it piles up enough to bind haemoglobin as well, that step must be "congested".

points.zh: 他把积累解读为转化速率变慢，也就意味着细胞内耗能正在很快速地进行。
points.en: He reads the build-up as a slowed conversion rate, which he takes as a sign that the cell is burning energy fast.

points.zh: 他给出的生理链条：这时就需要血红蛋白把氧气释放出来，「氧气才能进一步地催化这个三羧酸循环」。
points.en: The physiological chain he gives: haemoglobin then releases O₂, and "only then can the oxygen catalyse the TCA cycle".

points.zh: 结论：他把 2,3-BPG 定位成一个促进下游三羧酸循环的调控信号，但认为这一步相对不重要，所以没有像调控步骤那样圈出来。
points.en: His conclusion: 2,3-BPG acts as a signal promoting the downstream TCA cycle — but he judges the step minor and does not circle it as a control point.

points.zh: 接着进入下一步，他说这个反应比较特殊，叫做烯醇化酶。
points.en: He then moves on, calling the next reaction a special one: enolase.

points.zh: 反应内容：把 C3 位的羟基连同它上面的一个氢一起脱去，等于脱去一分子水，在 C2—C3 之间形成一个双键；他在图上把产物水写了出来。
points.en: The chemistry: the C3 hydroxyl plus a hydrogen leave as one molecule of water, creating a C2=C3 double bond; he writes H₂O as a product.

points.zh: 酶名 enolase，词根 enol 就是烯醇——「烯」上直接连一个「醇」（羟基），这是有机化学里的叫法。
points.en: The enzyme is enolase; the root enol means exactly that — a hydroxyl attached directly to a double-bonded carbon, borrowed from organic chemistry.

points.zh: 他专门把这个小结构圈出来，并强调：烯醇的稳定性不好，这个结构不稳定，所以反应到这一步以后会很快发生下一步。
points.en: He circles the enol fragment and stresses its instability, which is why the reaction runs straight on to the next step.

extra.zh: 他说 2,3-BPG 是变位酶主路「拥堵」时溢出的中间体。实际上：变位酶催化循环里确有酶结合态的 2,3-BPG，但红细胞里游离的 2,3-BPG 来自 Rapoport–Luebering 支路——1,3-BPG 经 BPG 变位酶直接生成 2,3-BPG，再由 2,3-BPG 磷酸酶水解回 3-磷酸甘油酸。这是一条专用分流，绕过 PGK、不产 ATP，不是主路堵车的溢出。
extra.en: He presents 2,3-BPG as an intermediate spilling out when the mutase step is congested. In fact the mutase cycle uses enzyme-bound 2,3-BPG, while the free pool in erythrocytes comes from the Rapoport–Luebering shunt: 1,3-BPG → 2,3-BPG via BPG mutase, then back to 3-phosphoglycerate via 2,3-BPG phosphatase. It is a dedicated branch that bypasses PGK and makes no ATP — not an overflow.

extra.zh: 红细胞内 2,3-BPG 约 5 mM，与血红蛋白近似等摩尔。它结合在脱氧血红蛋白四聚体中央的正电空腔，稳定 T 态，使 O₂ 解离曲线右移、P50 升高（亲和力下降）。高原缺氧和慢性贫血时升高；库存血中逐渐耗尽，输血后放氧能力一度变差。走这条支路的代价是每分子葡萄糖少赚 1 个 ATP。
extra.en: Erythrocyte 2,3-BPG sits around 5 mM, roughly equimolar with haemoglobin. It binds the positively charged central cavity of deoxy-Hb, stabilising the T state, right-shifting the O₂ dissociation curve and raising P50. It rises at altitude and in chronic anaemia, and falls in stored blood. The shunt costs one ATP per glucose that goes through it.

extra.zh: 「氧气才能进一步催化三羧酸循环」——氧气不催化、也不直接参与 TCA 循环的任何一步。它是电子传递链末端的电子受体，通过氧化 NADH/FADH₂ 再生 NAD⁺，间接让 TCA 和糖酵解能继续跑。他讲的「耗能快→需要放氧」这个生理方向是对的，只是「催化」用词错。
extra.en: "Only then can oxygen catalyse the TCA cycle" — O₂ neither catalyses nor participates in any TCA step. It is the terminal electron acceptor of the respiratory chain; by reoxidising NADH/FADH₂ it regenerates NAD⁺ and thereby lets the TCA cycle and glycolysis keep running. His physiological direction is right; the word "catalyse" is not.

extra.zh: 烯醇化酶用两个 Mg²⁺ 稳定脱水产生的烯醇负离子中间体。它是氟化物的靶点：F⁻ 与 Pi、Mg²⁺ 形成复合物抑制烯醇化酶——这正是血糖采血管加氟化钠（灰头管）阻断糖酵解、防止血样里葡萄糖被红细胞耗掉的原理。
extra.en: Enolase uses two Mg²⁺ ions to stabilise the enolate intermediate. It is the target of fluoride: F⁻ with Pi and Mg²⁺ forms an inhibitory complex — which is why glucose blood-collection tubes contain sodium fluoride, to stop erythrocyte glycolysis eating the sample.

quiz.q_zh: 红细胞里游离的 2,3-BPG 主要由什么产生？
quiz.q_en: Where does the free 2,3-BPG pool in erythrocytes mainly come from?

options.zh: 磷酸戊糖途径非氧化分支的碳骨架重排产物
options.en: Carbon rearranged in the pentose phosphate arm

options.zh: 丙酮酸激酶反应生成的副产物在胞内累积
options.en: A by-product of the pyruvate kinase reaction

options.zh: 1,3-BPG 经 BPG 变位酶分流
options.en: 1,3-BPG diverted through the Rapoport shunt

options.zh: 磷酸甘油酸变位酶主路拥堵时溢出的游离中间体
options.en: Overflow from the congested mutase step itself

quiz.explain_zh: BPG 变位酶把 1,3-BPG 直接转成 2,3-BPG，再由 2,3-BPG 磷酸酶送回 3-磷酸甘油酸，这条支路专门为调节放氧而存在。变位酶主路上的 2,3-BPG 是酶结合态、只需催化量，不会大量溢出；磷酸戊糖途径产的是 NADPH 和核糖-5-磷酸；丙酮酸激酶的产物是丙酮酸和 ATP。
quiz.explain_en: BPG mutase converts 1,3-BPG straight to 2,3-BPG, and 2,3-BPG phosphatase returns it to 3-phosphoglycerate — a branch that exists to tune O₂ delivery. The mutase cycle's own 2,3-BPG stays enzyme-bound and catalytic; the pentose phosphate pathway yields NADPH and ribose-5-phosphate; pyruvate kinase yields pyruvate and ATP.

quiz.q_zh: 2,3-BPG 结合血红蛋白后产生什么效果？
quiz.q_en: What does 2,3-BPG do once it binds haemoglobin?

options.zh: 与血红素铁配位，把 Fe²⁺ 氧化成 Fe³⁺
options.en: Coordinates the haem iron, oxidising Fe²⁺ to Fe³⁺

options.zh: 结合脱氧血红蛋白中央空腔，稳定 T 态
options.en: Binds the deoxy-Hb cavity, stabilising T state

options.zh: 结合 α 亚基使血红蛋白解离成游离单体
options.en: Binds the α subunits and splits the tetramer up

options.zh: 结合氧合血红蛋白稳定 R 态，提高氧亲和力
options.en: Binds oxy-Hb, stabilises R and raises O₂ affinity

quiz.explain_zh: 2,3-BPG 是负变构效应物，插进脱氧血红蛋白四聚体中央的正电空腔，稳定低亲和力的 T 态，曲线右移。它对 R 态几乎不结合，所以不会提高亲和力；把 Fe²⁺ 氧化成 Fe³⁺ 得到的是高铁血红蛋白，与 2,3-BPG 无关；血红蛋白四聚体在生理条件下也不会因它而解离。
quiz.explain_en: 2,3-BPG is a negative allosteric effector: it wedges into the positively charged central cavity of deoxy-Hb, stabilising the low-affinity T state and right-shifting the curve. It barely binds the R state, so it cannot raise affinity; Fe²⁺→Fe³⁺ gives methaemoglobin, an unrelated process; and it does not dissociate the tetramer.

quiz.q_zh: 烯醇化酶催化的反应是哪一个？
quiz.q_en: Which reaction does enolase catalyse?

options.zh: PEP 加一分子水生成 2-磷酸甘油醛
options.en: PEP takes on water to give 2-phosphoglycerate

options.zh: 2-磷酸甘油酸经氧化脱氢生成烯醇丙酮酸
options.en: 2-phosphoglycerate is oxidised to enolpyruvate

options.zh: 3-磷酸甘油酸脱水后直接生成丙酮酸和水
options.en: 3-phosphoglycerate loses water to give pyruvate

options.zh: 2-磷酸甘油酸脱去一分子水生成 PEP
options.en: 2-phosphoglycerate loses one water to give PEP

quiz.explain_zh: 烯醇化酶是脱水酶：底物 2-磷酸甘油酸，产物磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸 PEP 加一分子水。3-磷酸甘油酸必须先由变位酶换到 C2 才能脱水，而且脱水的产物是 PEP 不是丙酮酸；正向反应不是水合；这一步没有氧化还原，不消耗 NAD⁺，也不产生 NADH。
quiz.explain_en: Enolase is a dehydratase: 2-phosphoglycerate in, phosphoenolpyruvate plus water out. 3-phosphoglycerate must first be moved to the 2-position by the mutase, and the product is PEP, not pyruvate; the forward reaction is not a hydration; and no redox occurs, so no NAD⁺ is used and no NADH made.

title_zh: 丙酮酸激酶：PEP 的高能磷酸与烯醇–酮式互变
title_en: Pyruvate kinase: the high-energy phosphate of PEP and the enol–keto shift

points.zh: 因为烯醇不稳定，反应立刻进入糖酵解最终一步：这个结构上面的磷酸基团给到另一分子 ADP，形成 ATP。
points.en: Because the enol is unstable the reaction runs straight into the last step of glycolysis: its phosphoryl group goes to another ADP, making ATP.

points.zh: 这是第二个直接产能的步骤，他同样用蓝色标记，连箭头也改成蓝色——蓝色专门代表直接产能。
points.en: This is the second directly energy-yielding step; he marks it blue and recolours the arrow too, blue being his code for direct ATP production.

points.zh: 磷酸转走以后先得到烯醇；他重申烯醇这个小结构不稳定，会继续变。
points.en: Losing the phosphate leaves an enol; he repeats that this fragment is unstable and will keep changing.

points.zh: 变化的方式：双键从碳碳之间挪到与氧结合，变成羰基形式，因为羰基比较稳定。
points.en: How it changes: the double bond shifts from the C=C to the carbon–oxygen bond, giving the more stable carbonyl.

points.zh: 最终产物就是丙酮酸 pyruvate；他在底下补写 CH₃ 让结构好认。
points.en: The end product is pyruvate; he adds CH₃ underneath to make the structure easier to read.

points.zh: 学生插问 CH₃ 是什么基：老师答是甲基，并顺带说 DNA 甲基化修饰上的也是这个基团。
points.en: Asked what CH₃ is, he answers methyl, adding that DNA methylation marks use the same group.

points.zh: 他把这一步称作「整个三羧酸循环的最后一步的产能反应」（随后在 01:31:40 自己改口为糖酵解过程结束）。
points.en: He calls this "the last energy-producing step of the whole TCA cycle" — and corrects himself at 01:31:40 to say it is glycolysis that ends here.

points.zh: 酶名 pyruvate kinase 丙酮酸激酶；老生常谈地需要 Mg²⁺，但比较特殊的是 Mn²⁺ 也可以取代 Mg²⁺ 去结合 ATP。
points.en: The enzyme is pyruvate kinase; as usual it needs Mg²⁺, but unusually Mn²⁺ can substitute for Mg²⁺ in binding ATP.

extra.zh: 字幕里两处说「磷酸基团给了这个 ATP 形成了 ATP」（01:30:00、01:36:31），受体应当是 ADP。他在 01:29:17 讲得完全正确——「又会给到另一分子的 ADP 上面形成 ATP」。记忆按 PEP + ADP → 丙酮酸 + ATP。
extra.en: Twice the transcript has "the phosphate is given to ATP to form ATP" (01:30:00, 01:36:31); the acceptor is ADP. He states it correctly at 01:29:17 — "it goes to another molecule of ADP to form ATP". Remember it as PEP + ADP → pyruvate + ATP.

extra.zh: 他说不稳定的烯醇「会变成丙酮，会变成这个羰基的形式」。羰基/酮式这半句对，但产物是丙酮酸的酮式（enolpyruvate → pyruvate 的互变异构），不是丙酮 acetone。丙酮是酮体，来自乙酰乙酸脱羧，与这一步毫无关系；两者差一个羧基。
extra.en: He says the unstable enol "becomes acetone, becomes the carbonyl form". The carbonyl half is right, but the product is the keto tautomer of pyruvate, not acetone. Acetone is a ketone body from acetoacetate decarboxylation — one carboxyl group away, and unrelated to this step.

extra.zh: PEP 水解 ΔG°′ ≈ −61.9 kJ/mol，是细胞里磷酸转移势能最高的化合物，能量的大头正来自产物烯醇式→酮式的互变异构；扣掉合成 ATP 的 +30.5，丙酮酸激酶总反应 ΔG°′ ≈ −31.4 kJ/mol，因此这一步实际上不可逆。
extra.en: PEP has ΔG°′ of hydrolysis ≈ −61.9 kJ/mol, the highest phosphoryl transfer potential in the cell, most of it released by the enol→keto tautomerisation of the product; after paying +30.5 to make ATP, the pyruvate kinase reaction is ΔG°′ ≈ −31.4 kJ/mol and effectively irreversible.

extra.zh: 丙酮酸激酶除二价金属外还需要单价阳离子 K⁺ 激活。哺乳动物有 M1（肌、脑）、M2（增殖细胞与肿瘤）、L（肝）、R（红细胞）多种同工酶；肝型 L 会被胰高血糖素经 PKA 磷酸化而失活，让肝在饥饿时不与糖异生打架。
extra.en: Beyond the divalent metal, pyruvate kinase also needs monovalent K⁺. Mammals express M1 (muscle, brain), M2 (proliferating cells and tumours), L (liver) and R (erythrocyte) isozymes; the liver L form is switched off by glucagon-driven PKA phosphorylation so that it does not fight gluconeogenesis during fasting.

quiz.q_zh: PEP 的磷酸基团转移势能特别高，主要原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: Why is the phosphoryl transfer potential of PEP so unusually high?

options.zh: 脱磷酸后产物由烯醇式互变成稳定酮式
options.en: The enol product then tautomerises to keto

options.zh: 磷酸接在羧基上形成高能的酰基磷酸酐
options.en: A phosphate sitting on a carboxyl as anhydride

options.zh: 分子内两个磷酸基团的静电排斥被解除
options.en: Repulsion between two phosphates is relieved

options.zh: 磷酸与 Mg²⁺ 螯合后键被拉长而断裂
options.en: Mg²⁺ chelation stretches and snaps the P–O bond

quiz.explain_zh: PEP 上的磷酸把产物锁在了烯醇式，一旦转走，烯醇立刻互变成能量低得多的酮式丙酮酸，这份互变异构的驱动力才是 −61.9 kJ/mol 的主要来源。酰基磷酸酐说的是 1,3-BPG C1 的情形；PEP 只有一个磷酸，谈不上两个磷酸互斥；Mg²⁺ 的作用是屏蔽电荷、稳定过渡态，不会自发把键拉断。
quiz.explain_en: The phosphate traps the product as an enol; once it leaves, the enol tautomerises to the far more stable keto form of pyruvate, and that tautomerisation supplies most of the −61.9 kJ/mol. The acyl-phosphate description belongs to C1 of 1,3-BPG; PEP carries only one phosphate, so there is no inter-phosphate repulsion; Mg²⁺ screens charge and stabilises the transition state rather than snapping bonds.

quiz.q_zh: 丙酮酸激酶把磷酸转给 ADP 之后，直接得到的产物是什么？
quiz.q_en: Immediately after pyruvate kinase transfers the phosphate to ADP, what is formed?

options.zh: 稳定的酮式丙酮酸，不再发生任何互变
options.en: The stable keto form, with no further shift

options.zh: 乙酰 CoA，再水解释放出游离丙酮酸
options.en: Acetyl-CoA, later hydrolysed to free pyruvate

options.zh: 烯醇式丙酮酸，随后互变为稳定酮式
options.en: Enolpyruvate, which then shifts to keto form

options.zh: 丙酮，随后再羧化一步才变成丙酮酸
options.en: Acetone, which is then carboxylated to pyruvate

quiz.explain_zh: 酶催化的是磷酸转移，得到的是烯醇式丙酮酸，随后非酶促地互变成酮式——这一步不可逆的能量正来自这里。丙酮是乙酰乙酸脱羧的酮体，与糖酵解无关；说「直接得到酮式、不再互变」等于抹掉了 PEP 高能的来源；乙酰 CoA 要等丙酮酸进线粒体后由丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体氧化脱羧才生成。
quiz.explain_en: The enzyme does phosphoryl transfer, giving enolpyruvate, which then tautomerises non-enzymatically to the keto form — the source of the step's irreversibility. Acetone is a ketone body from acetoacetate and has nothing to do with glycolysis; saying the keto form appears directly erases the origin of PEP's high energy; acetyl-CoA is made later, by the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex inside mitochondria.

title_zh: 糖酵解总账：2 NADH、4 ATP、净得 2 ATP
title_en: The glycolysis balance sheet: 2 NADH, 4 ATP, net 2 ATP

points.zh: 到这里整个糖酵解过程结束：葡萄糖经过这么多步反应，最终变成丙酮酸。
points.en: Glycolysis ends here: after all those steps, glucose has become pyruvate.

points.zh: 总账的第一半：一分子葡萄糖在准备阶段消耗两分子 ATP，生成两分子 GAP。
points.en: First half of the ledger: one glucose spends two ATP in the preparatory phase and yields two GAP.

points.zh: 关键的记账规则：图上 step 2 只画了一分子 GAP 的变化，所以放能相的每一步在整条途径里都要乘以 2。
points.en: The key bookkeeping rule: the board shows step 2 for only one GAP, so every reaction of the payoff phase counts twice.

points.zh: 因此产能阶段实际产生两分子 NADH 和四分子 ATP。
points.en: The payoff phase therefore produces two NADH and four ATP.

points.zh: 四分子 ATP 减去前面消耗的两分子，糖酵解一共净赚两分子 ATP。
points.en: Four ATP minus the two spent up front: glycolysis nets two ATP.

points.zh: 学生追问「NADH 不是 2.5 吗」；老师答：这里先不考虑 NADH，NADH 要到后面才转化成 ATP，所以只讨论 ATP 时糖酵解净赚两分子。
points.en: A student asks about NADH counting as 2.5; he answers that NADH is set aside here because it becomes ATP only later, so counting ATP alone gives a net of two.

points.zh: 接着讲糖酵解「比较重要的几个地方」，第一个就是不可逆的反应：第一步消耗一分子 ATP 的过程是不可逆的。
points.en: He then turns to the "important points" of the pathway, starting with irreversibility: the first step, which spends one ATP, cannot run backwards.

points.zh: 他给的经验规则：所有涉及能量产生的反应大部分都是不可逆的，只有一个步骤例外，他把可逆的那些标成绿色。
points.en: His rule of thumb: reactions that produce energy are mostly irreversible, with one exception; he colours the reversible ones green.

points.zh: 学生问「可逆的话 ATP 也要还回去吗」；老师答：从反应角度可以还回去，但不是必须，大部分情况下仍是不可逆的。
points.en: Asked whether reversibility means the ATP must be paid back, he says it can be in principle but need not be — most of these steps stay irreversible.

extra.zh: 总反应式：葡萄糖 + 2 NAD⁺ + 2 ADP + 2 Pi → 2 丙酮酸 + 2 NADH + 2 H⁺ + 2 ATP + 2 H₂O。耗 ATP 的是己糖激酶和 PFK-1 各一分子；产 ATP 的是磷酸甘油酸激酶和丙酮酸激酶，每分子葡萄糖各两次。
extra.en: Overall: glucose + 2 NAD⁺ + 2 ADP + 2 Pi → 2 pyruvate + 2 NADH + 2 H⁺ + 2 ATP + 2 H₂O. The two ATP spent go to hexokinase and PFK-1; the four made come from phosphoglycerate kinase and pyruvate kinase, each firing twice per glucose.

extra.zh: 学生说的「2.5」来自 P/O 比。胞质里的 NADH 本身进不了线粒体：经苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭进去仍是 NADH（约 2.5 ATP），经甘油磷酸穿梭则交给 FAD 变成 FADH₂（约 1.5 ATP）。所以有氧时糖酵解这一段贡献约 5–7 ATP，葡萄糖完全氧化合计约 30–32 ATP。
extra.en: The student's 2.5 comes from the P/O ratio. Cytosolic NADH cannot itself enter mitochondria: via the malate-aspartate shuttle it arrives as NADH (~2.5 ATP), via the glycerol-3-phosphate shuttle it is handed to FAD as FADH₂ (~1.5 ATP). Aerobically this part of the pathway contributes roughly 5-7 ATP, and complete oxidation of glucose gives about 30-32.

extra.zh: 「净得 2 ATP」是每分子葡萄糖的口径；「每分子 GAP 产 2 ATP」是每分子三碳糖的口径，两者差一个 ×2。考试里最常见的丢分方式就是把两个口径混着算，或者忘了 DHAP 也会被 TPI 转成 GAP 继续往下走。
extra.en: "Net 2 ATP" is per glucose; "2 ATP per GAP" is per triose — a factor of two apart. The classic exam slip is mixing the two frames, or forgetting that DHAP is also converted to GAP by TPI and travels the same road.

extra.zh: 无氧条件下这 2 分子 NADH 必须就地重新氧化成 NAD⁺，否则 GAPDH 因缺氧化型辅酶而停摆：动物走乳酸脱氢酶生成乳酸，酵母走丙酮酸脱羧酶＋乙醇脱氢酶生成乙醇。发酵本身不产 ATP，净收益仍然是 2 ATP。
extra.en: Anaerobically those 2 NADH must be reoxidised on the spot or GAPDH stalls for want of NAD⁺: animals use lactate dehydrogenase, yeast uses pyruvate decarboxylase plus alcohol dehydrogenase. Fermentation makes no ATP of its own; the net yield stays at 2.

quiz.q_zh: 每分子葡萄糖经糖酵解的 ATP 收支是多少？
quiz.q_en: What is the ATP budget of glycolysis per molecule of glucose?

options.zh: 消耗 2 分子、产生 6 分子，净得 4 分子
options.en: Two spent, six made, four net

options.zh: 消耗 2 分子、产生 4 分子，净得 2 分子
options.en: Two spent, four made, two net

options.zh: 消耗 2 分子、产生 2 分子，净得 0 分子
options.en: Two spent, two made, none net

options.zh: 消耗 1 分子、产生 4 分子，净得 3 分子
options.en: One spent, four made, three net

quiz.explain_zh: 己糖激酶和 PFK-1 各耗 1 分子 ATP；磷酸甘油酸激酶和丙酮酸激酶各产 1 分子，但因为一分子葡萄糖裂解成两分子三碳糖，这两步都要乘 2，共产 4 分子，净得 2。耗 1 产 4 漏掉了 PFK-1 那一分子；产 6 把 NADH 也算成了 ATP；产 2 则漏掉了乘 2。
quiz.explain_en: Hexokinase and PFK-1 each cost one ATP; phosphoglycerate kinase and pyruvate kinase each make one, but both fire twice because glucose splits into two trioses — four made, two net. "One spent" forgets PFK-1; "six made" counts the NADH as ATP; "two made" forgets to double the payoff phase.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么放能相每一步在总账里都要乘以 2？
quiz.q_en: Why is every payoff-phase step doubled in the balance sheet?

options.zh: 因为 NADH 每次带走两个电子所以要计两次
options.en: Because NADH carries two electrons each time

options.zh: 因为葡萄糖以两种端基异构体形式同时进入
options.en: Because glucose enters as two anomers in parallel

options.zh: 因为每个反应都需要两分子 ATP 同时参与
options.en: Because each of those steps consumes two ATP

options.zh: 因为醛缩酶把己糖切成两个三碳糖都往下走
options.en: Because aldolase gives two trioses, both go on

quiz.explain_zh: F-1,6-BP 被醛缩酶切成 DHAP 和 GAP，DHAP 又被 TPI 转成 GAP，于是一分子葡萄糖给出两分子 GAP，放能相跑两遍。放能相并不消耗 ATP；NADH 的两个电子属于一次反应的化学计量，不构成翻倍；α/β 端基异构体只是同一分子的构型平衡，不改变碳的分子数。
quiz.explain_en: Aldolase cleaves F-1,6-BP into DHAP and GAP, and TPI converts DHAP to GAP, so one glucose delivers two GAP and the payoff phase runs twice. The payoff phase consumes no ATP; the two electrons on NADH are stoichiometry within one reaction, not a doubling; and the α/β anomers are the same molecule in equilibrium.

quiz.q_zh: 关于糖酵解产生的那 2 分子 NADH，下面哪种说法正确？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about the 2 NADH made in glycolysis is correct?

options.zh: 需靠穿梭系统进线粒体，折算约 2.5
options.en: A shuttle takes them in, worth about 2.5 ATP

options.zh: 它们在胞质中由 ATP 合酶直接换成 ATP
options.en: ATP synthase converts them within the cytosol

options.zh: 它们已经折算在净得的那 2 分子 ATP 里
options.en: They are already inside the net yield of 2 ATP

options.zh: 无氧时由丙酮酸羧化酶负责把它们重新氧化
options.en: Pyruvate carboxylase reoxidises them without O₂

quiz.explain_zh: 胞质 NADH 不能直接跨线粒体内膜，苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭给出 NADH（约 2.5），甘油磷酸穿梭给出 FADH₂（约 1.5）。ATP 合酶在线粒体内膜上、由质子梯度驱动，胞质里没有；净得的 2 ATP 只算底物水平磷酸化，不含 NADH；无氧时重新氧化 NADH 的是乳酸脱氢酶，丙酮酸羧化酶做的是丙酮酸→草酰乙酸的糖异生第一步。
quiz.explain_en: Cytosolic NADH cannot cross the inner membrane: the malate–aspartate shuttle delivers NADH (~2.5), the glycerol-3-phosphate shuttle delivers FADH₂ (~1.5). ATP synthase sits in the inner membrane and runs on the proton gradient, not in the cytosol; the net 2 ATP counts only substrate-level phosphorylation; and anaerobic reoxidation is done by lactate dehydrogenase, while pyruvate carboxylase starts gluconeogenesis.

title_zh: 逐步回顾：哪几步不可逆，高能磷酸从哪里来
title_en: Step-by-step recap: which steps are irreversible, and where the high-energy phosphate comes from

points.zh: 第一步己糖激酶消耗一分子 ATP，不可逆。
points.en: Step one, hexokinase, spends one ATP and is irreversible.

points.zh: 第二步 G6P 变成 F6P 是可逆的，他称之为「一个变构的过程」（用词见 extra）。
points.en: Step two, G6P to F6P, is reversible; he calls it an "allosteric process" (see the correction card).

points.zh: 第三步 PFK 又消耗一分子 ATP，生成 F-1,6-BP（他也写作 FBP），同样不可逆；他的口诀是「消耗 ATP 的都不可逆」。
points.en: Step three, PFK, spends another ATP to give F-1,6-BP (which he also writes FBP), also irreversible; his mnemonic is "anything that spends ATP is irreversible".

points.zh: 他补充：产生 ATP 的步骤也大部分不可逆，只有磷酸甘油酸激酶这一个步骤是可逆的。
points.en: He adds that ATP-producing steps are mostly irreversible too, with phosphoglycerate kinase the single reversible one.

points.zh: F-1,6-BP 进一步分解成 DHAP 和 GAP，DHAP 又转化成 GAP；这就是 step 1 的终点——葡萄糖变成两分子带磷酸的三碳糖（丙糖）。
points.en: F-1,6-BP is split into DHAP and GAP, and DHAP is converted to GAP: the end of stage one, glucose turned into two phosphorylated trioses.

points.zh: step 2 里 GAP 先产生一分子 NADH 并上一个磷酸，这个刚上去的磷酸再掉下来变成 ATP，这两步都是可逆的。
points.en: In stage two GAP first makes one NADH while taking on a phosphate, and that same phosphate then comes off as ATP; both steps are reversible.

points.zh: 这一段前后的净变化是 3-磷酸甘油醛变成 3-磷酸甘油酸（醛被氧化成酸）。
points.en: The net change across that pair is glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate to 3-phosphoglycerate — aldehyde oxidised to acid.

points.zh: 关键论证：磷酸从三位挪到二位以后仍然不是高能形式，因为这个结构比较稳定，还不能产生 ATP；必须再脱去一分子水，形成不稳定的烯醇结构，磷酸才带上比较高的能量。
points.en: The key argument: after the phosphate moves from C3 to C2 it is still not a high-energy form, because that structure is stable; only after losing a water to give the unstable enol does the phosphate carry high energy.

points.zh: 最后一步也是不可逆的：磷酸给了 ADP 之后，烯醇不稳定，转变成丙酮酸的形式；讲完这些他说过程还没结束，接下来要看调控。
points.en: The last step is irreversible too: once the phosphate goes to ADP the unstable enol converts to pyruvate. He closes by saying the topic is not finished — regulation comes next.

extra.zh: 他用「变构」描述 G6P→F6P（01:34:24）和烯醇式→酮式（01:36:31）。这两处都是异构化 / 互变异构：G6P→F6P 是醛糖↔酮糖异构，酶叫 phosphoglucose isomerase 磷酸葡糖异构酶。「变构 allosteric」在生化里专指调节物结合到别构位点引起酶构象改变——本讲后面讲 PFK 调控时用的才是真正的变构。笔记里不能写成变构。
extra.en: He calls both G6P→F6P (01:34:24) and enol→keto (01:36:31) "allosteric" changes. Both are isomerisation or tautomerisation: G6P→F6P is an aldose-ketose isomerisation run by phosphoglucose isomerase. "Allosteric" is reserved for an effector binding a regulatory site and changing enzyme conformation — which is what he will mean later when discussing PFK. Do not carry his word into your notes here.

extra.zh: 标准答案是糖酵解有三个不可逆步骤：己糖激酶、PFK-1、丙酮酸激酶。判据是胞内 ΔG 大幅为负，不是「是否消耗 ATP」——丙酮酸激酶产 ATP 却照样不可逆。他的结论（前两步不可逆、PGK 可逆）对，但理由不成立。糖异生正是用四个旁路酶绕开这三步：丙酮酸羧化酶 + PEP 羧激酶、果糖-1,6-二磷酸酶、葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶。
extra.en: The standard answer: glycolysis has three irreversible steps — hexokinase, PFK-1 and pyruvate kinase. The criterion is a strongly negative in-cell ΔG, not whether ATP is spent; pyruvate kinase makes ATP and is still irreversible. His conclusions are right, his reason is not. Gluconeogenesis bypasses exactly these three with pyruvate carboxylase plus PEP carboxykinase, fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase and glucose-6-phosphatase.

extra.zh: 按标准条件 ΔG°′ 为正的步骤不止一个：醛缩酶 +23.8、磷酸丙糖异构酶 +7.5、磷酸甘油酸变位酶 +4.4、烯醇化酶 +1.8 kJ/mol。是靠后续反应不断抽走产物，胞内实际 ΔG 才都 ≤ 0——这正是「产物移除拉着吸能步骤走」的含义。
extra.en: More than one step has a positive ΔG°′: aldolase +23.8, triose phosphate isomerase +7.5, phosphoglycerate mutase +4.4, enolase +1.8 kJ/mol. Only because downstream reactions keep removing products is the actual in-cell ΔG of every step ≤ 0 — product removal pulling the endergonic steps along.

extra.zh: 把他的论证补完整：2-磷酸甘油酸上的是普通低能磷酸酯（水解 ΔG°′ 约 −17 kJ/mol）。脱水生成 PEP 后，磷酸把分子锁在烯醇式；一旦磷酸转走，烯醇立刻塌成酮式，这一步互变异构释放的能量才把总势能推到 −61.9 kJ/mol。所以「高能」不在磷酸键本身，而在产物能量太低。
extra.en: Completing his argument: the phosphate on 2-phosphoglycerate is an ordinary low-energy ester (ΔG°′ ≈ −17 kJ/mol). Dehydration to PEP locks the molecule in the enol form; the moment the phosphate leaves, the enol collapses to the keto form, and that tautomerisation is what drives the total to −61.9 kJ/mol. The "high energy" is not in the bond but in how low the product sits.

quiz.q_zh: 糖酵解中真正不可逆的是哪三步？
quiz.q_en: Which three steps of glycolysis are genuinely irreversible?

options.zh: PFK-1、GAPDH、磷酸甘油酸激酶
options.en: PFK-1, GAPDH and phosphoglycerate kinase itself

options.zh: 磷酸葡糖异构酶、磷酸丙糖异构酶、变位酶
options.en: Phosphoglucose isomerase, TPI and the mutase step

options.zh: 己糖激酶、PFK-1、丙酮酸激酶
options.en: Hexokinase, PFK-1 and pyruvate kinase itself

options.zh: 醛缩酶、烯醇化酶、磷酸甘油酸变位酶
options.en: Aldolase, enolase and the phosphoglycerate mutase

quiz.explain_zh: 这三步胞内 ΔG 大幅为负，也正是糖异生必须另设旁路酶的三个位置，因此也是三个调控点。醛缩酶和烯醇化酶标准条件下 ΔG°′ 还是正的，靠产物抽走才前进；GAPDH 与磷酸甘油酸激酶偶联、接近平衡，糖异生直接反向使用；异构酶和变位酶都是近平衡的可逆反应。
quiz.explain_en: These three have strongly negative in-cell ΔG, are exactly where gluconeogenesis needs bypass enzymes, and are therefore the control points. Aldolase and enolase have positive ΔG°′ and move only because products are removed; GAPDH and PGK are coupled, near equilibrium, and are simply run backwards in gluconeogenesis; the isomerases and the mutase are near-equilibrium too.

quiz.q_zh: 变位酶把磷酸挪到 C2 之后，为什么还不能直接产生 ATP？
quiz.q_en: After the mutase moves the phosphate to C2, why can it still not make ATP?

options.zh: 因为 C2 上仍是低能磷酸酯，须先脱水
options.en: The C2 ester is low-energy until dehydration

options.zh: 因为 C2 磷酸还要再磷酸化成二磷酸形式
options.en: The C2 phosphate must be phosphorylated again

options.zh: 因为此时 ADP 还没有与 Mg²⁺ 结合
options.en: Because ADP has not yet been complexed with Mg²⁺

options.zh: 因为变位酶的产物其实是 2,3-BPG
options.en: The mutase product is actually 2,3-BPG itself

quiz.explain_zh: 2-磷酸甘油酸的磷酸酯结构稳定、转移势能低于 ATP，只有烯醇化酶脱去一分子水生成 PEP，产物才能靠烯醇→酮式互变塌下去，磷酸才「变高能」。Mg·ADP 在整个胞质里随时可得，不是限制因素；变位酶的产物是 2-磷酸甘油酸，2,3-BPG 只是酶结合态中间体；糖酵解里没有把它再磷酸化成二磷酸这一步。
quiz.explain_en: The ester on 2-phosphoglycerate is stable and its transfer potential is below ATP's; only after enolase removes a water to give PEP can the product collapse from enol to keto, which is what makes the phosphate "high energy". Mg·ADP is freely available in the cytosol; the mutase product is 2-phosphoglycerate, with 2,3-BPG only an enzyme-bound intermediate; and no second phosphorylation occurs here.

quiz.q_zh: 关于 G6P 变成 F6P 这一步，正确的描述是什么？
quiz.q_en: How should the G6P to F6P step be described?

options.zh: 消耗一分子 ATP 把六元环打开的磷酸化
options.en: A phosphorylation that spends one ATP per ring

options.zh: 磷酸从 C6 移到 C1 的分子内变位反应
options.en: An intramolecular phosphate shift from C6 to C1

options.zh: 醛糖变酮糖的异构化，由磷酸葡糖异构酶催化
options.en: An aldose-to-ketose isomerisation, formula kept

options.zh: 调节物结合别构位点引起构象改变的变构反应
options.en: An allosteric change caused by a bound effector

quiz.explain_zh: 这一步经烯二醇中间体把 C1 醛基变成 C2 酮基，分子式不变但共价结构改变，酶是 phosphoglucose isomerase。磷酸始终留在 C6，没有移位；「变构 allosteric」是别构调节的专有名词，不能用来指骨架异构；这一步不消耗 ATP，六元环变五元环是成环方式改变而非磷酸化的结果。
quiz.explain_en: It converts the C1 aldehyde to a C2 ketone through an enediol intermediate — same formula, different covalent structure — catalysed by phosphoglucose isomerase. The phosphate stays on C6; "allosteric" is reserved for regulatory-site effects and cannot describe a skeletal isomerisation; and no ATP is used, the ring size change being a consequence of the isomerisation, not of phosphorylation.

title_zh: 转入调控：为什么调控是这一章的核心（含约 40 秒中断）
title_en: Turning to regulation: why control is the core of this chapter (includes a ~40 s break)

points.zh: 01:37:04 起约四十秒老师重新登录设备，无课程内容，回来后接着讲。
points.en: From 01:37:04 there is a roughly forty-second gap while he logs back in; no course content, and he resumes straight afterwards.

points.zh: 全过程虽然讲完了，但还没有结束——还要看整个糖酵解过程是怎么调控的。
points.en: The pathway is finished but the topic is not: what remains is how glycolysis is regulated.

points.zh: 他强调调控的分量：糖酵解和三羧酸循环这一章里调控非常重要，是生化的核心——机体用不同方式手段调节反应快慢、调节能量与代谢的平衡。
points.en: He stresses the weight of it: regulation in the glycolysis/TCA chapter is the core of biochemistry — how the body tunes reaction rates and balances energy and metabolism.

points.zh: 先补上刚才漏讲的一点：最后一步的丙酮酸激酶也是受调控的，他先讲对它的抑制。
points.en: He first fills a gap he had left: the final enzyme, pyruvate kinase, is regulated too, starting with its inhibition.

points.zh: 他说丙酮酸激酶的调控和前面讲过的磷酸果糖激酶 PFK 比较像。
points.en: He notes that pyruvate kinase is regulated much like the phosphofructokinase step covered earlier.

points.zh: PFK 那一步就是他在图上画了两个圈的那一步——被他标为重点的调控步骤。
points.en: The PFK step is the one he had double-circled on the board as a key regulatory point.

points.zh: 他回头提问：第一阶段里最重要的那一步，调控因素是什么？
points.en: He turns it into a question: what regulates the most important step of the first stage?

points.zh: 学生答「它的产物会反过来抑制它自己」；老师指出那说的是第一步（己糖激酶）的产物反馈抑制，学生把两步记混了，并承认自己提示得有点问题。
points.en: A student answers "its product inhibits it"; he points out that this is the product feedback on step one, hexokinase — the student has conflated the two — and concedes his own prompt was misleading.

extra.zh: 全课都没有提到 PFK-1 最强的变构激活剂 F-2,6-BP：由双功能酶 PFK-2/FBPase-2 合成。胰高血糖素经 cAMP-PKA 磷酸化这个双功能酶，激酶活性关掉、磷酸酶活性打开，F-2,6-BP 下降，糖酵解减速而糖异生加速；胰岛素方向相反。它同时激活 PFK-1 并抑制果糖-1,6-二磷酸酶，一个分子把两条相反通路一起扳过去。
extra.en: The lecture never mentions PFK-1's strongest allosteric activator, F-2,6-BP, made by the bifunctional enzyme PFK-2/FBPase-2. Glucagon acting through cAMP–PKA phosphorylates that enzyme, switching the kinase off and the phosphatase on; F-2,6-BP falls, glycolysis slows and gluconeogenesis speeds up, with insulin doing the reverse. One molecule both activates PFK-1 and inhibits fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase, throwing both opposing pathways at once.

extra.zh: 三个调控点的效应物各不相同，别互相串：己糖激酶被产物 G6P 反馈抑制（肝的葡萄糖激酶不受此抑制）；PFK-1 被 ATP、柠檬酸、H⁺ 抑制，被 AMP、ADP、F-2,6-BP 激活；丙酮酸激酶被 ATP、乙酰 CoA、长链脂肪酸和丙氨酸抑制，被上游的 F-1,6-BP 前馈激活。
extra.en: The three control points have different effectors and must not be blended: hexokinase is feedback-inhibited by its product G6P (liver glucokinase is not); PFK-1 is inhibited by ATP, citrate and H⁺ and activated by AMP, ADP and F-2,6-BP; pyruvate kinase is inhibited by ATP, acetyl-CoA, long-chain fatty acids and alanine, and feed-forward activated by upstream F-1,6-BP.

extra.zh: PFK-1 才是糖酵解真正的限速步骤，也是「决定性一步」committed step：己糖激酶的产物 G6P 还可以转去糖原合成或磷酸戊糖途径，只有过了 PFK-1，碳才必然走完糖酵解。这也是为什么最强的调控信号都集中在这一步。
extra.en: PFK-1 is the true rate-limiting and committed step: hexokinase's product G6P can still be diverted to glycogen synthesis or the pentose phosphate pathway, whereas past PFK-1 the carbon is committed to glycolysis. That is why the strongest regulatory signals converge there.

extra.zh: 三个调控点正好就是三个不可逆步骤，这不是巧合：近平衡的可逆步骤由底物/产物浓度支配，调节酶量或酶活性几乎改变不了通量；只有远离平衡（ΔG 强负）的步骤，酶活性才直接决定通过速率，才值得安装调控阀门。
extra.en: The three control points coincide with the three irreversible steps, and not by accident: near-equilibrium steps are governed by substrate and product concentrations, so changing enzyme activity barely shifts flux; only far-from-equilibrium steps have flux set by the enzyme itself, and only they are worth a valve.

quiz.q_zh: 己糖激酶受什么反馈抑制？
quiz.q_en: What feedback-inhibits hexokinase?

options.zh: 它自己的产物 6-磷酸葡萄糖 G6P
options.en: Its own product, glucose-6-phosphate (G6P)

options.zh: PFK-1 的产物果糖-1,6-二磷酸
options.en: Fructose-1,6-bisphosphate from the PFK-1 step

options.zh: 三羧酸循环输出的柠檬酸和长链脂肪酸
options.en: Citrate together with long-chain fatty acids

options.zh: 底物葡萄糖本身浓度过高时的自身抑制
options.en: Substrate glucose itself when levels run high

quiz.explain_zh: G6P 累积说明下游用不掉，产物反馈抑制己糖激酶（肝的葡萄糖激酶例外，不受 G6P 抑制）。F-1,6-BP 抑制的对象不是己糖激酶，它反而前馈激活丙酮酸激酶；柠檬酸和脂肪酸分别作用于 PFK-1 和丙酮酸激酶；葡萄糖是底物，浓度高只会加快反应而不是抑制。
quiz.explain_en: Accumulating G6P signals that downstream demand is met, and it inhibits hexokinase (liver glucokinase excepted). F-1,6-BP does not target hexokinase — it feed-forward activates pyruvate kinase; citrate and fatty acids act on PFK-1 and pyruvate kinase respectively; and glucose is the substrate, so raising it accelerates rather than inhibits.

quiz.q_zh: PFK-1 最强的变构激活剂是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the most potent allosteric activator of PFK-1?

options.zh: G6P，由己糖激酶催化的第一步生成
options.en: G6P, generated by the hexokinase step itself

options.zh: F-2,6-BP，由 PFK-2 合成
options.en: F-2,6-BP, made by the bifunctional PFK-2

options.zh: F-1,6-BP，由 PFK-1 自身产生
options.en: F-1,6-BP, piling up as the product of PFK-1

options.zh: 柠檬酸，它由三羧酸循环向胞质大量输出
options.en: Citrate, exported in quantity by the TCA cycle

quiz.explain_zh: F-2,6-BP 提高 PFK-1 对 F-6-P 的亲和力并解除 ATP 抑制，是体内最强的激活信号，由 PFK-2/FBPase-2 双功能酶按激素状态合成或降解。F-1,6-BP 是 PFK-1 的产物，它激活的是下游丙酮酸激酶；柠檬酸表示碳源充足，是 PFK-1 的抑制剂；G6P 反馈抑制的是己糖激酶。
quiz.explain_en: F-2,6-BP raises PFK-1's affinity for F-6-P and relieves ATP inhibition — the strongest activating signal in vivo — made or destroyed by PFK-2/FBPase-2 according to hormonal state. F-1,6-BP is PFK-1's product and activates the downstream pyruvate kinase; citrate signals carbon sufficiency and inhibits PFK-1; G6P feeds back on hexokinase.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么代谢调控点几乎都落在不可逆步骤上？
quiz.q_en: Why do metabolic control points sit almost always at irreversible steps?

options.zh: 因为可逆步骤的酶几乎都没有别构调节位点
options.en: Reversible steps have no allosteric sites at all

options.zh: 因为不可逆步骤的酶都必须有 Mg²⁺ 参与
options.en: Irreversible steps all need Mg²⁺ as cofactor

options.zh: 因为近平衡步骤的通量由底物产物浓度决定
options.en: Near-equilibrium flux is set by concentrations

options.zh: 因为只有消耗 ATP 的步骤才能被激素调节
options.en: Only ATP-spending steps can respond to hormones

quiz.explain_zh: 近平衡步骤即使把酶活性改几倍，通量仍被两侧浓度拉回去，调它没有意义；远离平衡的步骤酶活性直接决定通过速率，才是有效的阀门。可逆步骤的酶不是没有别构位点，只是调它无效；Mg²⁺ 是所有激酶的共同需求，与可逆性无关；丙酮酸激酶产 ATP 却照样被 PKA 磷酸化调节。
quiz.explain_en: At a near-equilibrium step, changing enzyme activity several-fold leaves flux pinned by the concentrations on either side, so regulating it achieves nothing; at a far-from-equilibrium step the enzyme sets the throughput and makes an effective valve. Reversible-step enzymes are not devoid of allosteric sites, regulation there is simply futile; Mg²⁺ is common to all kinases and unrelated to reversibility; and pyruvate kinase makes ATP yet is hormonally phosphorylated.

title_zh: 调控因素点名：G6P、ATP/ADP 与 H⁺、F-1,6-BP 前馈
title_en: Naming the effectors: G6P, the ATP/ADP ratio and H⁺, and feed-forward F-1,6-BP

points.zh: 澄清学生记混的地方：产物反馈抑制说的是第一步，己糖激酶 hexokinase。
points.en: He clears up the student's confusion: product feedback inhibition belongs to step one, hexokinase.

points.zh: 理由：己糖激酶的特异性不是那么高（它接受多种己糖），所以机体给它装了产物抑制。
points.en: His reasoning: hexokinase is not very specific — it takes several hexoses — so the body puts product inhibition on it.

points.zh: 他指出肝里的那个（葡萄糖激酶）是不受这个抑制影响的，肝外的己糖激酶才受抑制。
points.en: He notes that the liver enzyme (glucokinase) is not affected by this inhibition, while the extrahepatic hexokinases are.

points.zh: PFK 这一步的第一个调控因素：ATP 与 ADP 的比值——他解释成「带 γ 磷酸和不带 γ 磷酸形式的比值」。
points.en: The first effector on the PFK step: the ATP/ADP ratio — which he glosses as the ratio of the form with the γ phosphate to the form without.

points.zh: 第二个调控因素是氢离子；他在板上写成方括号 [H⁺]，说明方括号代表某个东西的浓度。
points.en: The second is hydrogen ion; he writes it in square brackets on the board, explaining that brackets denote concentration.

points.zh: 丙酮酸激酶这一步也比较类似：同样受 ATP 影响，ATP 越多代表下游能量越充足，生成 pyruvate 的过程就越缓慢。
points.en: Pyruvate kinase behaves similarly: ATP inhibits it, since more ATP means the downstream energy supply is ample and pyruvate production should slow.

points.zh: 比较特殊的是它还受 1,6-二磷酸果糖 F-1,6-BP 调节——就是两边都带磷酸的那个形式；他把它加粗放大、涂成绿色写进框里。
points.en: The distinctive one: it is also regulated by fructose-1,6-bisphosphate, the form carrying a phosphate at both ends; he bolds, enlarges and greens it inside a box.

points.zh: 学生问「那个不是酶吗」；老师澄清 F16P 不是酶，是 1,6-二磷酸果糖这个代谢物，随即开始解释这个调节为什么成立（本段在此结束）。
points.en: A student asks whether F16P is an enzyme; he clarifies that it is the metabolite fructose-1,6-bisphosphate, and begins explaining why this regulation makes sense as the segment ends.

extra.zh: 他连说「它的抑制」而始终没点名抑制剂，学生因此记混了一次。必须写明：己糖激酶（HK I–III，Km ≈ 0.1 mM）被产物 6-磷酸葡萄糖抑制；肝的葡萄糖激酶就是己糖激酶 IV，Km ≈ 10 mM、不被 G6P 抑制，改由调节蛋白 GKRP 与果糖-6-磷酸/果糖-1-磷酸控制其入核出核。顺带一提，葡萄糖激酶和己糖激酶是同工酶 isozyme，不是两类无关的酶。
extra.en: He repeatedly says "its inhibition" without naming the inhibitor, which is what confused the student. Write it out: hexokinases I–III (Km ≈ 0.1 mM) are inhibited by their product glucose-6-phosphate; liver glucokinase is hexokinase IV, Km ≈ 10 mM, not inhibited by G6P, and is instead controlled by the regulatory protein GKRP together with fructose-6-phosphate and fructose-1-phosphate. Note also that glucokinase and hexokinase are isozymes, not unrelated enzymes.

extra.zh: F-1,6-BP 对丙酮酸激酶是前馈激活 feed-forward activation：上游 PFK-1 一放行，产物 F-1,6-BP 就提前把下游最后一步打开，让整条通路同步提速，避免中间产物在管道里堆积。方向与「产物反馈抑制」正好相反，肝型 PK 对它最敏感。
extra.en: F-1,6-BP acts on pyruvate kinase as feed-forward activation: as soon as PFK-1 opens the gate, its product switches on the last step in advance so the whole pathway accelerates together and intermediates do not pile up in the pipe. It is the mirror image of product feedback inhibition, and the liver L isozyme is the most sensitive to it.

extra.zh: H⁺ 抑制 PFK-1 的生理意义他没有讲清（本讲前面还把 H⁺ 说成能量充足的标志）。实际上：剧烈运动时无氧糖酵解产乳酸使胞质 pH 下降，低 pH 反过来关掉 PFK-1、限制酵解通量，这是防止乳酸酸中毒的负反馈——H⁺ 升高恰恰发生在能量紧缺的时候。能用来合成 ATP 的质子梯度在线粒体内膜两侧，与胞质 pH 是两个完全不同的质子池。
extra.en: He never makes the physiology of H⁺ inhibition clear (earlier in the lecture he even treats H⁺ as a sign of energy sufficiency). In fact: during hard exercise anaerobic glycolysis makes lactate, cytosolic pH falls, and the low pH shuts PFK-1 down to limit flux — a negative feedback against lactic acidosis. H⁺ rises precisely when energy is short. The proton gradient that can make ATP lies across the inner mitochondrial membrane and is a different pool from cytosolic pH.

extra.zh: ATP 对 PFK-1 既是底物又是别构抑制剂：底物位点 Km 低，生理浓度下早已饱和；别构位点亲和力低，只有 ATP 升高时才结合，把 F-6-P 的 K0.5 抬高、动力学曲线由双曲线变成 S 形。AMP 竞争解除这一抑制，而腺苷酸激酶反应（2 ADP ⇌ ATP + AMP）使 ATP 略降时 AMP 成倍上升，因此 AMP 是比 ATP 灵敏得多的能荷信号。
extra.en: ATP is both substrate and allosteric inhibitor of PFK-1: the catalytic site has a low Km and is saturated at physiological levels, while the low-affinity regulatory site is occupied only when ATP rises, raising the K0.5 for F-6-P and turning the kinetics from hyperbolic to sigmoidal. AMP competitively relieves this, and because adenylate kinase (2 ADP ⇌ ATP + AMP) multiplies AMP for a small drop in ATP, AMP is by far the more sensitive energy-charge signal.

quiz.q_zh: 肝脏的葡萄糖激酶与肝外己糖激酶相比，区别在哪里？
quiz.q_en: How does liver glucokinase differ from the extrahepatic hexokinases?

options.zh: 葡萄糖激酶 Km 低得多，被 G6P 强烈抑制
options.en: Glucokinase has a lower Km and is inhibited by G6P

options.zh: 葡萄糖激酶 Km 高得多，且不被 G6P 抑制
options.en: Glucokinase has a high Km and is free of G6P

options.zh: 葡萄糖激酶不需要 ATP 就能磷酸化葡萄糖
options.en: Glucokinase phosphorylates glucose without ATP

options.zh: 葡萄糖激酶直接把肝糖原分解成 6-磷酸葡萄糖
options.en: Glucokinase turns liver glycogen straight into G6P

quiz.explain_zh: 葡萄糖激酶即己糖激酶 IV，Km ≈ 10 mM，只有餐后血糖高时才高速运转，且不被 G6P 反馈抑制，因此能持续把入肝的葡萄糖清进肝里；低 Km 且被 G6P 抑制的是 HK I–III。它同样是 ATP 依赖的激酶；糖原分解走的是糖原磷酸化酶 → G1P → 磷酸葡萄糖变位酶 → G6P，与葡萄糖激酶无关。
quiz.explain_en: Glucokinase is hexokinase IV, Km ≈ 10 mM, so it runs fast only when portal glucose is high, and being free of G6P feedback it keeps clearing glucose into the liver; the low-Km, G6P-inhibited enzymes are HK I–III. It is an ordinary ATP-dependent kinase, and glycogen breakdown proceeds via glycogen phosphorylase to G1P and then phosphoglucomutase to G6P, bypassing it entirely.

quiz.q_zh: F-1,6-BP 对丙酮酸激酶起什么作用？
quiz.q_en: What does F-1,6-BP do to pyruvate kinase?

options.zh: 前馈激活，使下游与上游通量同步提速
options.en: Feed-forward activation matching upstream flux

options.zh: 反馈抑制，防止丙酮酸在胞质里过量堆积
options.en: Feedback inhibition that holds pyruvate down

options.zh: 作为底物被丙酮酸激酶磷酸化成 PEP
options.en: Serves as the substrate turned into PEP here

options.zh: 竞争性抑制，与 PEP 争夺同一个活性位点
options.en: Competitive inhibition, contesting the PEP site

quiz.explain_zh: F-1,6-BP 是 PFK-1 的产物，它结合丙酮酸激酶的别构位点使之激活，属于前馈激活：上游一开闸，下游提前打开，避免中间产物堆积。它不是抑制剂；丙酮酸激酶的底物是 PEP 和 ADP，F-1,6-BP 在通路上游好几步，不进活性位点，也就谈不上与 PEP 竞争。
quiz.explain_en: F-1,6-BP is PFK-1's product and activates pyruvate kinase through an allosteric site — feed-forward activation, opening the downstream gate as soon as the upstream one opens so intermediates do not accumulate. It is not an inhibitor; pyruvate kinase's substrates are PEP and ADP, and F-1,6-BP sits several steps upstream, never entering the catalytic site to compete.

quiz.q_zh: H⁺ 浓度升高抑制 PFK-1，其生理意义是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the physiological point of H⁺ inhibiting PFK-1?

options.zh: 限制无氧酵解产乳酸，防止乳酸酸中毒
options.en: Braking lactate output, averting acidosis

options.zh: 表示能量已经充足，所以把糖酵解关掉
options.en: Signalling that energy is already plentiful

options.zh: 把线粒体的质子梯度反馈给胞质中的酶
options.en: Relaying the mitochondrial gradient to cytosol

options.zh: 提示氧气充足，可以改走三羧酸循环产能
options.en: Reporting ample oxygen so the TCA takes over

quiz.explain_zh: 剧烈运动时无氧酵解产乳酸使胞质酸化，低 pH 关小 PFK-1 这个阀门，属于负反馈保护。H⁺ 升高恰恰发生在能量紧缺时，不是能量充足的标志（能荷信号是 ATP/ADP 与 AMP）；可用于合成 ATP 的质子梯度在线粒体内膜两侧，与胞质 pH 是两个池；缺氧才产乳酸，氧气充足时胞质反而不酸化。
quiz.explain_en: Hard exercise makes lactate, the cytosol acidifies, and low pH throttles PFK-1 — a protective negative feedback. H⁺ rises exactly when energy is short, so it is no marker of sufficiency (that job belongs to ATP/ADP and AMP); the ATP-making proton gradient lies across the inner mitochondrial membrane, a separate pool from cytosolic pH; and lactate accumulates when oxygen is scarce, not when it is plentiful.

title_zh: 前馈调节：F-1,6-BP 激活丙酮酸激酶
title_en: Feed-forward activation of pyruvate kinase by F-1,6-BP

points.zh: 他先回到图上标了双框的那一步，指出 PFK-1 催化的这一步是整个糖酵解的限速反应。
points.en: He goes back to the double-boxed step on the slide and identifies the PFK-1 reaction as the rate-limiting step of the whole of glycolysis.

points.zh: 限速步骤的产物 1,6-二磷酸果糖（他一直写作 F16P）反过来激活下游生成 pyruvate 的那一步，也就是丙酮酸激酶。
points.en: The product of that rate-limiting step, fructose-1,6-bisphosphate (which he writes throughout as F16P), activates the downstream step that makes pyruvate, i.e. pyruvate kinase.

points.zh: 他把这种上游产物提前激活下游酶的关系命名为前馈调节 feed-forward regulation。
points.en: He names this relationship, an upstream product activating a downstream enzyme in advance, feed-forward regulation.

points.zh: 他用一分子葡萄糖举例：反应还没走到最后一步，中间产物就已经把最后那个酶激活了。
points.en: He walks through it with a single glucose molecule: before the flux has even reached the last step, the intermediate has already switched on the enzyme that catalyses it.

points.zh: 他强调的意义是：等底物真正流到丙酮酸激酶时，这个酶已经处在高活力状态，反应可以顺利往下走。
points.en: The point he stresses: by the time substrate actually arrives at pyruvate kinase, the enzyme is already in a high-activity state, so flux passes through smoothly.

points.zh: 他现场把 F16P 加粗、放大、涂成绿色并框起来，说明这是要记的重点标记。
points.en: He bolds, enlarges, colours green and boxes F16P live on the slide, marking it as something to remember.

points.zh: 他总结整个糖酵解有两个最重要的调节：一个是限速步骤本身，另一个是通过前馈调节控制 pyruvate kinase。
points.en: He summarises that glycolysis has two regulatory events that matter most: the rate-limiting step itself, and the feed-forward control of pyruvate kinase.

points.zh: 他指出这两步都与能量的产生有关，并且受不同物质的调节。
points.en: He notes that both of these steps are tied to energy output and that each is controlled by a different set of metabolites.

points.zh: 他预告后面还有很多其他调节方式，稍后会着重讲。
points.en: He flags that there are many further modes of regulation coming, which he will cover in detail shortly.

extra.zh: 前馈激活的分子层面：F-1,6-BP 结合在丙酮酸激酶的别构位点上，把酶从低亲和力的 T 态推向高亲和力的 R 态，使 PEP 的饱和曲线从 S 型变得接近双曲线，即在同样的 PEP 浓度下速率大幅上升。它不是把 Vmax 提上去，而是把酶对底物的表观亲和力提上去。
extra.en: What feed-forward activation is at the molecular level: F-1,6-BP binds an allosteric site on pyruvate kinase and shifts the enzyme from the low-affinity T state toward the high-affinity R state, turning the sigmoidal PEP saturation curve into a near-hyperbolic one, so rate rises sharply at the same PEP concentration. It raises apparent substrate affinity, not Vmax.

extra.zh: 为什么偏偏是这一对：PFK-1 和丙酮酸激酶之间隔着六步反应，中间物（三碳糖磷酸、1,3-BPG、PEP）都不能积累。上游一旦决定放行，下游出口必须同步打开，否则中间段会堵。前馈激活就是这个同步机制，也是教科书里糖酵解唯一的前馈激活例子。
extra.en: Why this particular pair: six reactions separate PFK-1 from pyruvate kinase, and none of the intermediates in between (triose phosphates, 1,3-BPG, PEP) may accumulate. Once the upstream valve commits, the downstream exit has to open with it or the middle of the pathway backs up. Feed-forward activation is that coupling, and it is the textbook example of feed-forward control in glycolysis.

extra.zh: F-1,6-BP 和 F-2,6-BP 名字只差一个数字，作用完全不同：F-1,6-BP 是 PFK-1 的产物、是通路上的真中间物、前馈激活丙酮酸激酶；F-2,6-BP 由 PFK-2 生成、根本不是通路中间物、只作信号分子去激活 PFK-1。他在本讲后半段（约 01:51:39 起）才讲 F-2,6-BP，此前所有 F16P 都指 1,6。
extra.en: F-1,6-BP and F-2,6-BP differ by one digit and by everything else: F-1,6-BP is the product of PFK-1, a genuine pathway intermediate, and it feed-forward activates pyruvate kinase; F-2,6-BP is made by PFK-2, is not a pathway intermediate at all, and exists purely as a signal that activates PFK-1. He only reaches F-2,6-BP later in this lecture (from about 01:51:39); every F16P before that means 1,6.

extra.zh: 丙酮酸激酶不止受前馈激活。肝型 PKL 在胰高血糖素信号下被 PKA 磷酸化而失活，这样肝在饥饿时不会把刚做好的 PEP 又烧掉，而是留给糖异生；ATP、乙酰 CoA、长链脂肪酸和丙氨酸都是它的别构抑制剂。所以这一步同时接收前馈信号和全身激素信号。
extra.en: Pyruvate kinase receives more than the feed-forward signal. The liver isozyme PKL is phosphorylated and switched off by PKA under glucagon, so that a fasting liver does not burn the PEP it has just made but leaves it for gluconeogenesis; ATP, acetyl-CoA, long-chain fatty acids and alanine are all allosteric inhibitors. The step therefore integrates a local feed-forward signal with a whole-body hormonal one.

quiz.q_zh: 糖酵解中的前馈调节具体指哪一对关系？
quiz.q_en: Which pairing is the feed-forward regulation in glycolysis?

options.zh: ATP 积累后别构抑制磷酸果糖激酶-1
options.en: Accumulated ATP allosterically inhibits PFK-1

options.zh: G6P 反馈抑制己糖激酶的磷酸化活性
options.en: G6P feedback-inhibits hexokinase in muscle

options.zh: F-1,6-BP 别构激活丙酮酸激酶
options.en: F-1,6-BP allosterically opens pyruvate kinase

options.zh: 柠檬酸出线粒体后别构抑制 PFK-1
options.en: Citrate leaving the mitochondria inhibits PFK-1

quiz.explain_zh: 前馈的定义是上游产物提前把下游的酶打开，F-1,6-BP 激活丙酮酸激酶正是如此。ATP 抑制 PFK-1、G6P 抑制己糖激酶、柠檬酸抑制 PFK-1 都真实存在，但它们都是下游信号回头关闭上游，属于反馈抑制，方向正好相反。
quiz.explain_en: Feed-forward means an upstream product opens a downstream enzyme ahead of the flux, which is exactly what F-1,6-BP does to pyruvate kinase. ATP on PFK-1, G6P on hexokinase and citrate on PFK-1 are all real, but each is a downstream signal shutting an upstream step, i.e. feedback inhibition, running the opposite way.

quiz.q_zh: 前馈激活丙酮酸激酶的生理意义是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does feed-forward activation of pyruvate kinase achieve?

options.zh: 底物流到该酶时它已处于高活性
options.en: The enzyme is already highly active on arrival

options.zh: 让该步变为可逆以便直接糖异生
options.en: It makes the step reversible for gluconeogenesis

options.zh: 压低 PFK-1 活性防止中间物堆积
options.en: It lowers PFK-1 activity to stop pile-up

options.zh: 使己糖激酶不再被自身产物抑制
options.en: It frees hexokinase from product inhibition

quiz.explain_zh: 前馈的价值在时间差：上游一放行，下游出口就先开好，中间六步的产物不会堵在半路。丙酮酸激酶这一步 ΔG 大幅为负，别构激活并不能让它变可逆，糖异生要靠丙酮酸羧化酶加 PEP 羧激酶绕过去；前馈是激活不是压低 PFK-1；己糖激酶的产物抑制由 G6P 浓度决定，与 F-1,6-BP 无关。
quiz.explain_en: The value of feed-forward is timing: the exit opens before the flux arrives, so the six intervening intermediates never back up. The pyruvate kinase step has a strongly negative ΔG and allosteric activation cannot make it reversible, which is why gluconeogenesis bypasses it with pyruvate carboxylase plus PEP carboxykinase. Feed-forward activates rather than suppresses PFK-1, and hexokinase product inhibition is set by G6P, not by F-1,6-BP.

title_zh: 丙酮酸的去路（一）：进入 TCA 与乳酸发酵
title_en: Fates of pyruvate I: the TCA cycle and lactate fermentation

points.zh: 他先给这一段定性：从丙酮酸去路开始，后面的内容以了解为主，不是重要考点，大概看一下就行。
points.en: He first sets the level: from the fates of pyruvate onward the material is background rather than examinable, and a quick read is enough.

points.zh: 他说 90% 以上的 pyruvate 都是直接进入 TCA cycle（三羧酸循环），其他去路只占非常少的比例。
points.en: He says over 90% of pyruvate goes straight into the TCA cycle and that the other routes account for only a small fraction.

points.zh: 第一条支路是生成乳酸，他说这是许多厌氧细菌产生能量的主要方式。
points.en: The first branch he covers is lactate, which he describes as the main energy-yielding route for many anaerobic bacteria.

points.zh: 他给的理由是：厌氧细菌没有氧气，不能进行三羧酸循环，所以发明了这种方式。
points.en: His reasoning: anaerobic bacteria have no oxygen and therefore cannot run the TCA cycle, so they invented this route instead.

points.zh: 机制上他讲的是把 NADH 上的氢重新还回到 pyruvate 上，结果是 NADH 被重新氧化。
points.en: Mechanistically he describes handing the hydrogen on NADH back onto pyruvate, with the result that NADH is re-oxidised.

points.zh: 他特意说这里不能叫电子传递链，而是靠别的化学反应把 NADH 重新利用起来。
points.en: He pointedly says this must not be called an electron transport chain; some other chemistry recycles the NADH.

points.zh: 他承认这一步看起来是把能量消耗掉，但强调它实际上让厌氧细菌别的产能方式能够继续。
points.en: He concedes the step looks like throwing energy away, but insists it is what allows the anaerobe other energy-yielding processes to continue.

points.zh: 学生插问 NADH 是不是一种辅酶，老师回答是辅酶。
points.en: A student asks whether NADH is a coenzyme; he answers that it is.

points.zh: 他给的辅酶定义：辅酶不是蛋白质，是一种化学小分子，NADH 就是这样一坨可以结合氢离子的东西。
points.en: His working definition: a coenzyme is not a protein but a small chemical molecule, and NADH is just such a thing, one that can carry hydrogen.

extra.zh: 他说 90% 以上的丙酮酸「直接进入 TCA cycle」。丙酮酸不是三羧酸循环的中间物，也不能直接进循环：它先经单羧酸转运体进线粒体基质，由丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体（PDH）氧化脱羧成乙酰 CoA，乙酰 CoA 再与草酰乙酸缩合成柠檬酸才算进入循环。而且这个比例只在有氧、有线粒体的组织成立——成熟红细胞根本没有线粒体，全部丙酮酸走乳酸。
extra.en: He says over 90% of pyruvate goes directly into the TCA cycle. Pyruvate is not a cycle intermediate and cannot enter directly: it is carried into the mitochondrial matrix, oxidatively decarboxylated by the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex to acetyl-CoA, and only then condensed with oxaloacetate to citrate. The proportion also holds only for aerobic, mitochondria-bearing tissue; mature erythrocytes have no mitochondria at all and send all their pyruvate to lactate.

extra.zh: 乳酸发酵写全就是一步反应：pyruvate + NADH + H+ →（乳酸脱氢酶 LDH）lactate + NAD+。整条反应的唯一目的是把 NAD+ 还回去，让糖酵解第 6 步 GAPDH 有氧化型辅酶可用。细胞里 NAD+ 加 NADH 的总量很小，如果不再生，糖酵解在几秒内就会停在 GAPDH 这一步。乳酸是废物，不是目的——他讲到「重新氧化 NADH」这个落点是完全正确的。
extra.en: Lactate fermentation is one reaction: pyruvate + NADH + H+ → lactate + NAD+, catalysed by lactate dehydrogenase. Its entire purpose is to hand NAD+ back so that step 6, GAPDH, has oxidised cofactor to work with. The cellular NAD+ plus NADH pool is small; without regeneration glycolysis stalls at GAPDH within seconds. Lactate is waste, not the goal, and his landing point about re-oxidising NADH is exactly right.

extra.zh: 「没有氧就不能跑 TCA」这个因果要说细一点：氧的需求在电子传递链/氧化磷酸化那一端，不在 TCA 循环的酶身上。缺氧时 ETC 停摆，NADH 和 FADH2 无法再氧化，循环因为缺少氧化型辅酶而停转，不是因为酶不存在。许多严格厌氧菌保留完整或分支型的 TCA，用来供应 α-酮戊二酸、琥珀酰 CoA 这些生物合成前体。
extra.en: The causal chain behind no oxygen, no TCA needs one more link: the oxygen requirement sits in the electron transport chain and oxidative phosphorylation, not in the TCA enzymes. Without oxygen the chain stops, NADH and FADH2 cannot be re-oxidised, and the cycle halts for lack of oxidised cofactor rather than for lack of enzymes. Many strict anaerobes keep a complete or branched TCA to supply biosynthetic precursors such as α-ketoglutarate and succinyl-CoA.

extra.zh: 他说「辅酶不是蛋白质，是化学小分子」是对的，但这个大类里还要再分：辅酶 coenzyme 指 NAD+、FAD、CoA、TPP 这类可解离的有机小分子；辅基 prosthetic group 指与酶紧密或共价结合、不解离的有机分子（如琥珀酸脱氢酶上的 FAD、血红素）；辅因子 cofactor 是最大的那个筐，还包括 Mg2+、Zn2+ 这类金属离子。他在本讲前面几次把 Mg2+ 叫作辅酶，按辅因子记。
extra.en: His statement that a coenzyme is not a protein but a small molecule is right, but the family splits further: coenzymes are dissociable organic small molecules such as NAD+, FAD, CoA and TPP; prosthetic groups are organic molecules bound tightly or covalently and never released, like the FAD of succinate dehydrogenase or a haem; cofactor is the widest term and also covers metal ions such as Mg2+ and Zn2+. Earlier in this lecture he called Mg2+ a coenzyme; record it as a cofactor.

quiz.q_zh: 乳酸脱氢酶把丙酮酸还原成乳酸，对细胞的直接意义是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does reducing pyruvate to lactate immediately do for the cell?

options.zh: 把乳酸作为燃料输出给心肌和肝
options.en: It exports lactate as fuel to other tissues

options.zh: 再生 NAD+ 维持糖酵解继续
options.en: It regenerates NAD+ so glycolysis continues

options.zh: 额外生成 ATP 补上能量缺口
options.en: It makes extra ATP to cover the anaerobic gap

options.zh: 把丙酮酸变成乙酰 CoA 进循环
options.en: It converts pyruvate into usable acetyl-CoA

quiz.explain_zh: 这一步本身是净耗还原力、不产 ATP 的，它的唯一产出是 NAD+，供糖酵解第 6 步继续。乳酸被送到肝再变回葡萄糖（Cori 循环）确实存在，但那是全身层面的后果而不是这一步的直接意义；生成乙酰 CoA 是丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体的活，与 LDH 无关。
quiz.explain_en: The reaction consumes reducing power and yields no ATP; its only product of value is NAD+, which keeps step 6 of glycolysis turning. Shipping lactate to liver for reconversion (the Cori cycle) is real but is a whole-body consequence, not the immediate point of the step, and making acetyl-CoA is the job of the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, not LDH.

quiz.q_zh: 丙酮酸进入三羧酸循环之前必须先经过什么？
quiz.q_en: What must happen to pyruvate before the TCA cycle?

options.zh: 由丙酮酸羧化酶羧化成草酰乙酸后进入
options.en: Pyruvate carboxylase carboxylates it to oxaloacetate

options.zh: 由 PDH 复合体脱羧成乙酰 CoA
options.en: The pyruvate dehydrogenase complex makes acetyl-CoA

options.zh: 先由乳酸脱氢酶还原成乳酸，再进线粒体
options.en: Lactate dehydrogenase reduces it, then it enters

options.zh: 由丙酮酸激酶磷酸化成磷酸烯醇丙酮酸
options.en: Pyruvate kinase phosphorylates it back to PEP

quiz.explain_zh: 进入循环的分子是乙酰 CoA，由 PDH 复合体在线粒体基质中氧化脱羧生成。乳酸是离开循环的支路；丙酮酸激酶催化的是丙酮酸之前的一步且不可逆；丙酮酸羧化酶生成草酰乙酸确有其事，但那是补充循环中间物的回补反应（anaplerotic），不是丙酮酸被氧化利用的入口。
quiz.explain_en: What enters the cycle is acetyl-CoA, produced by oxidative decarboxylation in the mitochondrial matrix. Lactate is a branch leading away from the cycle; pyruvate kinase catalyses the irreversible step before pyruvate, not after it; and pyruvate carboxylase to oxaloacetate is genuine but anaplerotic, topping up cycle intermediates rather than serving as the oxidative entry point.

title_zh: 乙醇发酵，以及泡菜里的乳酸到底是谁产的
title_en: Alcoholic fermentation, and who really makes the lactate in pickles

points.zh: 他说乳酸这条途径主要发生在厌氧细菌，并补充「虽然酵母不算细菌」，但酵母里也大量发生。
points.en: He says the lactate route is mainly a matter for anaerobic bacteria, then adds that although yeast is not a bacterium the same thing happens there a great deal.

points.zh: 他说这就是酵母消耗糖的一种方式，并举例：用酵母发酵泡菜可以产生乳酸，靠的就是这条途径。
points.en: He presents it as one of the ways yeast consumes sugar, with the example that fermenting pickles with yeast produces lactate by this route.

points.zh: 第二条支路：丙酮酸脱去一个二氧化碳，他把脱掉的部分说成「一个二碳单位」。
points.en: The second branch: pyruvate loses one carbon dioxide, which he describes as losing a two-carbon unit.

points.zh: 他说这一步靠 TPP 催化，并点明 TPP 就是维生素 B1。
points.en: He says the step runs on TPP and points out that TPP is vitamin B1.

points.zh: 他顺带总结：维生素 B 家族基本上都可以作为辅酶，各有各的作用。
points.en: He generalises in passing that the B vitamins essentially all serve as coenzymes, each with its own role.

points.zh: 产物他讲的是先生成乙醛，再生成乙醇。
points.en: He gives the products as acetaldehyde first, then ethanol.

points.zh: 他连说两遍这个过程「很少见」，说只在一些细菌里，真核生物里基本很少见到这种过程。
points.en: He twice calls the process rare, saying it occurs in some bacteria and hardly ever in eukaryotes.

points.zh: 他给的理由是：乙醛或乙醇对人体有很大危害，生物不可能产生一种把自己弄死的东西。
points.en: His justification: acetaldehyde and ethanol are very harmful to humans, and an organism would not make something that kills itself.

points.zh: 他把这条支路定位为「只需要了解就 OK 了」。
points.en: He files this branch under background knowledge only.

extra.zh: 他说「用酵母发酵泡菜可以产生乳酸」，这里归错了菌。酿酒酵母 Saccharomyces cerevisiae 走的是乙醇发酵，基本不含乳酸脱氢酶；泡菜、酸菜、酸奶里的乳酸来自乳酸菌（Lactobacillus、Leuconostoc 等）。关键差别在一个酶：乳酸菌没有丙酮酸脱羧酶，丙酮酸下不了乙醛这条路，只能用 LDH 还原成乳酸来再生 NAD+。他在本段内没有自我更正。
extra.en: Attributing the lactate in pickles to yeast puts it on the wrong organism. Saccharomyces cerevisiae ferments to ethanol and carries essentially no lactate dehydrogenase; the lactate in pickles, sauerkraut and yoghurt comes from lactic acid bacteria such as Lactobacillus and Leuconostoc. One enzyme makes the difference: lactic acid bacteria lack pyruvate decarboxylase, so the acetaldehyde route is closed to them and they must regenerate NAD+ by reducing pyruvate with LDH instead. He does not correct this later.

extra.zh: 他紧接着说乙醛/乙醇这条路「基本只在细菌里见，真核生物里很少」，这正好说反了，也和他一分钟前说的酵母自相矛盾。乙醇发酵恰恰是真核生物酵母的标志性代谢，酿酒、面包发酵全靠它；淹水缺氧的植物根、部分真菌也能做。反过来，食品发酵里的细菌多数走的是乳酸路线。「生物不可能产生把自己弄死的东西」也不成立：酵母对乙醇的耐受远高于竞争微生物，产乙醇正是它压制对手的手段。他没有自我更正。
extra.en: He then says the acetaldehyde/ethanol route is basically bacterial and rare in eukaryotes, which is backwards and contradicts what he said a minute earlier about yeast. Alcoholic fermentation is the signature metabolism of a eukaryote, yeast; brewing and bread both depend on it, and flooded plant roots and some fungi do it too. Conversely, most food-fermenting bacteria take the lactate route. Nor does no organism makes what kills it hold: yeast tolerates ethanol far better than its competitors, and producing it is precisely how it suppresses them.

extra.zh: 「脱掉一个二碳单位」应为脱掉一个碳。丙酮酸是三碳（C3），丙酮酸脱羧酶脱去的是羧基上的那一个碳，以 CO2 放出；剩下的乙醛才是二碳单位。若真按他说的脱掉二碳，就只剩一个碳，和乙醛、乙醇都对不上。
extra.en: Losing a two-carbon unit should be losing one carbon. Pyruvate is C3; pyruvate decarboxylase removes the carboxyl carbon as CO2, and the acetaldehyde left behind is the two-carbon unit. If a two-carbon unit really left, only one carbon would remain, which fits neither acetaldehyde nor ethanol.

extra.zh: 把两条发酵放在一起看，这一整段才立得住：所有发酵存在的唯一理由都是再生 NAD+，好让糖酵解在无氧时继续跑，产物（乳酸、乙醇）是废物而不是目的。乙醇发酵两步酶：丙酮酸脱羧酶 PDC（TPP 依赖，放 CO2，不可逆，这也是面包发起来的气泡来源）加乙醇脱氢酶 ADH（含 Zn2+，把 NADH 氧化回 NAD+）。乳酸发酵一步：LDH。两条路的 NAD+ 账目完全一样，差别只在细胞有没有 PDC。
extra.en: The whole passage only coheres when the two fermentations are read together: every fermentation exists to regenerate NAD+ so that glycolysis can keep running without oxygen, and the product, lactate or ethanol, is waste rather than the objective. Alcoholic fermentation takes two enzymes: pyruvate decarboxylase (TPP-dependent, releases the CO2 that raises bread, irreversible) then alcohol dehydrogenase (a Zn2+ enzyme that oxidises NADH back to NAD+). Lactate fermentation takes one, LDH. The NAD+ bookkeeping is identical; the only difference is whether the cell has PDC.

quiz.q_zh: 酿酒酵母在无氧条件下把丙酮酸变成什么，用哪些酶？
quiz.q_en: Anaerobically, what does brewing yeast turn pyruvate into, and how?

options.zh: 变成乙醇，由脱羧酶和乙醇脱氢酶
options.en: To ethanol, by pyruvate decarboxylase and ADH

options.zh: 变成草酰乙酸，由丙酮酸羧化酶完成
options.en: To oxaloacetate, by pyruvate carboxylase

options.zh: 变成乳酸，由乳酸脱氢酶一步完成
options.en: To lactate, by lactate dehydrogenase alone

options.zh: 变成乙酰 CoA，由丙酮酸脱氢酶完成
options.en: To acetyl-CoA, by the PDH complex in mitochondria

quiz.explain_zh: 酵母基本没有乳酸脱氢酶，走的是丙酮酸脱羧酶放 CO2 生成乙醛、再由乙醇脱氢酶用 NADH 还原成乙醇这两步。丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体是有氧条件下进线粒体的路；丙酮酸羧化酶生成草酰乙酸是糖异生和回补反应，都不解决无氧时 NAD+ 再生的问题。
quiz.explain_en: Yeast has essentially no lactate dehydrogenase; it uses pyruvate decarboxylase to release CO2 and give acetaldehyde, then alcohol dehydrogenase to reduce that with NADH to ethanol. The pyruvate dehydrogenase complex is the aerobic mitochondrial route, and pyruvate carboxylase to oxaloacetate serves gluconeogenesis and anaplerosis; neither regenerates NAD+ under anaerobic conditions.

quiz.q_zh: 泡菜、酸菜里的乳酸主要由什么产生？
quiz.q_en: What actually produces the lactate in pickles and sauerkraut?

options.zh: 乳酸菌，缺脱羧酶只能走 LDH
options.en: Lactic acid bacteria, lacking decarboxylase

options.zh: 酵母，用乳酸脱氢酶还原丙酮酸产酸
options.en: Yeast, reducing pyruvate with its own LDH

options.zh: 醋酸菌，把乙醇进一步氧化成酸
options.en: Acetic acid bacteria oxidising the ethanol

options.zh: 蔬菜自身无氧糖酵解积累的乳酸
options.en: The vegetable cells own anaerobic glycolysis

quiz.explain_zh: 乳酸菌缺少丙酮酸脱羧酶，乙醛这条路走不了，只能用乳酸脱氢酶把丙酮酸还原成乳酸来拿回 NAD+，这就是泡菜变酸的来源。酵母走的是乙醇发酵，基本不含 LDH；醋酸菌把乙醇氧化成的是乙酸，不是乳酸；植物组织缺氧时主要走乙醇发酵，产量也远不足以决定泡菜的酸度。
quiz.explain_en: Lactic acid bacteria lack pyruvate decarboxylase, so the acetaldehyde route is unavailable and they must reclaim NAD+ by reducing pyruvate with lactate dehydrogenase, which is what sours the jar. Yeast ferments to ethanol and carries essentially no LDH; acetic acid bacteria oxidise ethanol to acetate, not lactate; and hypoxic plant tissue mostly makes ethanol, nowhere near enough to set the acidity.

quiz.q_zh: 乳酸发酵和乙醇发酵共同的根本目的是什么？
quiz.q_en: What do lactate and alcoholic fermentation both exist to do?

options.zh: 为三羧酸循环提供碳骨架前体
options.en: Supply carbon skeletons to the TCA cycle

options.zh: 再生 NAD+ 维持糖酵解通量
options.en: Regenerate NAD+ to sustain glycolytic flux

options.zh: 在无氧条件下额外多合成 ATP
options.en: Synthesise extra ATP under anaerobic conditions

options.zh: 把丙酮酸转成可排出的无毒废物
options.en: Turn pyruvate into a harmless excretable waste

quiz.explain_zh: 两条发酵本身都不产 ATP，反而消耗一分子 NADH；ATP 全部来自糖酵解底物水平磷酸化，发酵只是让这条线不停。乳酸和乙醇都是要排掉的废物，把它说成发酵的目的就把因果颠倒了；发酵产物也不回流进 TCA 循环，缺氧时循环本来就转不动。
quiz.explain_en: Neither fermentation makes ATP; each spends an NADH. All the ATP comes from substrate-level phosphorylation in glycolysis, and fermentation merely keeps that line moving. Lactate and ethanol are waste to be disposed of, so calling their production the purpose inverts cause and effect, and neither feeds back into the TCA cycle, which cannot turn without oxygen anyway.

title_zh: 糖酵解调节总论：长期与短期，三个不可逆步骤
title_en: Regulation of glycolysis: long- versus short-term, and three irreversible steps

points.zh: 他把糖酵解的调节单独拎出来，说这是本章比较重要的部分，前面提过一些，这里再补充几种方式。
points.en: He brings up regulation as a section of its own, calling it one of the more important parts of the chapter and adding several modes to what he mentioned earlier.

points.zh: 他把调节分成两类：长期调控和短期调控。
points.en: He splits regulation into long-term and short-term control.

points.zh: 长期调控他说靠激素，举了胰高血糖素，并说它可以综合调节整个消化系统的功能，从而控制糖酵解速率。
points.en: Long-term control he assigns to hormones, giving glucagon as the example and saying it regulates the function of the whole digestive system and thereby the rate of glycolysis.

points.zh: 短期调控他说更重要，就是通过 ATP、NADH 这些代谢物直接调节酶。
points.en: Short-term control he calls the more important one: metabolites such as ATP and NADH acting directly on the enzymes.

points.zh: 他给出总原则：糖酵解过程中催化不可逆反应的酶，都是控制代谢的有力调节点。
points.en: He states the general principle that the enzymes catalysing irreversible reactions are the effective control points of the pathway.

points.zh: 他回到图上逐个指认：丙酮酸激酶那一步不可逆，所以可以被调节；最开始那一步也不可逆，也可以被调节。
points.en: He walks back over the map: the pyruvate kinase step is irreversible so it can be regulated, and the very first step is irreversible too, so it can be regulated as well.

points.zh: 第一步他说调节的是己糖激酶，而且是它自己的产物反过来抑制它；紧接着他把这个酶名说成了葡糖激酶。
points.en: For the first step he says the regulated enzyme is hexokinase and that its own product inhibits it; in the very next breath he names the enzyme glucokinase.

points.zh: 他把图上所有绿色框先说成「抑制」，同一句里自己改口：都是调节，不是抑制。
points.en: He first calls every green box on the slide an inhibition, then corrects himself within the same sentence: they are all regulation, not inhibition.

points.zh: 他指出可逆的那些步骤不是很强的调节过程，并总结整个糖酵解一共三步不可逆，每一步都受很多调节。
points.en: He notes the reversible steps are not strong control points and concludes that glycolysis has three irreversible steps in all, each heavily regulated.

extra.zh: 胰高血糖素不是「消化系统的总调节因子」。它由胰岛 α 细胞在低血糖时分泌，靶器官主要是肝：经 cAMP-PKA 促进肝糖原分解和糖异生升高血糖，同时 PKA 磷酸化双功能酶 PFK-2/FBPase-2 使 F-2,6-BP 下降，于是 PFK-1 被关小、糖酵解降速。所以它确实控制糖酵解速率，但走的是明确的肝内信号通路，不是笼统调节消化功能。
extra.en: Glucagon is not a general regulator of the digestive system. It is secreted by pancreatic α cells when blood glucose falls, and its main target is the liver: through cAMP and PKA it drives glycogenolysis and gluconeogenesis to raise blood glucose, while PKA phosphorylation of the bifunctional PFK-2/FBPase-2 enzyme lowers F-2,6-BP, closing PFK-1 down and slowing glycolysis. It does set glycolytic rate, but through a specific hepatic signalling route rather than by governing digestion at large.

extra.zh: 他说「G6P 反过来抑制这个葡糖激酶的活性」，把酶名说串了。受产物 G6P 反馈抑制的是己糖激酶 I–III（肌肉、脑等）；肝脏的葡萄糖激酶就是己糖激酶 IV，恰恰不被 G6P 抑制，它由 GKRP 结合与果糖-1-磷酸/F6P 调节。他自己在约 01:56:04 把「葡萄糖激酶不受 G6P 抑制」讲对了，做笔记按后面那次记。
extra.en: Saying that G6P inhibits glucokinase mixes up the names. Product inhibition by G6P applies to hexokinases I–III in muscle, brain and elsewhere; the liver enzyme, glucokinase, is hexokinase IV and is specifically not inhibited by G6P, being controlled instead by the regulatory protein GKRP together with fructose-1-phosphate and F6P. He gets this right himself at about 01:56:04, so take the later statement.

extra.zh: 三个不可逆步骤具体是：己糖激酶（第 1 步）、PFK-1（第 3 步）、丙酮酸激酶（第 10 步）。判据是细胞内实际 ΔG 大幅为负、远离平衡，而不是「消耗 ATP」——丙酮酸激酶反而产 ATP。这三处正是糖异生必须绕道的地方，分别用葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶、果糖-1,6-二磷酸酶-1、以及丙酮酸羧化酶加 PEP 羧激酶来反向通过，构成三个底物循环。
extra.en: The three irreversible steps are hexokinase (step 1), PFK-1 (step 3) and pyruvate kinase (step 10). The criterion is a strongly negative in-cell ΔG, far from equilibrium, not ATP consumption: pyruvate kinase in fact produces ATP. These are exactly the three points gluconeogenesis must bypass, using glucose-6-phosphatase, fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase-1, and pyruvate carboxylase plus PEP carboxykinase, forming three substrate cycles.

extra.zh: 长期与短期不只是名字的差别，时间尺度差好几个数量级：短期调控是别构效应和共价修饰（磷酸化），秒到分钟级，改变的是现有酶分子的活性；长期调控是转录水平改变酶的数量（胰岛素诱导葡萄糖激酶、PFK-1、丙酮酸激酶的转录，胰高血糖素抑制），小时到天级。考试里问「快速响应」几乎总是指别构。
extra.en: Long- and short-term differ by orders of magnitude in timescale, not just in label. Short-term control is allosteric and covalent (phosphorylation), acting over seconds to minutes on the activity of enzyme molecules already present; long-term control changes how many enzyme molecules exist, through transcription (insulin induces glucokinase, PFK-1 and pyruvate kinase; glucagon represses them), over hours to days. When an exam asks about rapid response it almost always means allostery.

quiz.q_zh: 糖酵解中哪三步是不可逆的、因而成为主要调节点？
quiz.q_en: Which three glycolytic steps are irreversible control points?

options.zh: 磷酸葡糖异构酶、PFK-1、GAPDH
options.en: Phosphoglucose isomerase, PFK-1 and GAPDH

options.zh: PFK-1、磷酸甘油酸激酶、烯醇化酶
options.en: PFK-1, phosphoglycerate kinase and enolase

options.zh: 己糖激酶、醛缩酶、烯醇化酶这三步
options.en: Hexokinase, aldolase, and enolase reactions

options.zh: 己糖激酶、PFK-1、丙酮酸激酶三步
options.en: Hexokinase, PFK-1 and pyruvate kinase

quiz.explain_zh: 判据是细胞内 ΔG 远离平衡而大幅为负。醛缩酶、磷酸葡糖异构酶、烯醇化酶、磷酸甘油酸激酶和 GAPDH 在细胞内都接近平衡、可以双向运行，糖异生正是直接借用这些酶反着跑；只有己糖激酶、PFK-1、丙酮酸激酶必须由另外的酶绕过去。
quiz.explain_en: The criterion is an in-cell ΔG far from equilibrium and strongly negative. Aldolase, phosphoglucose isomerase, enolase, phosphoglycerate kinase and GAPDH all sit near equilibrium and run either way, which is why gluconeogenesis simply reuses them in reverse; only hexokinase, PFK-1 and pyruvate kinase have to be bypassed by different enzymes.

quiz.q_zh: 胰高血糖素升高时，肝脏糖酵解为什么减慢？
quiz.q_en: Why does glucagon slow hepatic glycolysis?

options.zh: 它升高 F-2,6-BP，加快糖酵解的通量
options.en: It raises F-2,6-BP and thereby activates PFK-1

options.zh: 它诱导葡萄糖激酶转录，使摄糖加快
options.en: It falls: glucagon blocks the PFK-1 enzyme itself

options.zh: 它经 PKA 使 F-2,6-BP 下降
options.en: Via PKA it lowers F-2,6-BP and closes PFK-1

options.zh: 它直接与丙酮酸激酶结合并使其失活
options.en: It binds pyruvate kinase directly and blocks it

quiz.explain_zh: 胰高血糖素经 cAMP-PKA 磷酸化双功能酶 PFK-2/FBPase-2，关掉激酶域、打开磷酸酶域，F-2,6-BP 水解掉，PFK-1 失去最强激活剂而降速。它不直接结合丙酮酸激酶（是经 PKA 磷酸化肝型 PKL）；升高 F-2,6-BP 是胰岛素的效果；诱导葡萄糖激酶转录同样是胰岛素干的，方向相反。
quiz.explain_en: Glucagon acts through cAMP and PKA to phosphorylate the bifunctional PFK-2/FBPase-2 enzyme, switching the kinase domain off and the phosphatase domain on; F-2,6-BP is hydrolysed away and PFK-1 loses its strongest activator. Glucagon does not bind pyruvate kinase directly (it acts by PKA phosphorylation of the liver isozyme), while raising F-2,6-BP and inducing glucokinase transcription are both insulin effects, running the other way.

title_zh: 为什么调节都落在不可逆步骤；PFK-1 的 ATP 别构抑制
title_en: Why control sits on irreversible steps; allosteric inhibition of PFK-1 by ATP

points.zh: 学生先提问：PFK 这一步之所以重要，是不是因为产生太多 pyruvate 对机体有害、也无法代谢；老师回答「对对对，你可以这样理解」。
points.en: A student asks whether the PFK step matters because too much pyruvate would be harmful and impossible to metabolise; he answers that yes, it can be understood that way.

points.zh: 他给出通则：这类调节大多数情况下都是抑制不可逆的过程。
points.en: He states the general rule that regulation of this kind mostly means inhibiting irreversible steps.

points.zh: 他的理由是：不可逆过程没办法通过可逆平衡来缓解反应的危害，只能靠别的方式尽量减缓。
points.en: His reasoning: an irreversible step cannot relieve itself through a reversible equilibrium, so the only option is to slow it from outside.

points.zh: 他说在机体内，反应过度倾向某个方向、某种物质过度积累，都是不好的。
points.en: He says that in the body, pushing a reaction too far in one direction, or letting any one substance accumulate, is bad.

points.zh: 他点出唯一的例外：F-1,6-BP 对丙酮酸激酶是激活调节，也就是前面讲的前馈调节。
points.en: He flags the exception: F-1,6-BP acting on pyruvate kinase is activating, the feed-forward regulation covered earlier.

points.zh: 转入 PFK 的细节：他说这个酶有多个别构位点，而且「好像也是一个多聚体」。
points.en: Turning to PFK in detail, he says the enzyme has several allosteric sites and is, he thinks, a multimer.

points.zh: 他说 PFK 受 ATP 调节，动力学是 S 型曲线，并类比前面讲过的血红蛋白别构调节。
points.en: He says PFK is regulated by ATP with sigmoidal kinetics, drawing the analogy to the haemoglobin allostery covered in an earlier lecture.

points.zh: ATP 浓度高时：酶活性被抑制，即使底物 F6P 浓度增加，反应速率也只是缓慢上升。
points.en: At high ATP the enzyme is inhibited: even as the substrate F6P rises, the rate climbs only slowly.

points.zh: ATP 浓度低时：曲线就不是 S 型了，底物稍微增加一点速率就上升很多，他说这是比较好感性理解的一点。
points.en: At low ATP the curve is no longer sigmoidal: a small rise in substrate lifts the rate a lot, which he says is easy to feel intuitively.

extra.zh: 学生那句「丙酮酸产生太多对机体有害、无法代谢」老师顺口认了，但丙酮酸并不是毒性代谢物：丙酮酸钠是常规细胞培养基成分，也做膳食补充剂。PFK-1 被严格调控的真正理由是把糖酵解通量与细胞能荷、以及下游生物合成的需求匹配起来——葡萄糖是有限资源，不该烧过头。临床上真正危险的是无氧酵解过强时乳酸堆积造成的乳酸酸中毒，那是乳酸不是丙酮酸。
extra.en: He accepts the student framing that excess pyruvate would be harmful and unmetabolisable, but pyruvate is not a toxic metabolite: sodium pyruvate is a routine cell-culture ingredient and a dietary supplement. PFK-1 is tightly controlled in order to match glycolytic flux to the cell energy charge and to downstream biosynthetic demand, because glucose is a finite resource that should not be burned past need. The genuine clinical danger is lactic acidosis from lactate accumulating during heavy anaerobic glycolysis, and that is lactate, not pyruvate.

extra.zh: 他讲的 ATP 抑制之所以成立，关键在 ATP 在这个酶上有两个身份：它既是催化位点的底物（高亲和力，永远被占着），又结合一个独立的、低亲和力的别构位点。浓度升高时先饱和催化位点，再占住别构位点，把酶推向低亲和力的 T 态，于是 F6P 的 K0.5 升高、曲线更陡。这不是底物竞争，而是同一分子在两个位点上做两件事。
extra.en: His account of ATP inhibition works because ATP has two identities on this enzyme: it is the substrate at the catalytic site (high affinity, always occupied) and it also binds a separate, low-affinity allosteric site. As concentration rises the catalytic site saturates first, then the regulatory site fills, pushing the enzyme toward the low-affinity T state so that the K0.5 for F6P rises and the curve steepens. This is not substrate competition but one molecule doing two different jobs at two sites.

extra.zh: 细胞里 ATP 的绝对浓度波动其实很小，所以「ATP 高就抑制」真正灵敏的载体是 AMP。腺苷酸激酶催化 2 ADP ⇌ ATP + AMP，把 ATP 的小幅下降放大成 AMP 的大幅上升；AMP 结合 PFK-1 的调节位点解除 ATP 抑制。也就是说这一步读的是 ATP/AMP 比值（能荷），不是 ATP 的绝对量。AMP 同时抑制果糖-1,6-二磷酸酶-1，一个信号同时开酵解、关糖异生。
extra.en: Absolute ATP concentration barely moves inside a cell, so the sensitive carrier of the high ATP inhibits signal is really AMP. Adenylate kinase runs 2 ADP ⇌ ATP + AMP, amplifying a small fall in ATP into a large rise in AMP, and AMP binds the PFK-1 regulatory site to relieve ATP inhibition. The step therefore reads the ATP/AMP ratio, the energy charge, rather than absolute ATP. AMP simultaneously inhibits fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase-1, so one signal opens glycolysis and closes gluconeogenesis.

extra.zh: 血红蛋白的 S 型和 PFK-1 的 S 型不是同一件事，只是数学形状相同：血红蛋白是四个亚基之间对同一配体（O2）的正协同；PFK-1 是同源四聚体上 F6P 结合的协同，再叠加 ATP 这个异位效应物（heterotropic）。另外别构酶不能写 Km——米氏方程的前提在这里不成立，应写 K0.5（半饱和底物浓度）；己糖激酶那种双曲线酶才有 Km。
extra.en: The sigmoid of haemoglobin and that of PFK-1 share only their shape: haemoglobin shows positive cooperativity among four subunits for one ligand, oxygen, whereas PFK-1 shows cooperative F6P binding on a homotetramer with an additional heterotropic effector, ATP. Note also that an allosteric enzyme should not be given a Km, since the Michaelis assumptions fail; use K0.5, the half-saturating substrate concentration. Km belongs to hyperbolic enzymes such as hexokinase.

quiz.q_zh: ATP 在 PFK-1 上的双重身份是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the dual role of ATP at PFK-1?

options.zh: 既是底物，又是该酶的共价修饰供体
options.en: Substrate, and donor for covalent modification

options.zh: 既是催化位点底物，又是别构抑制剂
options.en: Catalytic-site substrate and allosteric inhibitor

options.zh: 只是底物，抑制来自水解出的 ADP
options.en: Only substrate; the ADP released does the inhibiting

options.zh: 只是别构抑制剂，磷酸供体其实是 GTP
options.en: Only an allosteric inhibitor; GTP donates phosphate

quiz.explain_zh: ATP 在催化位点作磷酸供体（高亲和力），同时在一个独立的低亲和力调节位点上作别构抑制剂，浓度升高时才占住后者。ADP 和 AMP 恰恰是解除抑制的激活剂；PFK-1 的磷酸供体只有 ATP，GTP 不参与；PFK-1 本身不靠共价磷酸化调节，那是 PFK-2/FBPase-2 双功能酶的事。
quiz.explain_en: ATP serves as the phosphate donor at the catalytic site with high affinity, and simultaneously as an allosteric inhibitor at a separate low-affinity regulatory site that only fills as concentration rises. ADP and AMP are the activators that relieve that inhibition; PFK-1 uses ATP alone as donor, not GTP; and PFK-1 itself is not regulated by covalent phosphorylation, which is what happens to the bifunctional PFK-2/FBPase-2 enzyme.

quiz.q_zh: ATP 浓度升高后，PFK-1 对底物 F6P 的曲线怎样变化？
quiz.q_en: How does raising ATP change the PFK-1 curve for F6P?

options.zh: 变成直线，速率与底物浓度无关
options.en: It flattens to a line independent of substrate

options.zh: 变成双曲线，K0.5 明显下降
options.en: It becomes hyperbolic, with K0.5 falling

options.zh: 形状不变，只有 Vmax 被压低
options.en: Shape unchanged, only Vmax is pushed down

options.zh: S 型更明显，K0.5 升高
options.en: More strongly sigmoidal, K0.5 for F6P rises

quiz.explain_zh: ATP 把酶推向低亲和力的 T 态，协同性增强，曲线更 S 型且右移，同样的 F6P 浓度下速率低得多——这正是老师说的「底物增加速率也只缓慢上升」。变成双曲线且 K0.5 下降是 F-2,6-BP 或 AMP 解除抑制后的效果；别构抑制剂主要改的是表观亲和力而不是 Vmax；酶促速率也不可能与底物浓度无关。
quiz.explain_en: ATP pushes the enzyme toward the low-affinity T state, increasing cooperativity so the curve becomes more sigmoidal and shifts right, giving far lower rates at the same F6P, which is exactly his point that the rate climbs only slowly. A hyperbolic curve with lower K0.5 is what relief by F-2,6-BP or AMP produces; an allosteric inhibitor of this type changes apparent affinity rather than Vmax; and no enzymatic rate is independent of substrate.

title_zh: F-2,6-BP 与 PFK-2：把限速步骤打开的开关
title_en: F-2,6-BP and PFK-2: the switch that opens the rate-limiting step

points.zh: 他引入第二个调节物 2,6-二磷酸果糖，并说这就是他前面一直把 1,6 写成 F16P 的原因——为了和 F26P 区分开。
points.en: He introduces the second regulator, fructose-2,6-bisphosphate, explaining that this is why he has been writing the 1,6 compound as F16P all along: to keep it apart from F26P.

points.zh: 他说 F26P 由另一个酶催化生成，叫 PFK-2；PFK-2 和 PFK-1 发挥的作用很相似。
points.en: He says F26P is made by another enzyme, PFK-2, which he describes as doing something very similar to PFK-1.

points.zh: 区别在产物：PFK-1 产生 F16P，PFK-2 产生 F26P，磷酸加在果糖的 2 位基团上。
points.en: The difference is the product: PFK-1 makes F16P, PFK-2 makes F26P, putting the phosphate on the 2 position of the sugar.

points.zh: 他说结构不需要记，只要记住 PFK-2 的产物是 2,6-二磷酸果糖就行。
points.en: He says the structure need not be memorised, only that the PFK-2 product is fructose-2,6-bisphosphate.

points.zh: 他点出 F26P 是 PFK-1 的促进剂，并回顾此前只讲了抑制：ATP 多活性低、氢离子多活性也低，还没讲什么能让 PFK 活性提高。
points.en: He identifies F26P as an activator of PFK-1 and recaps that so far only inhibition has been covered, high ATP and high proton concentration both lowering activity, with nothing yet said about what raises it.

points.zh: 他给的逻辑链：F6P 浓度很高说明糖酵解很旺盛、需要尽快把游离葡萄糖消耗掉。
points.en: His logic: a high F6P concentration shows glycolysis is running hard and that free glucose needs to be consumed quickly.

points.zh: 他接着说此时下游三羧酸循环还没走，还没产生 ATP、还没产生氢离子，所以需要 PFK-2 把 F6P 转成 F26P 来推 PFK-1。
points.en: He continues that at that moment the downstream TCA cycle has not run yet, so no ATP and no protons have been made, and PFK-2 therefore converts F6P into F26P to push PFK-1.

points.zh: 他先说这是提高限速步骤活性的「唯一的方法」，随即自己改口：也不是唯一的，这个比例提高也可以促进，但一般来说主要靠 F26P。
points.en: He first calls this the only way to raise the activity of the rate-limiting step, then immediately corrects himself: not the only way, the ratio rising also promotes it, but F26P is the main one.

points.zh: 学生复述确认后他总结方向：ATP 和 H+ 是这个反应的下游产物，回过头来抑制；F26P 在反应之前就能产生，所以是激活。
points.en: After the student repeats it back, he sums up the directions: ATP and protons are downstream products that come back and inhibit, while F26P can be made before the reaction and therefore activates.

extra.zh: PFK-2 不是一个独立的酶，而是双功能酶 PFK-2/FBPase-2 的一个结构域：同一条多肽链上一头是把 F6P 磷酸化成 F-2,6-BP 的激酶域，另一头是把 F-2,6-BP 水解回 F6P 的磷酸酶域。PKA 磷酸化这条链后激酶域关、磷酸酶域开，F-2,6-BP 塌下去（胰高血糖素、饥饿）；去磷酸化则相反（胰岛素、进食）。一个蛋白身上装着方向相反的两个开关，这是本讲最值得单独记的结构。
extra.en: PFK-2 is not a separate enzyme but one domain of the bifunctional PFK-2/FBPase-2 protein: a single polypeptide carries a kinase domain that phosphorylates F6P to F-2,6-BP at one end and a phosphatase domain that hydrolyses F-2,6-BP back to F6P at the other. PKA phosphorylation switches the kinase off and the phosphatase on, collapsing F-2,6-BP (glucagon, fasting); dephosphorylation does the reverse (insulin, feeding). Two opposing switches on one protein is the structural point most worth remembering from this section.

extra.zh: F-2,6-BP 是 PFK-1 已知最强的别构激活剂，而且是双重作用：它既提高酶对 F6P 的亲和力（把 S 型曲线拉向双曲线），又降低 ATP 抑制的效力，两个效应叠加。更妙的是同一个分子还别构抑制糖异生方向的果糖-1,6-二磷酸酶-1，所以它一个分子同时踩下糖酵解的油门和糖异生的刹车，从根上防止两条路同时跑形成无效循环。
extra.en: F-2,6-BP is the most potent allosteric activator of PFK-1 known, and it acts twice over: it raises the affinity of the enzyme for F6P, pulling the sigmoid toward a hyperbola, and it weakens ATP inhibition. Better still, the same molecule allosterically inhibits fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase-1 on the gluconeogenic side, so a single metabolite presses the glycolytic accelerator and the gluconeogenic brake together, preventing the futile cycle of both routes running at once.

extra.zh: F-1,6-BP 和 F-2,6-BP 必须分清楚，考试最爱在这里设陷阱。F-1,6-BP：PFK-1 的产物，是通路上真正被醛缩酶裂解的中间物，作用是前馈激活丙酮酸激酶。F-2,6-BP：PFK-2 的产物，完全不进入通路、不被代谢掉，只作信号分子，作用是激活 PFK-1 并抑制 FBPase-1。一个是货，一个是命令。
extra.en: F-1,6-BP and F-2,6-BP must be kept apart; this is a favourite exam trap. F-1,6-BP is the product of PFK-1, a genuine intermediate that aldolase cleaves, and it feed-forward activates pyruvate kinase. F-2,6-BP is the product of PFK-2, never enters the pathway and is not consumed by it, existing purely as a signal that activates PFK-1 and inhibits FBPase-1. One is cargo, the other is an order.

extra.zh: 他把抑制 PFK-1 的 H+ 说成「三羧酸循环产生后回过头来抑制」。ATP 那部分是对的，H+ 这部分来源说反了：PFK-1 被低 pH 抑制的生理意义是无氧酵解大量产乳酸使胞质酸化时踩刹车，防止乳酸酸中毒——也就是能量紧缺的时候，不是能量充足的时候。能用来合成 ATP 的质子梯度在线粒体内膜两侧，和胞质 pH 是完全不同的两个质子池。
extra.en: He presents the protons that inhibit PFK-1 as a TCA-cycle product feeding back. The ATP half is right, but the proton source is inverted: inhibition of PFK-1 by low pH is a brake applied when heavy anaerobic glycolysis floods the cytosol with lactate and acidifies it, guarding against lactic acidosis, which happens when energy is short rather than plentiful. The proton gradient that can be used to make ATP sits across the inner mitochondrial membrane and is a different pool entirely from cytosolic pH.

quiz.q_zh: F-2,6-BP 在肝细胞里做什么？
quiz.q_en: What does F-2,6-BP do in a hepatocyte?

options.zh: 前馈激活丙酮酸激酶，提高 ATP 产量
options.en: Feed-forward activates pyruvate kinase for yield

options.zh: 别构抑制 PFK-2，构成负反馈回路
options.en: Allosterically inhibits PFK-2 as negative feedback

options.zh: 作为中间物被醛缩酶裂解成 GAP
options.en: Serves as an intermediate cleaved by aldolase

options.zh: 激活 PFK-1，抑制果糖二磷酸酶
