options.en: Activates PFK-1, inhibits the bisphosphatase

quiz.explain_zh: F-2,6-BP 是纯粹的信号分子，同时开糖酵解、关糖异生，避免两条路空转。被醛缩酶裂解的是 F-1,6-BP，前馈激活丙酮酸激酶的也是 F-1,6-BP；F-2,6-BP 的浓度由 PFK-2/FBPase-2 双功能酶的磷酸化状态决定，不靠自身反馈抑制 PFK-2。
quiz.explain_en: F-2,6-BP is a pure signal that opens glycolysis and closes gluconeogenesis, keeping the two from idling against each other. The molecule aldolase cleaves is F-1,6-BP, and the feed-forward activator of pyruvate kinase is likewise F-1,6-BP; the level of F-2,6-BP is set by the phosphorylation state of the bifunctional PFK-2/FBPase-2 protein rather than by feedback onto PFK-2.

quiz.q_zh: F-2,6-BP 由哪个酶生成，磷酸加在哪里？
quiz.q_en: Which enzyme makes F-2,6-BP, and where does the phosphate go?

options.zh: 己糖激酶，把磷酸加到葡萄糖 6 位上
options.en: Hexokinase, adding phosphate at glucose position 6

options.zh: 磷酸甘油酸变位酶，把磷酸移到 2 位
options.en: Phosphoglycerate mutase, moving phosphate to C2

options.zh: PFK-2，把磷酸加到果糖的 2 位
options.en: PFK-2, adding phosphate at the 2 position of F6P

options.zh: PFK-1，把磷酸加到果糖的 1 位上
options.en: PFK-1, adding phosphate at the fructose 1 position

quiz.explain_zh: PFK-2 以 ATP 为磷酸供体，在 F6P 的 2 位上再装一个磷酸，得到 F-2,6-BP。PFK-1 加的是 1 位、产物是通路中间物 F-1,6-BP；己糖激酶做的是葡萄糖变 G6P 那一步；磷酸甘油酸变位酶把 3-磷酸甘油酸上的磷酸从 3 位挪到 2 位，与果糖无关。
quiz.explain_en: PFK-2 uses ATP to place a second phosphate on the 2 position of F6P, giving F-2,6-BP. PFK-1 phosphorylates position 1 and its product, F-1,6-BP, is a pathway intermediate; hexokinase catalyses glucose to G6P; and phosphoglycerate mutase shifts a phosphate from C3 to C2 of 3-phosphoglycerate, which has nothing to do with fructose.

quiz.q_zh: 胰高血糖素升高时肝内 F-2,6-BP 浓度如何变化，机制是什么？
quiz.q_en: How and why does hepatic F-2,6-BP change when glucagon rises?

options.zh: 上升，PKA 磷酸化使激酶域活性增强
options.en: It rises: PKA phosphorylation boosts the kinase

options.zh: 下降，胰高血糖素直接抑制 PFK-1
options.en: It falls: glucagon inhibits the PFK-1 protein itself

options.zh: 不变，其浓度只由 F6P 供应量决定
options.en: Unchanged: only F6P supply sets its concentration

options.zh: 下降，PKA 磷酸化使磷酸酶域开启
options.en: It falls: PKA phosphorylation opens the phosphatase

quiz.explain_zh: PFK-2/FBPase-2 是一条多肽上的两个域，被 PKA 磷酸化后激酶域关、磷酸酶域开，已有的 F-2,6-BP 被水解回 F6P，浓度下降，PFK-1 失去激活剂。磷酸化增强激酶域是胰岛素信号下去磷酸化的效果，方向反了；胰高血糖素不直接结合 PFK-1；底物供应虽有影响，但决定性因素是这条链的磷酸化状态。
quiz.explain_en: PFK-2/FBPase-2 carries two domains on one chain; PKA phosphorylation shuts the kinase and opens the phosphatase, so existing F-2,6-BP is hydrolysed back to F6P and PFK-1 loses its activator. Phosphorylation boosting the kinase domain has the direction backwards, since it is dephosphorylation under insulin that favours kinase activity; glucagon does not bind PFK-1 directly; and while substrate supply matters, the decisive variable is the phosphorylation state of that chain.

title_zh: 调节图复盘；己糖激酶与肝脏葡萄糖激酶
title_en: Recap of the regulation map; hexokinase versus liver glucokinase

points.zh: 学生复述最后一步：到 pyruvate 这一步不可逆，问 F16P 对它是不是抑制；老师明确回答「它是激活」。
points.en: The student reads back the last step, notes it is irreversible, and asks whether F16P inhibits it; he answers plainly that it activates.

points.zh: 结论定下来：对丙酮酸激酶，F-1,6-BP 是激活，ATP 是抑制；他让学生直接打出来核对了一遍。
points.en: The conclusion is settled: for pyruvate kinase, F-1,6-BP activates and ATP inhibits; he has the student type it out and confirms it.

points.zh: 他自己评价这张调节图「很绕、非常绕」，但比核酸那章有逻辑，可以顺一顺。
points.en: He calls the regulation slide convoluted but says it has more internal logic than the nucleic acid chapter and can be reasoned through.

points.zh: 最后一个调节点回到第一步：己糖激酶。
points.en: The last control point takes him back to step one, hexokinase.

points.zh: 他说己糖激酶的特异性没有那么高，而且会被自己的产物所抑制。
points.en: He says hexokinase has fairly low specificity and is inhibited by its own product.

points.zh: 葡萄糖激酶他说是在肝脏里的，最重要的特点是不受 G6P 的抑制，他重复了两遍。
points.en: Glucokinase he places in the liver, and its most important property, which he states twice, is that G6P does not inhibit it.

points.zh: 他明确说葡萄糖激酶受别的东西抑制这部分不要记，记了会头昏，只需要记住不受 G6P 抑制。
points.en: He explicitly tells the student not to memorise what else inhibits glucokinase, only that G6P does not.

points.zh: 他说葡萄糖激酶在肝脏里源源不断地把肝糖原变成可以走糖酵解的 G6P。
points.en: He says glucokinase in the liver continuously converts liver glycogen into G6P for use by glycolysis.

points.zh: 考点范围：他说后面从代谢调节一直到半乳糖那里都不用看，讲的都不是葡萄糖的代谢，完全不是考点，他在幻灯片上打了叉。
points.en: On scope: everything from there through the galactose material need not be read, since it is not glucose metabolism and is not examinable, and he has crossed it out on the slide.

extra.zh: 「葡萄糖激酶把肝糖原变成 G6P」方向反了。葡萄糖激酶催化的是游离葡萄糖 + ATP → G6P，是餐后把血糖抓进肝细胞的那一侧。糖原 → G6P 走的是另一条完全不同的路：糖原磷酸化酶把糖原磷酸解成 1-磷酸葡萄糖 G1P，再由磷酸葡萄糖变位酶转成 G6P；这条路不耗 ATP，用的是无机磷酸。而且肝糖原分解出的 G6P 主要去向是被葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶水解成游离葡萄糖释放入血维持血糖，并不是自己拿去跑糖酵解。
extra.en: Glucokinase converting liver glycogen to G6P runs the wrong way. Glucokinase catalyses free glucose plus ATP to G6P, the post-prandial side that pulls blood glucose into the hepatocyte. Glycogen to G6P is an entirely different route: glycogen phosphorylase phosphorolyses glycogen to glucose-1-phosphate, and phosphoglucomutase converts that to G6P, using inorganic phosphate and no ATP. Moreover the G6P released from hepatic glycogen is mostly hydrolysed by glucose-6-phosphatase to free glucose for export into blood, rather than being run through glycolysis in the liver itself.

extra.zh: 己糖激酶 I–III 的 Km 对葡萄糖约 0.1 mM 量级，远低于正常血糖（约 5 mM），所以它们平时就处于饱和，通量由产物 G6P 的反馈抑制来控制。肝的葡萄糖激酶 Km 约 10 mM，落在餐后门静脉血糖的范围里，因此只有血糖高时才明显开工，而且不被 G6P 抑制，可以不饱和地持续摄糖。两个数字合起来解释了同一个反应为什么需要两套酶：外周要稳定供能，肝要做缓冲池。
extra.en: Hexokinases I–III have a Km for glucose on the order of 0.1 mM, far below normal blood glucose of about 5 mM, so they sit saturated and their flux is set by product inhibition from G6P. Liver glucokinase has a Km near 10 mM, within the post-prandial portal range, so it only works hard when glucose is high, and because G6P does not inhibit it, it can keep taking up sugar without saturating. Those two numbers explain why one reaction needs two enzymes: the periphery needs steady fuel, the liver needs to act as a buffer.

extra.zh: 葡萄糖激酶就是己糖激酶 IV，是己糖激酶家族的同工酶 isozyme，同一反应、不同基因产物、不同组织分布和动力学（他在本讲前面某处说过两者「不是同工酶」，那句是错的）。他叫学生不要记的那部分调节其实很简洁：肝细胞核里有个葡萄糖激酶调节蛋白 GKRP，在低血糖、F6P 存在时把 GK 扣在核内；血糖升高或出现果糖-1-磷酸时把它放回胞质。这是隔离而不是别构抑制。
extra.en: Glucokinase is hexokinase IV, an isozyme of the hexokinase family: same reaction, different gene product, different tissue distribution and kinetics. (Earlier in this lecture he said the two are not isozymes; that statement is wrong.) The regulation he tells the student to skip is actually simple: glucokinase regulatory protein, GKRP, sequesters GK in the hepatocyte nucleus when glucose is low and F6P is present, and releases it to the cytosol when glucose rises or fructose-1-phosphate appears. That is sequestration rather than allosteric inhibition.

extra.zh: 「己糖激酶特异性没那么高」的具体含义：HK I–III 能磷酸化葡萄糖、果糖、甘露糖等多种六碳糖，所以叫己糖激酶（hexokinase，己糖 = hexose）；葡萄糖激酶几乎只作用于葡萄糖，名字里的葡萄糖就是这个意思。这也解释了为什么肌肉里吃进来的果糖能被直接磷酸化，而肝里的果糖要走果糖激酶那条独立的路。
extra.en: Low specificity, concretely: hexokinases I–III phosphorylate glucose, fructose, mannose and other six-carbon sugars, which is why they are named for hexose rather than for glucose; glucokinase acts almost exclusively on glucose, which is what its name records. This is also why fructose taken up by muscle can be phosphorylated directly while fructose in the liver goes through the separate fructokinase route.

quiz.q_zh: 肝糖原分解生成 G6P 走的是哪条路？
quiz.q_en: How does liver glycogen actually become G6P?

options.zh: 葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶把肝糖原水解成 G6P
options.en: Glucose-6-phosphatase hydrolyses glycogen to G6P

options.zh: 葡萄糖激酶直接把糖原磷酸化成 G6P
options.en: Glucokinase phosphorylates glycogen straight to G6P

options.zh: 己糖激酶把糖原末端葡萄糖变成 G6P
options.en: Hexokinase converts the glycogen end unit to G6P

options.zh: 磷酸化酶产 G1P，变位酶转成 G6P
options.en: Glycogen phosphorylase gives G1P, mutase gives G6P

quiz.explain_zh: 糖原磷酸解用的是无机磷酸而不是 ATP，先得到 1-磷酸葡萄糖，再由磷酸葡萄糖变位酶挪成 6-磷酸。葡萄糖激酶和己糖激酶的底物都是游离的单糖，不能作用于糖原大分子；葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶方向正相反，是把 G6P 水解成游离葡萄糖送进血液的那个酶。
quiz.explain_en: Glycogen is phosphorolysed with inorganic phosphate rather than ATP, giving glucose-1-phosphate first, which phosphoglucomutase then shifts to the 6 position. Glucokinase and hexokinase both act on free monosaccharides and cannot attack the glycogen polymer, while glucose-6-phosphatase runs the other way, hydrolysing G6P to free glucose for export to the blood.

quiz.q_zh: 肝脏葡萄糖激酶与肌肉己糖激酶最关键的区别是什么？
quiz.q_en: What most distinguishes liver glucokinase from muscle hexokinase?

options.zh: 葡萄糖激酶不用 ATP 而用 GTP 供磷酸
options.en: Glucokinase uses GTP rather than ATP as donor

options.zh: 葡萄糖激酶不被 G6P 抑制，Km 高
options.en: Glucokinase escapes G6P inhibition, high Km

options.zh: 葡萄糖激酶只有在血糖偏低时才被启用
options.en: Glucokinase only switches on when glucose is low

options.zh: 葡萄糖激酶能把 G6P 水解成游离葡萄糖
options.en: Glucokinase hydrolyses G6P back to free glucose

quiz.explain_zh: 这两点是配套的：Km 高使它只在餐后高血糖时开工，不被产物抑制使它能不饱和地把糖持续抓进肝细胞储存起来。两者的磷酸供体都是 ATP；正因为 Km 高，它恰恰是在高血糖而非低血糖时工作；把 G6P 水解成葡萄糖的是葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶，是完全不同的酶。
quiz.explain_en: The two properties work together: a high Km means it only engages when post-prandial glucose is high, and freedom from product inhibition lets it keep pulling sugar into the hepatocyte for storage without saturating. Both enzymes use ATP as donor; the high Km means it acts when glucose is high, not low; and hydrolysing G6P to glucose is the job of glucose-6-phosphatase, a different enzyme entirely.

title_zh: 【可跳过·非课程内容】课堂收尾与闲聊
title_en: [Skippable · not course material] Wrap-up and off-topic chat

points.zh: 学生提到自己可能要在酵母（yeast）那边学半乳糖，因为半乳糖是调节酵母表达蛋白的重要东西，老师表示同意。
points.en: The student mentions needing to learn about galactose on the yeast side, since it matters for driving protein expression in yeast, and he agrees.

points.zh: 老师重申半乳糖怎么降解「完全不重要」，不是本课考点。
points.en: He repeats that how galactose is degraded is entirely unimportant and not examinable here.

points.zh: 他把课件保存到桌面，并说糖酵解的别名是 EMP 途径。
points.en: He saves the slides to the desktop and notes that glycolysis is also called the EMP pathway.

points.zh: 谈到 PPP，他说全称是磷酸戊糖途径，认为它在整个生化里是非常边缘的知识点，不是重点。
points.en: On PPP he gives the full name, the pentose phosphate pathway, and judges it a very marginal topic in biochemistry as a whole.

points.zh: 他翻幻灯片时确认另一张图是电子传递链。
points.en: Flipping through the slides, he confirms that another figure is the electron transport chain.

points.zh: 他说今天讲的内容非常多，已经完成了本节课的目标——把糖酵解的每一个步骤详细讲一遍。
points.en: He says a great deal was covered and the goal of the session, walking through every step of glycolysis in detail, has been met.

points.zh: 他建议学生接下来几天多对照他发的 ChemDraw cdxml 文件复习；学生说电脑过热，稍后再打开，课程在互相道谢中结束。
points.en: He suggests reviewing against the ChemDraw cdxml file he sent over the next few days; the student says the laptop is overheating and will open it later, and the session ends with thanks on both sides.

extra.zh: 半乳糖在酵母里的意义正是学生想到的那个：GAL1/GAL10 启动子受半乳糖诱导、被葡萄糖阻遏，是酵母表达外源蛋白的经典可控开关。在人体内半乳糖走 Leloir 途径——半乳糖激酶生成半乳糖-1-磷酸，GALT 与 UDP-葡萄糖交换基团，UDP-半乳糖-4-差向异构酶完成翻转，最终以 G1P 汇入糖代谢；GALT 缺陷即经典型半乳糖血症。
extra.en: Galactose in yeast means exactly what the student was reaching for: the GAL1/GAL10 promoters are galactose-induced and glucose-repressed, the classic controllable switch for expressing foreign protein in yeast. In humans galactose runs the Leloir pathway, galactokinase to galactose-1-phosphate, GALT exchanging groups with UDP-glucose, and UDP-galactose-4-epimerase inverting the sugar, entering carbohydrate metabolism as G1P; GALT deficiency is classic galactosaemia.

extra.zh: 他顺口把磷酸戊糖途径的位置说成「在电子传递链之后」，从上下文看他多半是在说幻灯片的先后顺序，不要当成代谢顺序记。PPP 在胞质，从糖酵解第一步的产物 G6P 分叉出去，与糖酵解并行，产物是 NADPH 和核糖-5-磷酸，与电子传递链没有先后关系。它也不像他说的那么边缘：NADPH 供脂肪酸合成和谷胱甘肽还原，红细胞尤其依赖，G6PD 缺乏症就是这条路出问题。
extra.en: He remarks in passing that the pentose phosphate pathway comes after the electron transport chain; from context he is almost certainly describing slide order, so do not record it as metabolic sequence. PPP runs in the cytosol, branching from G6P, the product of the first glycolytic step, in parallel with glycolysis, and yields NADPH and ribose-5-phosphate, with no ordering relative to the respiratory chain. Nor is it as marginal as he suggests: NADPH supports fatty acid synthesis and glutathione reduction, erythrocytes depend on it heavily, and G6PD deficiency is a failure of exactly this route.

extra.zh: EMP 是 Embden–Meyerhof–Parnas 三位研究者姓氏的缩写，指的就是这一讲从头讲到尾的这条经典糖酵解。细菌里还有替代路线：Entner–Doudoroff 途径（每分子葡萄糖净得 1 ATP，见于假单胞菌等）和磷酸解酮酶途径（异型乳酸发酵）。记住 EMP 这个名字的用处是读文献时不会把它当成另一条陌生通路。
extra.en: EMP stands for Embden, Meyerhof and Parnas, the three investigators, and denotes precisely the classical glycolysis walked through in this lecture. Bacteria have alternatives: the Entner–Doudoroff pathway (net 1 ATP per glucose, found in Pseudomonas and others) and the phosphoketolase route of heterolactic fermentation. Knowing the abbreviation mainly stops it looking like an unfamiliar pathway in a paper.

quiz.q_zh: 磷酸戊糖途径发生在哪里，主要产物是什么？
quiz.q_en: Where does the pentose phosphate pathway run, and what does it yield?

options.zh: 溶酶体，产 NADPH 和丙酮酸
options.en: Lysosomes, giving NADPH and pyruvate

options.zh: 胞质，从 G6P 分叉产 NADPH
options.en: Cytosol, branching from G6P to give NADPH

options.zh: 线粒体基质，产 NADH 和 CO2
options.en: Mitochondrial matrix, giving NADH and CO2

options.zh: 内质网腔，产 ATP 和核糖
options.en: The ER lumen, giving ATP and ribose

quiz.explain_zh: PPP 与糖酵解同在胞质，从 G6P 分出去，氧化分支产 NADPH 和 CO2，非氧化分支产核糖-5-磷酸并把碳骨架以 F6P 和 3-磷酸甘油醛的形式还回糖酵解。它不产 ATP，也不产 NADH——NADPH 用于还原性生物合成，与 NADH 的产能用途是分开的两个池；线粒体、内质网、溶酶体都不是它的场所。
quiz.explain_en: PPP shares the cytosol with glycolysis, branching at G6P; its oxidative arm yields NADPH and CO2 and its non-oxidative arm yields ribose-5-phosphate while returning carbon to glycolysis as F6P and glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate. It makes no ATP and no NADH: NADPH serves reductive biosynthesis and is kept as a separate pool from the NADH used for energy. Mitochondria, ER and lysosomes are not its location.

quiz.q_zh: EMP 途径指的是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does the EMP pathway refer to?

options.zh: 经典糖酵解途径的另一种叫法
options.en: Another common name for classical glycolysis

options.zh: 磷酸戊糖途径的旧称呼方式
options.en: An older name for the pentose phosphate route

options.zh: 三羧酸循环最常见的别名写法
options.en: A common alternative name for the TCA cycle

options.zh: 电子传递链的化学渗透偶联
options.en: Chemiosmotic coupling in the respiratory chain

quiz.explain_zh: EMP 取自 Embden、Meyerhof、Parnas 三位研究者的姓，指的就是葡萄糖到丙酮酸的这条十步途径。电子传递链的偶联叫化学渗透学说（Mitchell）；磷酸戊糖途径的常见别名是 HMP 支路；三羧酸循环的别名是 Krebs 循环或柠檬酸循环。
quiz.explain_en: EMP comes from the surnames Embden, Meyerhof and Parnas and denotes the ten-step route from glucose to pyruvate. Coupling in the respiratory chain is Mitchell chemiosmotic theory; the pentose phosphate pathway is commonly abbreviated the HMP shunt; and the TCA cycle goes by Krebs cycle or citric acid cycle.
